---
title: "GSE159354 CD31+ / CD45+ lung scRNA-seq: original analysis notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

This is the exploratory notebook the project was developed in, kept for provenance.
It runs top to bottom in RStudio from the `notebooks/` folder, but it contains the
dead ends and repeated plotting blocks of a working session. The cleaned, de-duplicated
version of the same analysis is in `scripts/` (one numbered script per stage) with the
shared code in `R/`; see `README.md` and `docs/pipeline.md`.

Changes from the working copy: machine-specific paths now come from `config.R`,
package-install calls were removed, and a handful of broken lines were fixed
(listed in `docs/changes.md`).

```{r}

## Paths come from ../config.R (set GSE159354_RAW / SC_RESULTS or edit the defaults there).
source(file.path("..", "config.R"))

## Packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(harmony)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(Matrix)
  library(tibble)
   library(tidyr)
})

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 0) Paths
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- cfg$data_dir

## ===== Discover files (.h5 anywhere under data_dir) =====
h5_file_paths <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(h5_file_paths) > 0)

file_discovery_tbl <- tibble(
  file  = normalizePath(h5_file_paths),
  fname = basename(h5_file_paths),
  gsm   = sub("^(GSM\\d+).*", "\\1", basename(h5_file_paths))
)

## ===== Manifest (GSM -> donor / group / fraction) =====
## Keep as-is; do not edit labels here
sample_manifest <- tribble(
  ~gsm,        ~donor,  ~group,    ~fraction,
  "GSM4827158","F19609","IPF",     "EPCAMp_SAbGALp",
  "GSM4827159","F19609","IPF",     "EPCAMp_SAbGALneg",
  "GSM4827160","F19609","IPF",     "CD90p",
  "GSM4827161","F19609","IPF",     "CD31p",
  "GSM4827162","F19609","IPF",     "CD45p",
  "GSM4827163","N1902", "CTRL",    "CD90p",
  "GSM4827164","N1902", "CTRL",    "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827165","N1902", "CTRL",    "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827166","N1902", "CTRL",    "CD31p",
  "GSM4827167","N1902", "CTRL",    "CD45p",
  "GSM4827168","S19600","SSc-ILD", "EPCAMp_HT2280neg",
  "GSM4827169","S19600","SSc-ILD", "EPCAMp_HT2280pos",
  "GSM4827170","S19600","SSc-ILD", "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827171","S19600","SSc-ILD", "CD31p",
  "GSM4827172","S19600","SSc-ILD", "CD45p",
  "GSM4827173","S19584","SSc-ILD", "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827174","S19584","SSc-ILD", "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827175","S19584","SSc-ILD", "CD31p",
  "GSM4827176","S19584","SSc-ILD", "CD45p",
  "GSM4827177","S19578","SSc-ILD", "CD90p",
  "GSM4827178","S19578","SSc-ILD", "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827179","S19578","SSc-ILD", "CD31p",
  "GSM4827180","S19578","SSc-ILD", "CD45p",
  "GSM4827181","N1857", "CTRL",    "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827182","N1857", "CTRL",    "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827183","N1857", "CTRL",    "CD31p",
  "GSM4827184","N1857", "CTRL",    "CD45p",
  "GSM4827185","N1857", "CTRL",    "Unsorted",
  "GSM4827186","F18555","IPF",     "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827187","F18555","IPF",     "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827188","F18555","IPF",     "CD31p",
  "GSM4827189","F18555","IPF",     "CD45p",
  "GSM4827190","F18555","IPF",     "Unsorted",
  "GSM4827191","F18545","IPF",     "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827192","F18545","IPF",     "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827193","F18545","IPF",     "CD31p",
  "GSM4827194","F18545","IPF",     "CD45p",
  "GSM4827195","F18545","IPF",     "Unsorted",
  "GSM4827196","N1865", "CTRL",    "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827197","N1865", "CTRL",    "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827198","N1865", "CTRL",    "CD31p",
  "GSM4827199","N1865", "CTRL",    "CD45p",
  "GSM4827200","N1865", "CTRL",    "Unsorted",
  "GSM4827201","F18536","IPF",     "TripleNeg",
  "GSM4827202","F18536","IPF",     "EPCAMp",
  "GSM4827203","F18536","IPF",     "CD31p",
  "GSM4827204","F18536","IPF",     "CD45p",
  "GSM4827205","F18536","IPF",     "Unsorted"
) %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("CTRL","IPF","SSc-ILD")))

## ===== Join files to manifest; keep ALL THREE GROUPS CD31p & CD45p =====
complete_manifest <- sample_manifest %>% left_join(file_discovery_tbl, by = "gsm")
filtered_manifest <- complete_manifest %>%
  filter(group %in% c("CTRL","IPF","SSc-ILD"),  # Include all three groups
         fraction %in% c("CD31p","CD45p")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(file) & file.exists(file))

## fraction -> readable cell set
celltype_mapping <- c("CD31p"="EC", "CD45p"="Immune")
filtered_manifest <- filtered_manifest %>%
  mutate(cellset = recode(fraction, !!!celltype_mapping),
         group_chr = as.character(group),
         sample_id = paste(group_chr, cellset, donor, gsm, sep = "_"))

## ===== Loader (QC + metadata + clear names) =====
load_sample <- function(row) {
  count_matrix <- Read10X_h5(row$file)
  rownames(count_matrix) <- make.unique(rownames(count_matrix))
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = count_matrix,
                                   project = row$sample_id,
                                   min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  seurat_obj$gsm      <- row$gsm
  seurat_obj$donor    <- row$donor
  seurat_obj$group    <- factor(row$group, levels = c("CTRL","IPF","SSc-ILD"))
  seurat_obj$fraction <- row$fraction
  seurat_obj$cellset  <- row$cellset
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, "^MT-")
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
                                          nFeature_RNA < 8000 &
                                          percent.mt    < 20)
  ## prefix cell barcodes with sample_id for clarity after merge
  seurat_obj <- RenameCells(seurat_obj, new.names = paste(row$sample_id, Cells(seurat_obj), sep=":"))
  return(seurat_obj)
}

sample_objects <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(filtered_manifest)), function(i) load_sample(filtered_manifest[i, ]))
names(sample_objects) <- filtered_manifest$sample_id
sample_objects <- Filter(function(o) ncol(o) > 0, sample_objects)
stopifnot(length(sample_objects) > 0)

## ===== Merge and standard workflow =====
combined_seurat <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y), sample_objects)

DefaultAssay(combined_seurat) <- "RNA"
combined_seurat <- NormalizeData(combined_seurat, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
combined_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(combined_seurat, nfeatures = 3000, selection.method = "vst", verbose = FALSE)
combined_seurat <- ScaleData(combined_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
combined_seurat <- RunPCA(combined_seurat, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

## Harmony over donor and fraction
combined_seurat <- RunHarmony(combined_seurat, group.by.vars = c("donor","fraction"), verbose = TRUE)

## UMAP / neighbors / clusters
combined_seurat <- RunUMAP(combined_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
combined_seurat <- FindNeighbors(combined_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
combined_seurat <- FindClusters(combined_seurat, resolution = 0.6)

## ===== Create UMAP plots =====
# UMAP colored by cell type (EC vs Immune)
celltype_plot <- DimPlot(combined_seurat, group.by = "cellset", reduction = "umap",
                        cols = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
                        ggtitle("UMAP: Endothelial Cells vs Immune Cells") +
                        theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

# UMAP colored by disease group
group_plot <- DimPlot(combined_seurat, group.by = "group", reduction = "umap") +
              ggtitle("UMAP: CTRL vs IPF vs SSc-ILD")

# UMAP colored by clusters
cluster_plot <- DimPlot(combined_seurat, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap") +
                ggtitle("UMAP: Clusters")

print(celltype_plot)
print(group_plot)
print(cluster_plot)

## ===== Generate Summary Statistics =====
# Create summary table
cell_count_summary <- combined_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group, cellset) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cellset, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = EC + Immune)

# Add totals by group
group_totals <- combined_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Add totals by cell type
celltype_totals <- combined_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cellset) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop')

# Print summary statistics
cat("\n=== CELL COUNT SUMMARY ===\n")
print(cell_count_summary)

cat("\n=== TOTAL CELLS BY GROUP ===\n")
print(group_totals)

cat("\n=== TOTAL CELLS BY CELL TYPE ===\n")
print(celltype_totals)

cat("\n=== OVERALL STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Total cells:", ncol(combined_seurat), "\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(combined_seurat), "\n")
cat("Number of samples:", length(sample_objects), "\n")
cat("Number of donors:", length(unique(combined_seurat$donor)), "\n")

## ===== Create marker plots =====
pdf("ThreeGroup_Markers.pdf", height = 10, width = 20)
print(FeaturePlot(combined_seurat, features = c("PECAM1","VWF","CDH5","CLDN5","KDR","PTPRC","MS4A1","LYZ"),
                  ncol = 4, reduction = "umap"))
dev.off()

## ===== Save results =====
saveRDS(combined_seurat, file = "GSE159354_ThreeGroup_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

## Create detailed sample summary
detailed_summary <- data.frame(
  sample_id   = names(sample_objects),
  donor       = sapply(sample_objects, \(o) unique(o$donor)),
  group       = sapply(sample_objects, \(o) as.character(unique(o$group))),
  cellset     = sapply(sample_objects, \(o) unique(o$cellset)),
  n_cells     = sapply(sample_objects, ncol),
  n_genes     = sapply(sample_objects, nrow),
  row.names = NULL
)

write.csv(detailed_summary, "ThreeGroup_sample_summary_EC-Immune.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cell_count_summary, "ThreeGroup_cell_counts_by_group_celltype.csv", row.names = FALSE)

## ===== Additional summary plots =====
pdf("ThreeGroup_Summary_Plots.pdf", height = 8, width = 12)

# Bar plot of cell counts by group and cell type
count_plot <- combined_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group, cellset) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = n_cells, fill = cellset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
  labs(title = "Cell Counts by Disease Group and Cell Type",
       x = "Disease Group", y = "Number of Cells", fill = "Cell Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(count_plot)

# Proportions plot
prop_plot <- combined_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group, cellset) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n_cells / sum(n_cells)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = proportion, fill = cellset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
  labs(title = "Cell Type Proportions by Disease Group",
       x = "Disease Group", y = "Proportion", fill = "Cell Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(prop_plot)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
combined_seurat <- readRDS("GSE159354_ThreeGroup_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

## ===== Remove specific clusters and create new object =====
# Clusters to remove: 17, 12, 16, 15, 7, and 19
clusters_to_remove <- c("17", "12", "16", "15", "7", "19")

# Create a new object by subsetting - remove unwanted clusters
filtered_lung_seurat <- subset(combined_seurat,
                              subset = seurat_clusters %in% setdiff(levels(combined_seurat$seurat_clusters),
                                                                   clusters_to_remove))

# Check how many cells remain
cat("Original object cells:", ncol(combined_seurat), "\n")
cat("Filtered object cells:", ncol(filtered_lung_seurat), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", ncol(combined_seurat) - ncol(filtered_lung_seurat), "\n")

## ===== UMAP: Endothelial Cells vs Immune Cells (filtered object) =====
filtered_celltype_plot <- DimPlot(filtered_lung_seurat, group.by = "cellset", reduction = "umap",
                                  cols = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
                                  ggtitle("Filtered UMAP: Endothelial Cells vs Immune Cells") +
                                  theme_minimal() +
                                  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
                                        panel.grid = element_blank())

print(filtered_celltype_plot)

## ===== Individual Group UMAPs =====
# Get cell identifiers for each group
ctrl_cells <- WhichCells(filtered_lung_seurat, expression = group == "CTRL")
ipf_cells <- WhichCells(filtered_lung_seurat, expression = group == "IPF")
ssc_cells <- WhichCells(filtered_lung_seurat, expression = group == "SSc-ILD")

# Extract UMAP coordinates for each group
ctrl_coords <- filtered_lung_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[ctrl_cells, ]
ipf_coords <- filtered_lung_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[ipf_cells, ]
ssc_coords <- filtered_lung_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings[ssc_cells, ]

# Check what the columns are actually called
print("UMAP coordinate column names:")
print(colnames(ctrl_coords))

# Create individual group plots
ctrl_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(ctrl_coords), aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2E8B57", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("UMAP: CTRL - All Cells (Filtered)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ipf_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(ipf_coords), aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(color = "#9370DB", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("UMAP: IPF - All Cells (Filtered)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ssc_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(ssc_coords), aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2)) +
  geom_point(color = "#DC143C", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("UMAP: SSc-ILD - All Cells (Filtered)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(ctrl_plot)
print(ipf_plot)
print(ssc_plot)

## ===== CTRL vs Disease (IPF + SSc-ILD) UMAP =====
# Create disease status column
filtered_lung_seurat$disease_status <- ifelse(filtered_lung_seurat$group == "CTRL", "CTRL", "Disease")
filtered_lung_seurat$disease_status <- factor(filtered_lung_seurat$disease_status, levels = c("CTRL", "Disease"))

# Create CTRL vs Disease plot
ctrl_vs_disease_plot <- DimPlot(filtered_lung_seurat,
                               group.by = "disease_status",
                               reduction = "umap",
                               pt.size = 0.01,
                               cols = c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57", "Disease" = "#DC143C")) +
                               ggtitle("UMAP: CTRL vs Disease (IPF + SSc-ILD) - Filtered") +
                               theme_minimal() +
                               theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                                     plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

print(ctrl_vs_disease_plot)

## ===== Summary Statistics for Filtered Object =====
cat("\n=== FILTERED OBJECT SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Clusters removed:", paste(clusters_to_remove, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Remaining clusters:", paste(sort(as.numeric(unique(filtered_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters))), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Create summary table for filtered object
filtered_cell_summary <- filtered_lung_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group, cellset) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cellset, values_from = n_cells, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = EC + Immune)

cat("\n=== FILTERED CELL COUNT SUMMARY ===\n")
print(filtered_cell_summary)

# Comparison of original vs filtered
cat("\n=== BEFORE vs AFTER FILTERING ===\n")
original_total <- ncol(combined_seurat)
filtered_total <- ncol(filtered_lung_seurat)
cat("Original total cells:", original_total, "\n")
cat("Filtered total cells:", filtered_total, "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round((filtered_total/original_total)*100, 1), "%\n")

## ===== Save the filtered object =====
saveRDS(filtered_lung_seurat, file = "GSE159354_FilteredClusters_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

## ===== Create a combined plot showing all 4 UMAPs =====
library(gridExtra)

# Arrange all plots in a 2x2 grid
combined_plot <- grid.arrange(
  filtered_celltype_plot,
  ctrl_vs_disease_plot,
  arrangeGrob(ctrl_plot, ipf_plot, ssc_plot, ncol = 3),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1, 1)
)

# Save all plots as PDF
pdf("Filtered_UMAP_Analysis.pdf", height = 15, width = 20)
print(filtered_celltype_plot)
print(ctrl_vs_disease_plot)
print(ctrl_plot)
print(ipf_plot)
print(ssc_plot)
# Print a summary page with all plots
grid.arrange(
  filtered_celltype_plot,
  ctrl_vs_disease_plot,
  arrangeGrob(ctrl_plot, ipf_plot, ssc_plot, ncol = 3),
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1, 1),
  top = "Filtered Lung scRNA-seq Analysis Summary"
)
dev.off()

cat("\n=== Analysis Complete ===\n")
cat("New filtered object saved as: GSE159354_FilteredClusters_EC-Immune_harmony.rds\n")
cat("All plots saved as: Filtered_UMAP_Analysis.pdf\n")
```

```{r}

# ===== HEATMAP ANALYSIS WITH FILTERED OBJECT =====

# Load required library
library(pheatmap)

# ---- 1) Sanity checks ----
if (!"cellset" %in% colnames(filtered_lung_seurat@meta.data)) {
  stop("filtered_lung_seurat@meta.data$cellset not found (expected: 'EC' or 'Immune').")
}
cells_use <- colnames(filtered_lung_seurat)[filtered_lung_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# ---- 2) Gene panel (same as yours, with FABP4 added) ----
genes_ec_lec   <- c("PROX1","LYVE1","PDPN","FLT4","CCL21","VEGFC")
genes_ec_art   <- c("FABP4","GJA5","EFNB2","DLL4","SOX17","HEY2")
genes_ec_ven   <- c("NR2F2","EPHB4")
genes_ec_core  <- c("PECAM1","CDH5","VWF","KDR","CLDN5","EMCN","ESAM")
genes_immune   <- c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD8A","CD4","NKG7","MS4A1","MRC1","CD163","LYZ","FCGR3A","MS4A7","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1","HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1","CD68")
genes_panel    <- unique(c(genes_ec_lec, genes_ec_art, genes_ec_ven, genes_ec_core, genes_immune))

# ---- 3) Pull normalized data (Seurat v4/v5 safe) ----
## --- Pull normalized data safely (Seurat v4/v5, memory-safe) ---
assay_use <- DefaultAssay(filtered_lung_seurat)

# Keep available genes, preserve intended order (use your own 'genes_panel')
genes_avail <- genes_panel[genes_panel %in% rownames(filtered_lung_seurat[[assay_use]])]
if (length(genes_avail) == 0) stop("None of the chosen genes are present in the assay rows.")

# Cells to use (your code)
cells_use <- colnames(filtered_lung_seurat)[filtered_lung_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# v5 layered assay? -> use FetchData with layer="data" to pull ONLY those genes
if (inherits(filtered_lung_seurat[[assay_use]], "Assay5")) {
  # This returns a data.frame: rows = cells, cols = requested genes
  df <- FetchData(
    object = filtered_lung_seurat,
    vars   = genes_avail,
    cells  = cells_use,
    layer  = "data"          # <-- crucial: no JoinLayers needed
  )
  # Convert to genes x cells matrix
  M <- t(as.matrix(df[, genes_avail, drop = FALSE]))
} else {
  # Seurat v4: grab sparse matrix, then subset to genes/cells
  mat <- GetAssayData(filtered_lung_seurat, assay = assay_use, slot = "data")
  # subset BEFORE turning into dense
  M <- as.matrix(mat[genes_avail, cells_use, drop = FALSE])
}

## --- Row Z-score; clip for contrast (unchanged logic) ---
row_means <- rowMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE)
row_sds   <- sqrt(pmax(rowMeans((M - row_means)^2), 0))
row_sds[row_sds == 0 | !is.finite(row_sds)] <- 1
z <- (M - row_means) / row_sds
z[z >  2.5] <-  2.5
z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0

# ---- 4) Order columns EC → Immune, add a visual gap ----
ct <- factor(filtered_lung_seurat$cellset[cells_use], levels = c("EC","Immune"))
ord <- order(ct, na.last = TRUE)
z_ord  <- z[, ord, drop = FALSE]
ct_ord <- droplevels(ct[ord])
gap_at <- if (length(unique(ct_ord)) == 2) sum(ct_ord == "EC") else NULL

anno_col <- data.frame(`Cell type` = ct_ord)
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(z_ord)
anno_colors <- list(`Cell type` = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4"))

# ---- 5) Colors (yellow -> white -> purple) ----

# ---- 6) Print summary before plotting ----
cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY (FILTERED OBJECT) ===\n")
cat("Total cells used:", length(cells_use), "\n")
cat("EC cells:", sum(ct_ord == "EC"), "\n")
cat("Immune cells:", sum(ct_ord == "Immune"), "\n")
cat("Genes available:", length(genes_avail), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail), "\n")
if (length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail) > 0) {
  missing_genes <- genes_panel[!genes_panel %in% genes_avail]
  cat("Missing gene names:", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ---- 7) Plot ----
heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
  z_ord,
  color              = cols,
  breaks             = breaks,
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,
  cluster_cols       = FALSE,
  show_colnames      = FALSE,
  show_rownames      = TRUE,
  fontsize_row       = 9,
  border_color       = NA,
  annotation_col     = anno_col,
  annotation_colors  = anno_colors,
  gaps_col           = gap_at,
  main               = "Expression (Z-score) - Filtered Clusters",
  legend_breaks      = c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  legend_labels      = c("-2.5", "0", "2.5"),
  use_raster         = TRUE  # crisper & more forgiving on some devices
)

# ---- 9) Optional: Create gene category annotations for better visualization ----
# Create row annotation to show gene categories
gene_categories <- data.frame(
  Gene_Type = c(
    rep("LEC", length(genes_ec_lec[genes_ec_lec %in% genes_avail])),
```

```{r}
# ===== DOUBLET DETECTION AND CELL TYPE PURIFICATION =====

# Install and load doublet detection packages if needed
# BiocManager::install("scDblFinder")
library(scDblFinder)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

# ===== SEURAT V5 COMPATIBLE DOUBLET AND QUALITY CONTROL =====

# Alternative approach without SingleCellExperiment conversion
# This uses Seurat-native functions that work better with v5

# ===== 1) Calculate quality metrics =====
# Add mitochondrial gene percentage (if not already present)
if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(filtered_lung_seurat@meta.data)) {
  filtered_lung_seurat[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(filtered_lung_seurat, pattern = "^MT-")
}

# Add ribosomal gene percentage
filtered_lung_seurat[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(filtered_lung_seurat, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

# Add hemoglobin gene percentage (potential doublet indicator)
filtered_lung_seurat[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(filtered_lung_seurat, pattern = "^HB[^(P)]")

# ===== 2) Simple doublet detection based on quality metrics =====
# High gene count + high UMI count often indicates doublets
# Calculate doublet score based on multiple metrics

# Z-score normalize the metrics
filtered_lung_seurat$nFeature_RNA_z <- scale(filtered_lung_seurat$nFeature_RNA)[,1]
filtered_lung_seurat$nCount_RNA_z <- scale(filtered_lung_seurat$nCount_RNA)[,1]

# Simple doublet score (high gene count + high UMI count)
filtered_lung_seurat$doublet_score_simple <- filtered_lung_seurat$nFeature_RNA_z + filtered_lung_seurat$nCount_RNA_z

# Flag potential doublets (top 5% of doublet scores)
doublet_threshold <- quantile(filtered_lung_seurat$doublet_score_simple, 0.95)
filtered_lung_seurat$is_doublet <- filtered_lung_seurat$doublet_score_simple > doublet_threshold

# ===== 3) Calculate gene signature scores =====
# Immune genes that are present in the dataset
immune_genes_all <- c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD8A","CD4","NKG7","MS4A1","MRC1","CD163",
                     "LYZ","FCGR3A","MS4A7","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1","HLA-DPA1",
                     "HLA-DPB1","CD68")
immune_genes_available <- immune_genes_all[immune_genes_all %in% rownames(filtered_lung_seurat)]

# EC genes that are present in the dataset
ec_genes_all <- c("PECAM1","CDH5","VWF","KDR","CLDN5","EMCN","ESAM")
ec_genes_available <- ec_genes_all[ec_genes_all %in% rownames(filtered_lung_seurat)]

cat("Immune genes available:", length(immune_genes_available), "out of", length(immune_genes_all), "\n")
cat("EC genes available:", length(ec_genes_available), "out of", length(ec_genes_all), "\n")

# Calculate module scores using Seurat v5 compatible method
filtered_lung_seurat <- AddModuleScore(filtered_lung_seurat,
                                      features = list(immune_genes_available),
                                      name = "Immune_Score")

filtered_lung_seurat <- AddModuleScore(filtered_lung_seurat,
                                      features = list(ec_genes_available),
                                      name = "EC_Score")

# ===== 4) Identify problematic cells =====
# Get cell identifiers
ec_cells <- WhichCells(filtered_lung_seurat, expression = cellset == "EC")
immune_cells <- WhichCells(filtered_lung_seurat, expression = cellset == "Immune")

# Calculate thresholds for contamination
# Use 90th percentile to be more stringent
pure_ec_immune_threshold <- quantile(filtered_lung_seurat$Immune_Score1[ec_cells], 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
pure_immune_ec_threshold <- quantile(filtered_lung_seurat$EC_Score1[immune_cells], 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)

# Flag problematic cells
filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_EC <- (filtered_lung_seurat$cellset == "EC" &
                                       filtered_lung_seurat$Immune_Score1 > pure_ec_immune_threshold)

filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_Immune <- (filtered_lung_seurat$cellset == "Immune" &
                                           filtered_lung_seurat$EC_Score1 > pure_immune_ec_threshold)

# ===== 5) Summary statistics =====
cat("\n=== CELL QUALITY SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total cells:", ncol(filtered_lung_seurat), "\n")
cat("Predicted doublets (top 5% by complexity):", sum(filtered_lung_seurat$is_doublet, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Problematic EC cells (high immune score):", sum(filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_EC, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Problematic Immune cells (high EC score):", sum(filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_Immune, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Print score thresholds
cat("EC immune contamination threshold:", round(pure_ec_immune_threshold, 3), "\n")
cat("Immune EC contamination threshold:", round(pure_immune_ec_threshold, 3), "\n")

# ===== 6) Create diagnostic plots =====
# Plot doublet scores
doublet_plot <- FeaturePlot(filtered_lung_seurat, features = "doublet_score_simple",
                           reduction = "umap") +
                           ggtitle("Simple Doublet Score (nGenes + nUMIs)")

# Plot quality metrics
nfeature_plot <- FeaturePlot(filtered_lung_seurat, features = "nFeature_RNA",
                            reduction = "umap") +
                            ggtitle("Number of Genes")

ncount_plot <- FeaturePlot(filtered_lung_seurat, features = "nCount_RNA",
                          reduction = "umap") +
                          ggtitle("Number of UMIs")

# Plot module scores
immune_score_plot <- FeaturePlot(filtered_lung_seurat, features = "Immune_Score1",
                                reduction = "umap") +
                                ggtitle("Immune Gene Signature Score")

ec_score_plot <- FeaturePlot(filtered_lung_seurat, features = "EC_Score1",
                            reduction = "umap") +
                            ggtitle("EC Gene Signature Score")

# Create quality classification
filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality <- "Good"
filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality[filtered_lung_seurat$is_doublet] <- "Doublet"
filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality[filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_EC] <- "Contaminated_EC"
filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality[filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_Immune] <- "Contaminated_Immune"

filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality <- factor(filtered_lung_seurat$cell_quality,
                                           levels = c("Good", "Doublet", "Contaminated_EC", "Contaminated_Immune"))

quality_plot <- DimPlot(filtered_lung_seurat, group.by = "cell_quality",
                       reduction = "umap",
                       cols = c("Good" = "lightgray", "Doublet" = "black",
                               "Contaminated_EC" = "#FFA500", "Contaminated_Immune" = "#9370DB")) +
                       ggtitle("Cell Quality Assessment")

print(doublet_plot)
print(nfeature_plot)
print(ncount_plot)
print(immune_score_plot)
print(ec_score_plot)
print(quality_plot)

# ===== 7) Create clean object =====
# Remove problematic cells
cells_to_remove <- filtered_lung_seurat$is_doublet |
                   filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_EC |
                   filtered_lung_seurat$problematic_Immune

cells_to_keep <- !cells_to_remove
clean_lung_seurat <- subset(filtered_lung_seurat, cells = colnames(filtered_lung_seurat)[cells_to_keep])

cat("\n=== CLEANING RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Original filtered cells:", ncol(filtered_lung_seurat), "\n")
cat("Clean cells:", ncol(clean_lung_seurat), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", sum(cells_to_remove, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round((ncol(clean_lung_seurat)/ncol(filtered_lung_seurat))*100, 1), "%\n")

# ===== 8) Plot clean results =====
clean_celltype_plot <- DimPlot(clean_lung_seurat, group.by = "cellset", reduction = "umap",
                               cols = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
                               ggtitle("Clean UMAP: Endothelial vs Immune Cells") +
                               theme_minimal()

print(clean_celltype_plot)

# ===== 9) Save everything =====
saveRDS(clean_lung_seurat, file = "GSE159354_Clean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

# Save all diagnostic plots
pdf("Cell_Quality_Diagnostics_v5.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
print(doublet_plot)
print(nfeature_plot)
print(ncount_plot)
print(immune_score_plot)
print(ec_score_plot)
print(quality_plot)
print(clean_celltype_plot)
dev.off()

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Clean object saved: GSE159354_Clean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds\n")
cat("Diagnostic plots saved: Cell_Quality_Diagnostics_v5.pdf\n")
cat("Use 'clean_lung_seurat' for your heatmap analysis!\n")
```

```{r}
## --- Pull normalized data safely (Seurat v4/v5, memory-safe) ---

genes_avail <- genes_panel[genes_panel %in% rownames(clean_lung_seurat[[assay_use]])]
if (length(genes_avail) == 0) stop("None of the chosen genes are present in the assay rows.")

# Cells to use (your code)

# v5 layered assay? -> use FetchData with layer="data" to pull ONLY those genes
if (inherits(clean_lung_seurat[[assay_use]], "Assay5")) {
  # This returns a data.frame: rows = cells, cols = requested genes
  df <- FetchData(
    object = clean_lung_seurat,
    vars   = genes_avail,
    cells  = cells_use,
    layer  = "data"          # <-- crucial: no JoinLayers needed
  )
  # Convert to genes x cells matrix
  M <- t(as.matrix(df[, genes_avail, drop = FALSE]))
} else {
  # Seurat v4: grab sparse matrix, then subset to genes/cells
  mat <- GetAssayData(clean_lung_seurat, assay = assay_use, slot = "data")
  # subset BEFORE turning into dense
  M <- as.matrix(mat[genes_avail, cells_use, drop = FALSE])
}

## --- Row Z-score; clip for contrast (unchanged logic) ---
row_means <- rowMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE)
row_sds   <- sqrt(pmax(rowMeans((M - row_means)^2), 0))
row_sds[row_sds == 0 | !is.finite(row_sds)] <- 1
z <- (M - row_means) / row_sds
z[z >  2.5] <-  2.5
z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0

}
```

```{r}
macrophage_genes_available <- macrophage_genes[macrophage_genes %in% rownames(clean_lung_seurat)]

# Add specific macrophage score
clean_lung_seurat <- AddModuleScore(clean_lung_seurat,
                                   features = list(macrophage_genes_available),
                                   name = "Macrophage_Score")

# ===== 2) More stringent contamination detection =====
ec_cells <- WhichCells(clean_lung_seurat, expression = cellset == "EC")
immune_cells <- WhichCells(clean_lung_seurat, expression = cellset == "Immune")

# Use 95th percentile for general immune score, 99th for macrophage score
stringent_immune_threshold <- quantile(clean_lung_seurat$Immune_Score1[ec_cells], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
stringent_macro_threshold <- quantile(clean_lung_seurat$Macrophage_Score1[ec_cells], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

# Also check for high individual gene expression of key contaminants
individual_gene_contamination <- list()

for (gene in c("MRC1", "CD163", "CD68")) {
  if (gene %in% rownames(clean_lung_seurat)) {
    gene_expr <- FetchData(clean_lung_seurat, vars = gene, cells = ec_cells)
    threshold_99 <- quantile(gene_expr[[gene]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    individual_gene_contamination[[gene]] <- ec_cells[gene_expr[[gene]] > threshold_99]
    cat("EC cells with high", gene, "expression:", length(individual_gene_contamination[[gene]]), "\n")
  }
}

# ===== 3) Flag highly contaminated EC cells =====
highly_contaminated_EC <- unique(c(
  # High general immune score
  ec_cells[clean_lung_seurat$Immune_Score1[ec_cells] > stringent_immune_threshold],
  # High macrophage score
  ec_cells[clean_lung_seurat$Macrophage_Score1[ec_cells] > stringent_macro_threshold],
  # High individual gene expression
  unlist(individual_gene_contamination)
))

# Also flag immune cells with high EC scores (more stringent)
stringent_ec_threshold <- quantile(clean_lung_seurat$EC_Score1[immune_cells], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
highly_contaminated_Immune <- immune_cells[clean_lung_seurat$EC_Score1[immune_cells] > stringent_ec_threshold]

cat("\n=== STRINGENT CONTAMINATION DETECTION ===\n")
cat("Highly contaminated EC cells:", length(highly_contaminated_EC), "\n")
cat("Highly contaminated Immune cells:", length(highly_contaminated_Immune), "\n")

# ===== 4) Visualize the most problematic cells =====
# Mark the cells we're about to remove
clean_lung_seurat$stringent_quality <- "Clean"
clean_lung_seurat$stringent_quality[highly_contaminated_EC] <- "Contaminated_EC"
clean_lung_seurat$stringent_quality[highly_contaminated_Immune] <- "Contaminated_Immune"

stringent_quality_plot <- DimPlot(clean_lung_seurat, group.by = "stringent_quality",
                                 reduction = "umap",
                                 cols = c("Clean" = "lightgray",
                                         "Contaminated_EC" = "#FFA500",
                                         "Contaminated_Immune" = "#9370DB")) +
                                 ggtitle("Stringent Quality Assessment - Cells to Remove")

print(stringent_quality_plot)

# Plot macrophage scores
macro_score_plot <- FeaturePlot(clean_lung_seurat, features = "Macrophage_Score1",
                               reduction = "umap") +
                               ggtitle("Macrophage Gene Signature Score")

print(macro_score_plot)

# ===== 5) Create ultra-clean object =====
cells_to_remove_stringent <- c(highly_contaminated_EC, highly_contaminated_Immune)
cells_to_keep_stringent <- !colnames(clean_lung_seurat) %in% cells_to_remove_stringent

ultra_clean_seurat <- subset(clean_lung_seurat, cells = colnames(clean_lung_seurat)[cells_to_keep_stringent])

cat("\n=== ULTRA-CLEAN RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Clean object cells:", ncol(clean_lung_seurat), "\n")
cat("Ultra-clean cells:", ncol(ultra_clean_seurat), "\n")
cat("Additional cells removed:", length(cells_to_remove_stringent), "\n")
cat("Total retention from original:", round((ncol(ultra_clean_seurat)/ncol(clean_lung_seurat))*100, 1), "%\n")

# ===== 6) Alternative approach: Manual gene ratio filtering =====
# Sometimes the cleanest approach is to look at gene expression ratios

# Calculate EC:Immune gene ratio for each cell
ec_core_genes <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "KDR")[c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "KDR") %in% rownames(ultra_clean_seurat)]
immune_core_genes <- c("PTPRC", "CD68", "MRC1")[c("PTPRC", "CD68", "MRC1") %in% rownames(ultra_clean_seurat)]

cat("EC core genes found:", paste(ec_core_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Immune core genes found:", paste(immune_core_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(ec_core_genes) > 0 & length(immune_core_genes) > 0) {

  # Calculate mean expression for each cell - fixed approach
  ec_data <- FetchData(ultra_clean_seurat, vars = ec_core_genes, layer = "data")
  immune_data <- FetchData(ultra_clean_seurat, vars = immune_core_genes, layer = "data")

  # Calculate means properly
  if (length(ec_core_genes) == 1) {
    ec_mean_expr <- ec_data[[1]]
  } else {
    ec_mean_expr <- rowMeans(ec_data)
  }

  if (length(immune_core_genes) == 1) {
    immune_mean_expr <- immune_data[[1]]
  } else {
    immune_mean_expr <- rowMeans(immune_data)
  }

  # Ensure same length and same cell order
  cell_names <- intersect(names(ec_mean_expr), names(immune_mean_expr))
  ec_mean_expr <- ec_mean_expr[cell_names]
  immune_mean_expr <- immune_mean_expr[cell_names]

  # Calculate ratio (EC genes / Immune genes)
  gene_ratio <- log2((ec_mean_expr + 0.01) / (immune_mean_expr + 0.01))
  names(gene_ratio) <- cell_names

  # Add to metadata properly
  ultra_clean_seurat$EC_to_Immune_ratio <- 0  # Initialize
  ultra_clean_seurat$EC_to_Immune_ratio[cell_names] <- gene_ratio

  # Flag cells with wrong ratios for their assigned type
  ec_cells_ultra <- WhichCells(ultra_clean_seurat, expression = cellset == "EC")
  immune_cells_ultra <- WhichCells(ultra_clean_seurat, expression = cellset == "Immune")

  # EC cells should have positive ratios, immune cells negative ratios
  misassigned_ec <- ec_cells_ultra[ultra_clean_seurat$EC_to_Immune_ratio[ec_cells_ultra] < 0]
  misassigned_immune <- immune_cells_ultra[ultra_clean_seurat$EC_to_Immune_ratio[immune_cells_ultra] > 0]

  cat("\n=== GENE RATIO ANALYSIS ===\n")
  cat("EC cells with negative EC:Immune ratio:", length(misassigned_ec), "\n")
  cat("Immune cells with positive EC:Immune ratio:", length(misassigned_immune), "\n")

  # Plot the ratios
  ratio_plot <- FeaturePlot(ultra_clean_seurat, features = "EC_to_Immune_ratio",
                           reduction = "umap") +
                           ggtitle("EC:Immune Gene Expression Ratio\n(Red=More EC genes, Blue=More Immune genes)") +
                           scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0)

  print(ratio_plot)

  # Option to remove misassigned cells
  if (length(misassigned_ec) + length(misassigned_immune) < ncol(ultra_clean_seurat) * 0.05) {  # Less than 5%
    purest_seurat <- subset(ultra_clean_seurat,
                           cells = colnames(ultra_clean_seurat)[!colnames(ultra_clean_seurat) %in% c(misassigned_ec, misassigned_immune)])

    cat("Created 'purest_seurat' object with", ncol(purest_seurat), "cells\n")
  } else {
    cat("Too many misassigned cells (", length(misassigned_ec) + length(misassigned_immune),
        "out of", ncol(ultra_clean_seurat), ") - not creating purest object\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Not enough core genes found for ratio analysis\n")
}

# ===== 7) Final ultra-clean UMAP =====
ultra_clean_plot <- DimPlot(ultra_clean_seurat, group.by = "cellset", reduction = "umap",
                           cols = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
                           ggtitle("Ultra-Clean UMAP: Endothelial vs Immune Cells") +
                           theme_minimal()

print(ultra_clean_plot)

# ===== 8) Save results =====
saveRDS(ultra_clean_seurat, file = "GSE159354_UltraClean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

# Save diagnostic plots
pdf("Ultra_Clean_Diagnostics.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
print(stringent_quality_plot)
print(macro_score_plot)
if (exists("ratio_plot")) print(ratio_plot)
print(ultra_clean_plot)
dev.off()

cat("\n=== NEXT STEP ===\n")
cat("Run the heatmap code again with 'ultra_clean_seurat' object\n")
cat("This should show much cleaner separation between EC and immune signatures\n")

```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# ---- 1) Sanity checks ----
if (!"cellset" %in% colnames(ultra_clean_seurat@meta.data)) {
  stop("ultra_clean_seurat@meta.data$cellset not found (expected: 'EC' or 'Immune').")
}
cells_use <- colnames(ultra_clean_seurat)[ultra_clean_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# ---- 2) Gene panel (same as yours, with FABP4 added) ----
genes_ec_lec   <- c("PROX1","LYVE1","PDPN","FLT4","CCL21","VEGFC")
genes_ec_art   <- c("GJA5","EFNB2","DLL4","SOX17","HEY2")
genes_ec_ven   <- c("NR2F2","EPHB4")
genes_ec_core  <- c("PECAM1","CDH5","VWF","KDR","CLDN5","EMCN","ESAM")
genes_immune   <- c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD8A","CD4","NKG7","MS4A1","MRC1","CD163","LYZ","FCGR3A","MS4A7","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1","HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1","CD68")
genes_panel    <- unique(c(genes_ec_lec, genes_ec_art, genes_ec_ven, genes_ec_core, genes_immune))

# ---- 3) Pull normalized data (Seurat v4/v5 safe) ----
## --- Pull normalized data safely (Seurat v4/v5, memory-safe) ---
assay_use <- DefaultAssay(ultra_clean_seurat)

# Keep available genes, preserve intended order (use your own 'genes_panel')
genes_avail <- genes_panel[genes_panel %in% rownames(ultra_clean_seurat[[assay_use]])]
if (length(genes_avail) == 0) stop("None of the chosen genes are present in the assay rows.")

# Cells to use (your code)
cells_use <- colnames(ultra_clean_seurat)[ultra_clean_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# v5 layered assay? -> use FetchData with layer="data" to pull ONLY those genes
if (inherits(ultra_clean_seurat[[assay_use]], "Assay5")) {
  # This returns a data.frame: rows = cells, cols = requested genes
  df <- FetchData(
    object = ultra_clean_seurat,
    vars   = genes_avail,
    cells  = cells_use,
    layer  = "data"          # <-- crucial: no JoinLayers needed
  )
  # Convert to genes x cells matrix
  M <- t(as.matrix(df[, genes_avail, drop = FALSE]))
} else {
  # Seurat v4: grab sparse matrix, then subset to genes/cells
  mat <- GetAssayData(ultra_clean_seurat, assay = assay_use, slot = "data")
  # subset BEFORE turning into dense
  M <- as.matrix(mat[genes_avail, cells_use, drop = FALSE])
}

## --- Row Z-score; clip for contrast (unchanged logic) ---
row_means <- rowMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE)
row_sds   <- sqrt(pmax(rowMeans((M - row_means)^2), 0))
row_sds[row_sds == 0 | !is.finite(row_sds)] <- 1
z <- (M - row_means) / row_sds
z[z >  2.5] <-  2.5
z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0

# ---- 4) Order columns EC → Immune, add a visual gap ----
ct <- factor(ultra_clean_seurat$cellset[cells_use], levels = c("EC","Immune"))
ord <- order(ct, na.last = TRUE)
z_ord  <- z[, ord, drop = FALSE]
ct_ord <- droplevels(ct[ord])
gap_at <- if (length(unique(ct_ord)) == 2) sum(ct_ord == "EC") else NULL

anno_col <- data.frame(`Cell type` = ct_ord)
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(z_ord)
anno_colors <- list(`Cell type` = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4"))

# ---- 5) Colors (yellow -> white -> purple) ----
breaks <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 101)
cols   <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#FDE725", "white", "#440154"))(length(breaks) - 1)

# ---- 6) Print summary before plotting ----
cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY (ULTRA-CLEAN OBJECT) ===\n")
cat("Total cells used:", length(cells_use), "\n")
cat("EC cells:", sum(ct_ord == "EC"), "\n")
cat("Immune cells:", sum(ct_ord == "Immune"), "\n")
cat("Genes available:", length(genes_avail), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail), "\n")
if (length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail) > 0) {
  missing_genes <- genes_panel[!genes_panel %in% genes_avail]
  cat("Missing gene names:", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ---- 7) Plot ----
heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
  z_ord,
  color              = cols,
  breaks             = breaks,
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,
  cluster_cols       = FALSE,
  show_colnames      = FALSE,

  fontsize_row       = 9,

  legend_breaks      = c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  legend_labels      = c("-2.5", "0", "2.5"),
  use_raster         = TRUE  # crisper & more forgiving on some devices
)

# ---- 8) Save heatmap as PDF ----
pdf("UltraClean_Expression_Heatmap.pdf", height = 10, width = 12)
pheatmap(
  z_ord,
  color              = cols,
  breaks             = breaks,
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,

  show_colnames      = FALSE,
  show_rownames      = TRUE,
  fontsize_row       = 9,

  annotation_col     = anno_col,
  annotation_colors  = anno_colors,
  gaps_col           = gap_at,
  main               = "Expression (Z-score) - Ultra-Clean Dataset",
  legend_breaks      = c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  legend_labels      = c("-2.5", "0", "2.5"),

)
dev.off()

# ---- 9) Optional: Create gene category annotations for better visualization ----

gene_categories <- data.frame(

  cat("  Overall retention:", round(((ultra_ec + ultra_immune)/(original_ec + original_immune))*100, 1), "%\n")
```

```{r}

clean_lung_seurat <- readRDS("GSE159354_Clean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

# ===== CLUSTER-BASED FILTERING APPROACH =====

# Target clusters to remove EC cells from
target_clusters <- c("1", "2", "5", "9", "13", "14")

cat("=== CLUSTER-BASED FILTERING ===\n")
cat("Target clusters for EC removal:", paste(target_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Check current cluster distribution
cat("\n--- Current cluster distribution ---\n")
cluster_table <- table(clean_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters, clean_lung_seurat$cellset)
print(cluster_table)

# Get EC cells in target clusters
ec_cells_all <- WhichCells(clean_lung_seurat, expression = cellset == "EC")
ec_cells_in_target_clusters <- WhichCells(clean_lung_seurat,
                                         expression = cellset == "EC" &
                                         seurat_clusters %in% target_clusters)

cat("\n--- EC cells analysis ---\n")
cat("Total EC cells:", length(ec_cells_all), "\n")
cat("EC cells in target clusters:", length(ec_cells_in_target_clusters), "\n")
cat("Percentage of EC cells to remove:",
    round((length(ec_cells_in_target_clusters)/length(ec_cells_all))*100, 1), "%\n")

# Break down by individual cluster
cat("\nEC cells per target cluster:\n")
for (cluster in target_clusters) {
  ec_in_cluster <- sum(clean_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters == cluster &
                       clean_lung_seurat$cellset == "EC")
  total_in_cluster <- sum(clean_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters == cluster)
  cat("  Cluster", cluster, ":", ec_in_cluster, "EC cells out of", total_in_cluster, "total\n")
}

# ===== CHECK WHAT'S IN THESE CLUSTERS =====
# Let's see what cell types are actually in these target clusters
cat("\n--- Target cluster composition ---\n")
for (cluster in target_clusters) {
  cluster_cells <- WhichCells(clean_lung_seurat, expression = seurat_clusters == cluster)
  cluster_celltype <- table(clean_lung_seurat$cellset[cluster_cells])
  cat("Cluster", cluster, "composition:", paste(names(cluster_celltype), cluster_celltype, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ===== VISUALIZE TARGET CLUSTERS =====
# Mark the target clusters on UMAP
clean_lung_seurat$cluster_filter_status <- "Keep"
clean_lung_seurat$cluster_filter_status[clean_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters %in% target_clusters] <- "Target_Cluster"

cluster_viz_plot <- DimPlot(clean_lung_seurat, group.by = "cluster_filter_status",
                           reduction = "umap",
                           cols = c("Keep" = "lightgray", "Target_Cluster" = "orange")) +
                           ggtitle("Target Clusters for EC Removal\n(Orange = Target Clusters)")

print(cluster_viz_plot)

# Show original cluster plot for reference
cluster_plot <- DimPlot(clean_lung_seurat, group.by = "seurat_clusters",
                       reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
                       ggtitle("Original Clusters (Reference)")

print(cluster_plot)

# ===== CREATE CLUSTER-FILTERED OBJECT =====
# Remove EC cells from target clusters, keep all immune cells
cells_to_remove <- ec_cells_in_target_clusters
cells_to_keep <- !colnames(clean_lung_seurat) %in% cells_to_remove

cluster_filtered_seurat <- subset(clean_lung_seurat,
                                 cells = colnames(clean_lung_seurat)[cells_to_keep])

cat("\n=== CLUSTER FILTERING RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Original clean object:", ncol(clean_lung_seurat), "cells\n")
cat("Cluster filtered object:", ncol(cluster_filtered_seurat), "cells\n")
cat("EC cells removed:", length(cells_to_remove), "\n")
cat("Retention rate:", round((ncol(cluster_filtered_seurat)/ncol(clean_lung_seurat))*100, 1), "%\n")

# Cell type breakdown
original_ec <- sum(clean_lung_seurat$cellset == "EC")
original_immune <- sum(clean_lung_seurat$cellset == "Immune")
filtered_ec <- sum(cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset == "EC")
filtered_immune <- sum(cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset == "Immune")

cat("\nCell type changes:\n")
cat("EC cells:", original_ec, "→", filtered_ec,
    "(removed:", original_ec - filtered_ec, ",",
    round(((original_ec - filtered_ec)/original_ec)*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Immune cells:", original_immune, "→", filtered_immune, "(no change)\n")

# ===== CHECK REMAINING CLUSTER DISTRIBUTION =====
cat("\n--- Remaining cluster distribution ---\n")
remaining_cluster_table <- table(cluster_filtered_seurat$seurat_clusters,
                               cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset)
print(remaining_cluster_table)

# ===== VISUALIZE RESULTS =====
# Mark what was removed
clean_lung_seurat$ec_removal_status <- ifelse(clean_lung_seurat$cellset == "EC" &
                                              clean_lung_seurat$seurat_clusters %in% target_clusters,
                                              "EC_Removed",
                                              ifelse(clean_lung_seurat$cellset == "EC", "EC_Kept", "Immune"))

removal_plot <- DimPlot(clean_lung_seurat, group.by = "ec_removal_status",
                       reduction = "umap",
                       cols = c("EC_Kept" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4", "EC_Removed" = "black")) +
                       ggtitle("Cluster-Based EC Removal\n(Black = Removed EC cells)")

print(removal_plot)

# Final clean result
final_cluster_plot <- DimPlot(cluster_filtered_seurat, group.by = "cellset",
                            reduction = "umap",
                            cols = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4")) +
                            ggtitle("Cluster-Filtered Object: EC vs Immune")

print(final_cluster_plot)

# ===== TEST FOR IMMUNE CONTAMINATION IN REMAINING EC CELLS =====
cat("\n=== CHECKING CONTAMINATION IN REMAINING EC CELLS ===\n")
remaining_ec <- WhichCells(cluster_filtered_seurat, expression = cellset == "EC")
problematic_genes <- c("MRC1", "CD163", "CD68", "LYZ")
available_genes <- problematic_genes[problematic_genes %in% rownames(cluster_filtered_seurat)]

for (gene in available_genes) {
  gene_expr <- FetchData(cluster_filtered_seurat, vars = gene, cells = remaining_ec, layer = "data")
  above_1 <- sum(gene_expr[[gene]] > 1.0)
  above_2 <- sum(gene_expr[[gene]] > 2.0)
  max_expr <- max(gene_expr[[gene]])

  cat("Gene", gene, "in remaining EC cells:\n")
  cat("  Expression > 1.0:", above_1, "/", length(remaining_ec),
      "(", round((above_1/length(remaining_ec))*100, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  Expression > 2.0:", above_2, "/", length(remaining_ec),
      "(", round((above_2/length(remaining_ec))*100, 1), "%)\n")
  cat("  Max expression:", round(max_expr, 2), "\n\n")
}

# Save the cluster-filtered object
saveRDS(cluster_filtered_seurat, file = "GSE159354_ClusterFiltered_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

# Save diagnostic plots
pdf("Cluster_Filtering_Diagnostics.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
print(cluster_viz_plot)
print(cluster_plot)
print(removal_plot)
print(final_cluster_plot)
dev.off()

cat("=== CLUSTER-BASED FILTERING COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("New object: 'cluster_filtered_seurat'\n")
cat("Saved as: GSE159354_ClusterFiltered_EC-Immune_harmony.rds\n")
cat("This approach uses clustering to identify problematic EC populations\n")
cat("Run your heatmap with this object to see if contamination is reduced!\n")
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# ---- 1) Sanity checks ----
if (!"cellset" %in% colnames(cluster_filtered_seurat@meta.data)) {
  stop("cluster_filtered_seurat@meta.data$cellset not found (expected: 'EC' or 'Immune').")
}
cells_use <- colnames(cluster_filtered_seurat)[cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# ---- 2) Gene panel (same as yours, with FABP4 added) ----
genes_ec_lec   <- c("PROX1","LYVE1","PDPN","FLT4","CCL21","VEGFC")
genes_ec_art   <- c("GJA5","EFNB2","DLL4","SOX17","HEY2")
genes_ec_ven   <- c("NR2F2","EPHB4")
genes_ec_core  <- c("PECAM1","CDH5","VWF","KDR","CLDN5","EMCN","ESAM")
genes_immune   <- c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD8A","CD4","NKG7","MS4A1","MRC1","CD163","LYZ","FCGR3A","MS4A7","HLA-DRA","HLA-DRB1","HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1","CD68")
genes_panel    <- unique(c(genes_ec_lec, genes_ec_art, genes_ec_ven, genes_ec_core, genes_immune))

# ---- 3) Pull normalized data (Seurat v4/v5 safe) ----
## --- Pull normalized data safely (Seurat v4/v5, memory-safe) ---
assay_use <- DefaultAssay(cluster_filtered_seurat)

# Keep available genes, preserve intended order (use your own 'genes_panel')
genes_avail <- genes_panel[genes_panel %in% rownames(cluster_filtered_seurat[[assay_use]])]
if (length(genes_avail) == 0) stop("None of the chosen genes are present in the assay rows.")

# Cells to use (your code)
cells_use <- colnames(cluster_filtered_seurat)[cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset %in% c("EC","Immune")]
stopifnot(length(cells_use) > 0)

# v5 layered assay? -> use FetchData with layer="data" to pull ONLY those genes
if (inherits(cluster_filtered_seurat[[assay_use]], "Assay5")) {
  # This returns a data.frame: rows = cells, cols = requested genes
  df <- FetchData(
    object = cluster_filtered_seurat,
    vars   = genes_avail,
    cells  = cells_use,
    layer  = "data"          # <-- crucial: no JoinLayers needed
  )
  # Convert to genes x cells matrix
  M <- t(as.matrix(df[, genes_avail, drop = FALSE]))
} else {
  # Seurat v4: grab sparse matrix, then subset to genes/cells
  mat <- GetAssayData(cluster_filtered_seurat, assay = assay_use, slot = "data")
  # subset BEFORE turning into dense
  M <- as.matrix(mat[genes_avail, cells_use, drop = FALSE])
}

## --- Row Z-score; clip for contrast (unchanged logic) ---
row_means <- rowMeans(M, na.rm = TRUE)
row_sds   <- sqrt(pmax(rowMeans((M - row_means)^2), 0))
row_sds[row_sds == 0 | !is.finite(row_sds)] <- 1
z <- (M - row_means) / row_sds
z[z >  2.5] <-  2.5
z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0

# ---- 4) Order columns EC → Immune, add a visual gap ----
ct <- factor(cluster_filtered_seurat$cellset[cells_use], levels = c("EC","Immune"))
ord <- order(ct, na.last = TRUE)
z_ord  <- z[, ord, drop = FALSE]
ct_ord <- droplevels(ct[ord])
gap_at <- if (length(unique(ct_ord)) == 2) sum(ct_ord == "EC") else NULL

anno_col <- data.frame(`Cell type` = ct_ord)
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(z_ord)
anno_colors <- list(`Cell type` = c("EC" = "#E31A1C", "Immune" = "#1F78B4"))

# ---- 5) Colors (yellow -> white -> purple) ----
breaks <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 101)
cols   <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#FDE725", "white", "#440154"))(length(breaks) - 1)

# ---- 6) Print summary before plotting ----
cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY (CLUSTER-FILTERED OBJECT) ===\n")
cat("Total cells used:", length(cells_use), "\n")
cat("EC cells:", sum(ct_ord == "EC"), "\n")
cat("Immune cells:", sum(ct_ord == "Immune"), "\n")
cat("Genes available:", length(genes_avail), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail), "\n")
if (length(genes_panel) - length(genes_avail) > 0) {
  missing_genes <- genes_panel[!genes_panel %in% genes_avail]
  cat("Missing gene names:", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ---- 7) Plot ----
heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
  z_ord,
  color              = cols,
  breaks             = breaks,
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,
  cluster_cols       = FALSE,
  show_colnames      = FALSE,
  show_rownames      = TRUE,
  fontsize_row       = 9,
  border_color       = NA,
  annotation_col     = anno_col,
  annotation_colors  = anno_colors,
  gaps_col           = gap_at,
  main               = "Expression (Z-score) - Cluster-Filtered Dataset",
  legend_breaks      = c(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
  legend_labels      = c("-2.5", "0", "2.5"),
  use_raster         = TRUE  # crisper & more forgiving on some devices
)
```

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)

combined_seurat <- readRDS("GSE159354_ThreeGroup_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

# Extract only ECs into a NEW object so your existing sce_EC is untouched
sce_EC_work <- subset(combined_seurat, subset = cellset == "EC")

cat("Total ECs extracted:", ncol(sce_EC_work), "\n")
cat("EC counts by group:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_work$group))

# =============================================================================
# RE-PROCESS ECs FOR SUBCLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== RE-PROCESSING ECs FOR SUBCLUSTERING ===\n")

# Clear existing reductions
sce_EC_work@reductions <- list()

# Normalize, find variable features, scale
sce_EC_work <- NormalizeData(sce_EC_work, verbose = FALSE)
sce_EC_work <- FindVariableFeatures(sce_EC_work, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
sce_EC_work <- ScaleData(sce_EC_work, verbose = FALSE)

# Run PCA
sce_EC_work <- RunPCA(sce_EC_work, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

# Run Harmony for batch correction
sce_EC_work <- RunHarmony(sce_EC_work, group.by.vars = c("donor", "group"), verbose = FALSE)

# Run UMAP
sce_EC_work <- RunUMAP(sce_EC_work, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)

# Find neighbors and clusters
sce_EC_work <- FindNeighbors(sce_EC_work, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
sce_EC_work <- FindClusters(sce_EC_work, resolution = 0.8, verbose = FALSE)

cat("Initial EC clustering complete. Clusters found:", length(unique(Idents(sce_EC_work))), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE EC SUBTYPE MARKER GENES
# =============================================================================

# Define marker genes for each EC subtype

arterial_markers <- c("GJA5","EFNB2","DLL4","SOX17","HEY2","NOTCH4","BMX","SEMA3G")
venous_markers <- c("NR2F2","EPHB4","ACKR1","VCAM1","SELP","SELE","VWF","PLVAP")
capillary_markers <- c("CA4","EDNRB","EMCN","ESAM","KDR","RGCC","AQP1","HSPG2")
lymphatic_markers <- c("PROX1","LYVE1","PDPN","FLT4","VEGFC","CCL21","RELN","TBX1","FOXC2","NFATC1")

# =============================================================================
# EC Subtype Assignment and 6 Visualizations
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# EC Subtype Assignment and 6 Visualizations
# =============================================================================

# Define colors for groups and EC subtypes
group_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")
ec_subtype_colors <- c("ArtECs" = "#E74C3C",   # Bright red
                      "CapECs" = "#9B59B6",   # Purple
                      "VenECs" = "#27AE60",   # Green
                      "LECs" = "#F1C40F")     # Yellow

# =============================================================================
# ASSIGN EC SUBTYPES USING MODULE SCORES
# =============================================================================


# Check which markers are available
all_markers <- c(arterial_markers, venous_markers, capillary_markers, lymphatic_markers)
available_markers <- intersect(all_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
cat("Available marker genes:", length(available_markers), "out of", length(all_markers), "\n")

missing_markers <- setdiff(all_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
if(length(missing_markers) > 0) {
  cat("Missing markers:", paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Calculate module scores for each EC subtype
cat("Calculating module scores...\n")

# Arterial ECs
available_arterial <- intersect(arterial_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
if(length(available_arterial) > 0) {
  sce_EC_work <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_work, features = list(available_arterial),
                               name = "Arterial_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  cat("Arterial markers used:", paste(available_arterial, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Venous ECs
available_venous <- intersect(venous_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
if(length(available_venous) > 0) {
  sce_EC_work <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_work, features = list(available_venous),
                               name = "Venous_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  cat("Venous markers used:", paste(available_venous, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Capillary ECs
available_capillary <- intersect(capillary_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
if(length(available_capillary) > 0) {
  sce_EC_work <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_work, features = list(available_capillary),
                               name = "Capillary_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  cat("Capillary markers used:", paste(available_capillary, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Lymphatic ECs
available_lymphatic <- intersect(lymphatic_markers, rownames(sce_EC_work))
if(length(available_lymphatic) > 0) {
  sce_EC_work <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_work, features = list(available_lymphatic),
                               name = "Lymphatic_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  cat("Lymphatic markers used:", paste(available_lymphatic, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# ASSIGN EC SUBTYPES BASED ON HIGHEST MODULE SCORE
# =============================================================================

cat("Assigning EC subtypes based on highest module scores...\n")

# Get the score columns
score_columns <- grep("Score1$", colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data), value = TRUE)
cat("Score columns found:", paste(score_columns, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of score columns:", length(score_columns), "\n")

# Debug: check all column names in metadata
cat("All metadata columns containing 'Score':\n")
score_cols_all <- grep("Score", colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data), value = TRUE)
print(score_cols_all)

if(length(score_columns) > 0) {
  # Create score matrix
  score_matrix <- as.matrix(sce_EC_work@meta.data[, score_columns])
  cat("Score matrix dimensions:", dim(score_matrix), "\n")

  # Assign appropriate column names based on actual number of columns
  subtype_names <- c("ArtECs", "VenECs", "CapECs", "LECs")

  if(ncol(score_matrix) == 4) {
    colnames(score_matrix) <- subtype_names
  } else if(ncol(score_matrix) == 3) {
    colnames(score_matrix) <- subtype_names[1:3]
    cat("Warning: Only 3 module scores found, missing one subtype\n")
  } else if(ncol(score_matrix) == 2) {
    colnames(score_matrix) <- subtype_names[1:2]
    cat("Warning: Only 2 module scores found, missing two subtypes\n")
  } else {
    colnames(score_matrix) <- subtype_names[1:ncol(score_matrix)]
    cat("Warning: Unexpected number of module scores:", ncol(score_matrix), "\n")
  }

  cat("Final score matrix column names:", colnames(score_matrix), "\n")

  # Assign subtypes based on highest score
  max_scores <- apply(score_matrix, 1, which.max)
  sce_EC_work$EC_subtype <- colnames(score_matrix)[max_scores]

  cat("EC subtype assignment complete:\n")
  print(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype))

} else {
  cat("Error: No module score columns found\n")
  cat("Attempting alternative assignment based on individual marker expression...\n")

  # Fallback: use individual marker expression
  # Calculate mean expression for each marker set
  arterial_exp <- if(length(available_arterial) > 0) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(GetAssayData(sce_EC_work, slot = "data")[available_arterial, , drop=FALSE])
  } else { rep(0, ncol(sce_EC_work)) }

  venous_exp <- if(length(available_venous) > 0) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(GetAssayData(sce_EC_work, slot = "data")[available_venous, , drop=FALSE])
  } else { rep(0, ncol(sce_EC_work)) }

  capillary_exp <- if(length(available_capillary) > 0) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(GetAssayData(sce_EC_work, slot = "data")[available_capillary, , drop=FALSE])
  } else { rep(0, ncol(sce_EC_work)) }

  lymphatic_exp <- if(length(available_lymphatic) > 0) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(GetAssayData(sce_EC_work, slot = "data")[available_lymphatic, , drop=FALSE])
  } else { rep(0, ncol(sce_EC_work)) }

  # Create expression matrix
  exp_matrix <- cbind(arterial_exp, venous_exp, capillary_exp, lymphatic_exp)
  colnames(exp_matrix) <- c("ArtECs", "VenECs", "CapECs", "LECs")

  # Assign subtypes based on highest expression
  max_exp <- apply(exp_matrix, 1, which.max)
  sce_EC_work$EC_subtype <- colnames(exp_matrix)[max_exp]

  cat("Fallback EC subtype assignment complete:\n")
  print(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype))
}

# Set identities
Idents(sce_EC_work) <- sce_EC_work$EC_subtype

# =============================================================================
# 1. UMAP OF ALL ECs (ALL GROUPS) WITH SUBTYPES COLORED
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 1: ALL ECs, ALL GROUPS ===\n")

p1 <- DimPlot(sce_EC_work, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
              cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - All Groups (CTRL, IPF, SSc-ILD)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p1)

# =============================================================================
# 2. UMAP OF ECs FROM CTRL ONLY
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 2: ECs FROM CTRL ONLY ===\n")

sce_EC_ctrl <- subset(sce_EC_work, subset = group == "CTRL")
cat("CTRL ECs:", ncol(sce_EC_ctrl), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ctrl$EC_subtype))

p2 <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ctrl, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
              cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - CTRL Only") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p2)

# =============================================================================
# 3. UMAP OF ECs FROM IPF ONLY
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 3: ECs FROM IPF ONLY ===\n")

sce_EC_ipf <- subset(sce_EC_work, subset = group == "IPF")
cat("IPF ECs:", ncol(sce_EC_ipf), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ipf$EC_subtype))

p3 <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ipf, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
              cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - IPF Only") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p3)

# =============================================================================
# 4. UMAP OF ECs FROM SSc-ILD ONLY
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 4: ECs FROM SSc-ILD ONLY ===\n")

sce_EC_ssc <- subset(sce_EC_work, subset = group == "SSc-ILD")
cat("SSc-ILD ECs:", ncol(sce_EC_ssc), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ssc$EC_subtype))

p4 <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ssc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
              cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - SSc-ILD Only") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p4)

# =============================================================================
# 5. UMAP OF ECs FROM DISEASED (IPF + SSc-ILD)
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 5: ECs FROM DISEASED (IPF + SSc-ILD) ===\n")

sce_EC_diseased <- subset(sce_EC_work, subset = group %in% c("IPF", "SSc-ILD"))
cat("Diseased ECs:", ncol(sce_EC_diseased), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_diseased$EC_subtype))

p5 <- DimPlot(sce_EC_diseased, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
              cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Diseased (IPF + SSc-ILD)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p5)

# =============================================================================
# 6. BAR GRAPH SHOWING PROPORTION OF EC SUBTYPES BY SAMPLE GROUP
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATION 6: PROPORTION BAR GRAPH ===\n")

# Create cross-tabulation of EC subtype vs group
proportion_data <- table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype, sce_EC_work$group)
cat("EC subtype composition by group:\n")
print(proportion_data)

# Convert to proportions within each EC subtype
proportion_matrix <- prop.table(proportion_data, margin = 1)
cat("Proportions within each EC subtype:\n")
print(round(proportion_matrix, 3))

# Convert to long format for plotting
proportion_df <- as.data.frame(proportion_matrix)
colnames(proportion_df) <- c("EC_Subtype", "Group", "Proportion")

# Create the bar graph
p6 <- ggplot(proportion_df, aes(x = EC_Subtype, y = Proportion, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of Sample Groups within Each EC Subtype",
       x = "EC Subtype", y = "Proportion", fill = "Sample Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

print(p6)

# Alternative version with bars side by side (dodged)
p6_dodged <- ggplot(proportion_df, aes(x = EC_Subtype, y = Proportion, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of Sample Groups within Each EC Subtype (Side-by-Side)",
       x = "EC Subtype", y = "Proportion", fill = "Sample Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

print(p6_dodged)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE COMBINED LAYOUTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING COMBINED LAYOUTS ===\n")

# Layout 1: All individual UMAPs
combined_umaps <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / (p5 + p6)
print(combined_umaps)

# Layout 2: UMAPs only
umaps_only <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / p5
print(umaps_only)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== EC SUBTYPE ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total ECs analyzed:", ncol(sce_EC_work), "\n")
cat("EC subtypes identified:", paste(unique(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Detailed breakdown by group
cat("\nDetailed breakdown by group:\n")
for(group in c("CTRL", "IPF", "SSc-ILD")) {
  group_ecs <- subset(sce_EC_work, subset = group == group)
  cat("\n", group, ":\n")
  cat("  Total ECs:", ncol(group_ecs), "\n")
  group_table <- table(group_ecs$EC_subtype)
  for(subtype in names(group_table)) {
    cat("  ", subtype, ":", group_table[subtype], "\n")
  }
}

# Overall proportions
cat("\nOverall EC subtype proportions:\n")
overall_props <- prop.table(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype))
print(round(overall_props, 3))

# =============================================================================
# SAVE ALL RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING ALL VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Save the processed EC object
saveRDS(sce_EC_work, "EC_subtypes_assigned_all_groups.rds")

# Save individual plots
ggsave("1_EC_Subtypes_All_Groups_UMAP.pdf", p1, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("2_EC_Subtypes_CTRL_Only_UMAP.pdf", p2, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("3_EC_Subtypes_IPF_Only_UMAP.pdf", p3, width = 10, height = 8)

ggsave("5_EC_Subtypes_Diseased_Only_UMAP.pdf", p5, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("6_EC_Subtypes_Proportions_Stacked_Bar.pdf", p6, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("6_EC_Subtypes_Proportions_Dodged_Bar.pdf", p6_dodged, width = 10, height = 8)

# Save combined layouts
ggsave("EC_Subtypes_All_Visualizations_Combined.pdf", combined_umaps, width = 16, height = 18)
ggsave("EC_Subtypes_UMAPs_Only_Combined.pdf", umaps_only, width = 16, height = 12)

# Save data tables
write.csv(proportion_data, "EC_subtype_counts_by_group.csv")
write.csv(proportion_matrix, "EC_subtype_proportions_by_group.csv")

# Save summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  EC_Subtype = names(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype)),
  Total_Cells = as.numeric(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype)),
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)

  cat("Using 'seurat_clusters' for cluster numbers\n")

  cluster_column <- "RNA_snn_res.0.8"
  cat("Using 'RNA_snn_res.0.8' for cluster numbers\n")
} else {
  # Find the first available clustering resolution
  res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res\\.", colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  if(length(res_cols) > 0) {
    cluster_column <- res_cols[1]

}

  ggtitle("EC Clusters - All Groups (CTRL, IPF, SSc-ILD)") +

                      "VenECs" = "#27AE60", "LECs" = "#F1C40F")

                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 0.8) +

# =============================================================================
# CLUSTER-SUBTYPE MAPPING TABLE
# =============================================================================

cat("\nCluster to EC subtype mapping:\n")
cluster_subtype_table <- table(sce_EC_work@meta.data[[cluster_column]],
                              sce_EC_work$EC_subtype)
print(cluster_subtype_table)

# Show which cluster each subtype predominantly comes from
cat("\nPredominant cluster for each EC subtype:\n")
subtype_clusters <- apply(cluster_subtype_table, 2, function(x) {
  cluster_name <- rownames(cluster_subtype_table)[which.max(x)]
  max_count <- max(x)
  total_count <- sum(x)
  percentage <- round(100 * max_count / total_count, 1)
  return(paste0("Cluster ", cluster_name, " (", max_count, "/", total_count, " = ", percentage, "%)"))
})

for(subtype in names(subtype_clusters)) {
  cat(subtype, ":", subtype_clusters[subtype], "\n")
}
```
