```{r}

sce_EC_work <- readRDS("EC_subtypes_assigned_all_groups.rds")

# =============================================================================
# EC ANALYSIS - FILTERED CLUSTERS ONLY (0,1,2,3,6,7,10,20)
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Define colors
group_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")
ec_subtype_colors <- c("ArtECs" = "#E74C3C", "CapECs" = "#9B59B6",
                      "VenECs" = "#27AE60", "LECs" = "#F1C40F")

# =============================================================================
# 1. IDENTIFY AND FILTER CLUSTERS
# =============================================================================

cat("=== FILTERING TO KEEP ONLY SPECIFIC CLUSTERS ===\n")

# Clusters to keep
clusters_to_keep <- c("0", "1", "2", "3", "6", "7", "10", "20")
cat("Clusters to keep:", paste(clusters_to_keep, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Identify the clustering column to use
if("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data)) {
  cluster_column <- "seurat_clusters"
} else if("RNA_snn_res.0.8" %in% colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data)) {
  cluster_column <- "RNA_snn_res.0.8"
} else {
  res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res\\.", colnames(sce_EC_work@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  cluster_column <- res_cols[1]
}

cat("Using clustering column:", cluster_column, "\n")

# Check which clusters exist in the data
existing_clusters <- unique(as.character(sce_EC_work@meta.data[[cluster_column]]))
cat("Existing clusters:", paste(sort(existing_clusters), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Find which requested clusters actually exist
available_clusters <- intersect(clusters_to_keep, existing_clusters)
missing_clusters <- setdiff(clusters_to_keep, existing_clusters)

cat("Available clusters to keep:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if(length(missing_clusters) > 0) {
  cat("Missing clusters (not in data):", paste(missing_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Filter the data to keep only specified clusters
cat("Filtering data...\n")
cells_to_keep <- sce_EC_work@meta.data[[cluster_column]] %in% available_clusters
sce_EC_filtered <- sce_EC_work[, cells_to_keep]

cat("Original EC cells:", ncol(sce_EC_work), "\n")
cat("Filtered EC cells:", ncol(sce_EC_filtered), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", ncol(sce_EC_work) - ncol(sce_EC_filtered), "\n")

# Show cluster composition after filtering
cat("\nFiltered cluster composition:\n")
filtered_cluster_table <- table(sce_EC_filtered@meta.data[[cluster_column]])
print(filtered_cluster_table)

# =============================================================================
# 2. RE-ASSIGN EC SUBTYPES FOR FILTERED DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== RE-ASSIGNING EC SUBTYPES FOR FILTERED DATA ===\n")

# Check if EC_subtype column exists, if not, reassign
if(!"EC_subtype" %in% colnames(sce_EC_filtered@meta.data)) {
  cat("EC_subtype column not found, reassigning subtypes...\n")

  # Use the same module score approach as before
  arterial_markers <- c("GJA5","EFNB2","DLL4","SOX17","HEY2","NOTCH4","BMX","SEMA3G")
  venous_markers <- c("NR2F2","EPHB4","ACKR1","VCAM1","SELP","SELE","VWF","PLVAP")
  capillary_markers <- c("CA4","EDNRB","EMCN","ESAM","KDR","RGCC","AQP1","HSPG2")
  lymphatic_markers <- c("PROX1","LYVE1","PDPN","FLT4","VEGFC","CCL21","RELN","TBX1","FOXC2","NFATC1")

  # Calculate module scores (simplified assignment)
  available_arterial <- intersect(arterial_markers, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))
  available_venous <- intersect(venous_markers, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))
  available_capillary <- intersect(capillary_markers, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))
  available_lymphatic <- intersect(lymphatic_markers, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))

  if(length(available_arterial) > 0) {
    sce_EC_filtered <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_filtered, features = list(available_arterial), name = "Art_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  }
  if(length(available_venous) > 0) {
    sce_EC_filtered <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_filtered, features = list(available_venous), name = "Ven_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  }
  if(length(available_capillary) > 0) {
    sce_EC_filtered <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_filtered, features = list(available_capillary), name = "Cap_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  }
  if(length(available_lymphatic) > 0) {
    sce_EC_filtered <- AddModuleScore(sce_EC_filtered, features = list(available_lymphatic), name = "Lym_Score", verbose = FALSE)
  }

  # Assign subtypes based on highest score
  score_columns <- grep("Score1$", colnames(sce_EC_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  if(length(score_columns) > 0) {
    score_matrix <- as.matrix(sce_EC_filtered@meta.data[, score_columns])
    subtype_names <- c("ArtECs", "VenECs", "CapECs", "LECs")[1:ncol(score_matrix)]
    colnames(score_matrix) <- subtype_names

    max_scores <- apply(score_matrix, 1, which.max)
    sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype <- colnames(score_matrix)[max_scores]
  }
}

cat("EC subtype composition in filtered data:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype))

# =============================================================================
# 3. UMAP VISUALIZATIONS - FILTERED DATA
# =============================================================================

# Set identities
Idents(sce_EC_filtered) <- sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype

cat("\n=== CREATING UMAPS FOR FILTERED DATA ===\n")

# 1. All groups UMAP
p1_filtered <- DimPlot(sce_EC_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Filtered Clusters (All Groups)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p1_filtered)

# 2. CTRL only
sce_EC_ctrl_filtered <- subset(sce_EC_filtered, subset = group == "CTRL")
cat("CTRL ECs (filtered):", ncol(sce_EC_ctrl_filtered), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ctrl_filtered$EC_subtype))

p2_filtered <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ctrl_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Filtered Clusters (CTRL Only)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p2_filtered)

# 3. IPF only
sce_EC_ipf_filtered <- subset(sce_EC_filtered, subset = group == "IPF")
cat("IPF ECs (filtered):", ncol(sce_EC_ipf_filtered), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ipf_filtered$EC_subtype))

p3_filtered <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ipf_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Filtered Clusters (IPF Only)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p3_filtered)

# 4. SSc-ILD only
sce_EC_ssc_filtered <- subset(sce_EC_filtered, subset = group == "SSc-ILD")
cat("SSc-ILD ECs (filtered):", ncol(sce_EC_ssc_filtered), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_ssc_filtered$EC_subtype))

p4_filtered <- DimPlot(sce_EC_ssc_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Filtered Clusters (SSc-ILD Only)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p4_filtered)

# 5. Diseased (IPF + SSc-ILD)
sce_EC_diseased_filtered <- subset(sce_EC_filtered, subset = group %in% c("IPF", "SSc-ILD"))
cat("Diseased ECs (filtered):", ncol(sce_EC_diseased_filtered), "\n")
print(table(sce_EC_diseased_filtered$EC_subtype))

p5_filtered <- DimPlot(sce_EC_diseased_filtered, reduction = "umap", group.by = "EC_subtype",
                      cols = ec_subtype_colors, label = FALSE, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("EC Subtypes - Filtered Clusters (Diseased)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p5_filtered)

# =============================================================================
# 4. PERCENTAGE COMPOSITION ANALYSIS - FILTERED DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING PERCENTAGE COMPOSITION GRAPHS ===\n")

# Cross-tabulation of EC subtype vs group (filtered data)
proportion_data_filtered <- table(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype, sce_EC_filtered$group)
cat("EC subtype composition by group (filtered):\n")
print(proportion_data_filtered)

# Convert to percentages within each EC subtype
proportion_matrix_filtered <- prop.table(proportion_data_filtered, margin = 1) * 100
cat("Percentages within each EC subtype (filtered):\n")
print(round(proportion_matrix_filtered, 1))

# Convert to long format for plotting
proportion_df_filtered <- as.data.frame(proportion_matrix_filtered)
colnames(proportion_df_filtered) <- c("EC_Subtype", "Group", "Percentage")

# Stacked percentage bar plot
p6_filtered <- ggplot(proportion_df_filtered, aes(x = EC_Subtype, y = Percentage, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Sample Groups within Each EC Subtype (Filtered)",
       x = "EC Subtype", y = "Percentage", fill = "Sample Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, fontface = "bold")

print(p6_filtered)

# Dodged percentage bar plot
p6_dodged_filtered <- ggplot(proportion_df_filtered, aes(x = EC_Subtype, y = Percentage, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Sample Groups within Each EC Subtype (Side-by-Side, Filtered)",
       x = "EC Subtype", y = "Percentage", fill = "Sample Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), vjust = -0.3, size = 3)

print(p6_dodged_filtered)

# =============================================================================
# 5. COMBINED LAYOUTS - FILTERED DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING COMBINED LAYOUTS ===\n")

# All UMAPs combined
combined_umaps_filtered <- (p1_filtered + p2_filtered) / (p3_filtered + p4_filtered) / (p5_filtered + p6_filtered)
print(combined_umaps_filtered)

# UMAPs only
umaps_only_filtered <- (p1_filtered + p2_filtered) / (p3_filtered + p4_filtered) / p5_filtered
print(umaps_only_filtered)

# =============================================================================
# 6. COMPARISON: BEFORE VS AFTER FILTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== BEFORE VS AFTER FILTERING COMPARISON ===\n")

cat("Cell counts before filtering:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_work$group))
cat("EC subtype counts before filtering:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype))

cat("\nCell counts after filtering:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_filtered$group))
cat("EC subtype counts after filtering:\n")
print(table(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype))

cat("\nClusters kept:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if(length(missing_clusters) > 0) {
  cat("Requested clusters not found:", paste(missing_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# 7. SAVE ALL RESULTS - FILTERED DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING FILTERED DATA RESULTS ===\n")

# Save the filtered object
saveRDS(sce_EC_filtered, "sce_EC_filtered_clusters.rds")

# Save individual plots
ggsave("1_EC_Subtypes_All_Groups_Filtered_UMAP.pdf", p1_filtered, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("2_EC_Subtypes_CTRL_Only_Filtered_UMAP.pdf", p2_filtered, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("3_EC_Subtypes_IPF_Only_Filtered_UMAP.pdf", p3_filtered, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("4_EC_Subtypes_SSc-ILD_Only_Filtered_UMAP.pdf", p4_filtered, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("5_EC_Subtypes_Diseased_Only_Filtered_UMAP.pdf", p5_filtered, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("6_EC_Subtypes_Percentages_Stacked_Filtered.pdf", p6_filtered, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave("6_EC_Subtypes_Percentages_Dodged_Filtered.pdf", p6_dodged_filtered, width = 12, height = 8)

# Save combined layouts
ggsave("EC_Subtypes_All_Visualizations_Filtered_Combined.pdf", combined_umaps_filtered, width = 16, height = 18)
ggsave("EC_Subtypes_UMAPs_Only_Filtered_Combined.pdf", umaps_only_filtered, width = 16, height = 12)

# Save data tables
write.csv(proportion_data_filtered, "EC_subtype_counts_by_group_filtered.csv")
write.csv(proportion_matrix_filtered, "EC_subtype_percentages_by_group_filtered.csv")
write.csv(filtered_cluster_table, "EC_filtered_cluster_composition.csv")

# Create summary comparison table
comparison_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total_Cells", "CTRL_Cells", "IPF_Cells", "SSc-ILD_Cells",
            "ArtECs", "CapECs", "VenECs", "LECs"),
  Before_Filtering = c(ncol(sce_EC_work),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$group == "CTRL"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$group == "IPF"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$group == "SSc-ILD"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype == "ArtECs"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype == "CapECs"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype == "VenECs"),
                      sum(sce_EC_work$EC_subtype == "LECs")),
  After_Filtering = c(ncol(sce_EC_filtered),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$group == "CTRL"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$group == "IPF"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$group == "SSc-ILD"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype == "ArtECs"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype == "CapECs"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype == "VenECs"),
                     sum(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype == "LECs"))
)
comparison_summary$Cells_Removed <- comparison_summary$Before_Filtering - comparison_summary$After_Filtering
comparison_summary$Percent_Retained <- round(100 * comparison_summary$After_Filtering / comparison_summary$Before_Filtering, 1)

write.csv(comparison_summary, "EC_filtering_comparison_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Files saved for filtered analysis:\n")
cat("- sce_EC_filtered_clusters.rds\n")
cat("- All UMAP PDFs (1-5) with 'Filtered' in name\n")
cat("- Percentage bar plots with percentages labeled\n")
cat("- Combined layouts\n")
cat("- Data tables and comparison summary\n")

cat("\n=== FILTERED CLUSTER ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Clusters kept:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total cells retained:", ncol(sce_EC_filtered), "out of", ncol(sce_EC_work), "\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# EC FILTERED DATA PHEATMAP HEATMAP

library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)

sce_EC_filtered <- readRDS("sce_EC_filtered_clusters.rds")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE GENES AND CHECK AVAILABILITY
# =============================================================================

cat("=== PREPARING HEATMAP DATA ===\n")

# Genes from your list
heatmap_genes <- c("DKK2", "BMX", "GJA5", "EFNB2", "IGFBP3",
                   "EDNRB", "CA4", "FCN3", "BTNL9", "CX3CL1",
                   "TNFAIP3", "AKAP12", "ICAM1", "HDAC9", "ACKR1",
                   "SELP", "NRG1", "CPE", "LRRC1",
                   "POSTN", "SPRY1", "ZNF385D", "PLVAP", "INSR", "COL15A1", "MKI67", "MMRN1", "PDPN", "PROX1", "EFNA5")

cat("Total genes requested:", length(heatmap_genes), "\n")

# Check which genes are available in the filtered data
available_genes <- intersect(heatmap_genes, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))
missing_genes <- setdiff(heatmap_genes, rownames(sce_EC_filtered))

cat("Available genes:", length(available_genes), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", length(missing_genes), "\n")

if(length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Missing genes list:\n")
  for(i in 1:length(missing_genes)) {
    cat("  ", missing_genes[i], "\n")
  }
}

cat("Available genes list:\n")
for(i in 1:length(available_genes)) {
  cat("  ", available_genes[i], "\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR HEATMAP
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CALCULATING AVERAGE EXPRESSION ===\n")

# Join layers if using Seurat v5
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_EC_filtered[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_EC_filtered[["RNA"]])
}

# Calculate average expression for each combination of EC subtype and sample group
cat("Calculating average expression by EC subtype and group...\n")
avg_exp_matrix <- AverageExpression(sce_EC_filtered,
                                   features = available_genes,
                                   group.by = c("EC_subtype", "group"),
                                   slot = "data")$RNA

cat("Expression matrix dimensions:", dim(avg_exp_matrix), "\n")
cat("Column names (EC_subtype_group combinations):\n")
print(colnames(avg_exp_matrix))

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ANNOTATIONS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ANNOTATIONS ===\n")

# Extract EC subtype and group from column names
col_info <- data.frame(
  sample_name = colnames(avg_exp_matrix),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Parse column names (format: ECsubtype_group)
col_info$EC_subtype <- sub("_.*", "", col_info$sample_name)
col_info$group <- sub(".*_", "", col_info$sample_name)

cat("Parsed column information:\n")
print(col_info)

# Create annotation dataframe for pheatmap
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  row.names = col_info$sample_name,
  `Cell type` = col_info$EC_subtype,
  `Sample type` = col_info$group,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("Annotation dataframe:\n")
print(annotation_col)

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE COLORS FOR ANNOTATIONS
# =============================================================================

# Define colors for cell types (EC subtypes)
cell_type_colors <- c("ArtECs" = "#E74C3C",   # Red
                     "CapECs" = "#9B59B6",   # Purple
                     "VenECs" = "#27AE60",   # Green
                     "LECs" = "#F1C40F")     # Yellow

# Define colors for sample types
sample_type_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C",     # Green
                       "IPF" = "#FF7F00",       # Orange
                       "SSc-ILD" = "#89CFF0")   # baby blue

# Create annotation colors list
annotation_colors <- list(
  `Cell type` = cell_type_colors[names(cell_type_colors) %in% unique(annotation_col$`Cell type`)],
  `Sample type` = sample_type_colors[names(sample_type_colors) %in% unique(annotation_col$`Sample type`)]
)

cat("Annotation colors:\n")
print(annotation_colors)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE PHEATMAP HEATMAP
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING PHEATMAP HEATMAP ===\n")

# Create yellow to purple color palette (matching your reference image)
yellow_purple_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFF99", "#9370DB"))(100)

# Alternative: More similar to the attached image
# yellow_purple_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFF2CC", "#4A148C"))(100)

cat("Creating heatmap...\n")

# Create the heatmap
heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(avg_exp_matrix,
                        annotation_col = annotation_col,
                        annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
                        color = yellow_purple_colors,
                        scale = "row",  # Scale by genes (rows)
                        cluster_rows = TRUE,   # Cluster genes
                        cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Don't cluster samples (keep grouping)
                        show_rownames = TRUE,
                        show_colnames = FALSE,  # Hide column names (show in annotation instead)
                        fontsize_row = 8,
                        fontsize_col = 8,
                        main = "EC Subtype Marker Expression (Filtered Clusters)",
                        border_color = "white",
                        cellwidth = 20,
                        cellheight = 12,
                        filename = "EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap2.pdf",
                        width = 10,
                        height = 12)

# Display the heatmap
print(heatmap_plot)

# =============================================================================
# ALTERNATIVE VERSION WITH DIFFERENT CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ALTERNATIVE VERSION ===\n")

# Version with no clustering (preserve gene order from your list)
heatmap_plot_ordered <- pheatmap(avg_exp_matrix[available_genes, ],  # Use original gene order
                                annotation_col = annotation_col,
                                annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
                                color = yellow_purple_colors,
                                scale = "row",
                                cluster_rows = FALSE,  # Keep original gene order
                                cluster_cols = FALSE,
                                show_rownames = TRUE,
                                show_colnames = FALSE,
                                fontsize_row = 8,
                                fontsize_col = 8,
                                main = "EC Marker Expression - Original Gene Order (Filtered)",
                                border_color = "white",
                                cellwidth = 20,
                                cellheight = 12,
                                filename = "EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap_Ordered.pdf",
                                width = 10,
                                height = 12)

print(heatmap_plot_ordered)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE VERSION WITH ENHANCED CONTRAST
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING HIGH CONTRAST VERSION ===\n")

# More contrasting yellow-purple palette (closer to your reference image)
high_contrast_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFCC", "#8E24AA"))(100)

heatmap_plot_contrast <- pheatmap(avg_exp_matrix,
                                 annotation_col = annotation_col,
                                 annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
                                 color = high_contrast_colors,
                                 scale = "row",
                                 cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                                 show_rownames = TRUE,
                                 show_colnames = FALSE,
                                 fontsize_row = 8,
                                 main = "EC Marker Expression - High Contrast (Filtered)",
                                 border_color = "white",
                                 cellwidth = 20,
                                 cellheight = 12,
                                 filename = "EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap_HighContrast.pdf",
                                 width = 10,
                                 height = 12)

print(heatmap_plot_contrast)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Filtered data used:\n")
cat("  Total cells:", ncol(sce_EC_filtered), "\n")
cat("  EC subtypes:", paste(unique(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("  Sample groups:", paste(unique(sce_EC_filtered$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("Heatmap details:\n")
cat("  Genes plotted:", length(available_genes), "out of", length(heatmap_genes), "requested\n")
cat("  Sample combinations:", ncol(avg_exp_matrix), "\n")
cat("  Color scheme: Yellow (low) to Purple (high)\n")

# Show sample composition
cat("Sample composition:\n")
sample_composition <- table(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype, sce_EC_filtered$group)
print(sample_composition)

# =============================================================================
# SAVE ADDITIONAL DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING ADDITIONAL DATA ===\n")

# Save expression matrix
write.csv(avg_exp_matrix, "EC_filtered_heatmap_expression_matrix.csv")

# Save annotation information
write.csv(annotation_col, "EC_filtered_heatmap_annotations.csv")

# Save gene availability information
gene_availability <- data.frame(
  Gene = heatmap_genes,
  Available = heatmap_genes %in% rownames(sce_EC_filtered)
)
write.csv(gene_availability, "EC_filtered_heatmap_gene_availability.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save sample composition
write.csv(sample_composition, "EC_filtered_heatmap_sample_composition.csv")

cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("- EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap.pdf (clustered)\n")
cat("- EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap_Ordered.pdf (original gene order)\n")
cat("- EC_Filtered_Pheatmap_Heatmap_HighContrast.pdf (enhanced colors)\n")
cat("- EC_filtered_heatmap_expression_matrix.csv\n")
cat("- EC_filtered_heatmap_annotations.csv\n")
cat("- EC_filtered_heatmap_gene_availability.csv\n")
cat("- EC_filtered_heatmap_sample_composition.csv\n")

cat("\n=== PHEATMAP HEATMAP CREATION COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}

sce_EC_filtered <- readRDS("sce_EC_filtered_clusters.rds")


# =============================================================================
# LEC SUBCLUSTERING ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Define colors
group_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")

# =============================================================================
# EXTRACT LECS FROM FILTERED OBJECT
# =============================================================================

cat("=== EXTRACTING LECS FOR SUBCLUSTERING ===\n")

# Extract only LECs from the filtered object
sce_LECs <- subset(sce_EC_filtered, subset = EC_subtype == "LECs")

cat("Total LECs extracted:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("LEC counts by group:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$group))

if(ncol(sce_LECs) < 50) {
  cat("Warning: Very few LECs found. May need to check EC subtype assignments.\n")
  cat("Available EC subtypes in filtered data:\n")
  print(table(sce_EC_filtered$EC_subtype))
  stop("Insufficient LECs for subclustering")
}

# =============================================================================
# RE-PROCESS LECS FOR SUBCLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== RE-PROCESSING LECS FOR SUBCLUSTERING ===\n")

# Clear existing reductions to start fresh
sce_LECs@reductions <- list()

# Normalize data
cat("Normalizing LEC data...\n")
sce_LECs <- NormalizeData(sce_LECs, verbose = FALSE)

# Find variable features
cat("Finding variable features...\n")
sce_LECs <- FindVariableFeatures(sce_LECs, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)

# Scale data
cat("Scaling LEC data...\n")
sce_LECs <- ScaleData(sce_LECs, verbose = FALSE)

# Run PCA
cat("Running PCA...\n")
n_pcs <- min(50, ncol(sce_LECs) - 1, nrow(sce_LECs) - 1)
sce_LECs <- RunPCA(sce_LECs, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)

cat("Using", n_pcs, "principal components\n")

# Run Harmony for batch correction
cat("Running Harmony batch correction...\n")
sce_LECs <- RunHarmony(sce_LECs, group.by.vars = c("donor", "group"), verbose = FALSE)

# Run UMAP
cat("Running UMAP...\n")
sce_LECs <- RunUMAP(sce_LECs, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:min(30, n_pcs), verbose = FALSE)

# Find neighbors and clusters
cat("Finding neighbors and clusters...\n")
sce_LECs <- FindNeighbors(sce_LECs, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:min(30, n_pcs), verbose = FALSE)

# Test different resolutions to find optimal clustering
resolutions <- c(0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1)
for(res in resolutions) {
  sce_LECs <- FindClusters(sce_LECs, resolution = res, verbose = FALSE)
  n_clusters <- length(unique(Idents(sce_LECs)))
  cat("Resolution", res, ":", n_clusters, "clusters\n")
}

# Choose resolution (adjust as needed - aim for 3-8 clusters)
selected_resolution <- 0.7
sce_LECs <- FindClusters(sce_LECs, resolution = selected_resolution, verbose = FALSE)

# Rename clusters
n_clusters <- length(unique(Idents(sce_LECs)))
cluster_names <- paste0("LEC", 0:(n_clusters-1))
names(cluster_names) <- levels(Idents(sce_LECs))
sce_LECs <- RenameIdents(sce_LECs, cluster_names)
sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster <- Idents(sce_LECs)

cat("LEC subclustering complete. Found", n_clusters, "subclusters:", paste(levels(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE UMAP VISUALIZATIONS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING LEC SUBCLUSTER VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Generate distinct colors for LEC subclusters
library(RColorBrewer)
if(n_clusters <= 8) {
  lec_colors <- brewer.pal(max(3, n_clusters), "Set2")[1:n_clusters]
} else {
  lec_colors <- rainbow(n_clusters)
}
names(lec_colors) <- levels(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster)

# 1. UMAP colored by LEC subclusters
p1_lec <- DimPlot(sce_LECs, reduction = "umap", group.by = "LEC_subcluster",
                  cols = lec_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 5, pt.size = 1.2) +
  ggtitle("LEC Subclusters - All Groups") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

print(p1_lec)

# 2. UMAP colored by disease group
p2_lec <- DimPlot(sce_LECs, reduction = "umap", group.by = "group",
                  cols = group_colors, pt.size = 1.2) +
  ggtitle("LECs by Disease Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

print(p2_lec)

# 3. Split by disease group
p3_lec <- DimPlot(sce_LECs, reduction = "umap", group.by = "LEC_subcluster",
                  split.by = "group", cols = lec_colors,
                  label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 1.0, ncol = 3) +
  ggtitle("LEC Subclusters by Disease Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p3_lec)

# =============================================================================
# CLUSTER COMPOSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== LEC SUBCLUSTER COMPOSITION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Show cluster sizes
cat("LEC subcluster sizes:\n")
lec_cluster_table <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster)
print(lec_cluster_table)

# Show composition by group
cat("LEC subclusters by disease group:\n")
lec_group_table <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster, sce_LECs$group)
print(lec_group_table)

# Calculate proportions
lec_group_props <- prop.table(lec_group_table, margin = 1) * 100
cat("Percentages within each LEC subcluster:\n")
print(round(lec_group_props, 1))

# Create composition bar plot
lec_prop_df <- as.data.frame(lec_group_props)
colnames(lec_prop_df) <- c("LEC_Subcluster", "Group", "Percentage")

p4_lec <- ggplot(lec_prop_df, aes(x = LEC_Subcluster, y = Percentage, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(title = "LEC Subcluster Composition by Disease Group",
       x = "LEC Subcluster", y = "Percentage", fill = "Disease Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Percentage > 5, paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%"), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3)

print(p4_lec)

# =============================================================================
# COMBINED LAYOUTS
# =============================================================================

# Create combined layouts
combined_lec_basic <- p1_lec + p2_lec
print(combined_lec_basic)

combined_lec_full <- (p1_lec + p2_lec) / p4_lec
print(combined_lec_full)

# =============================================================================
# LYMPHATIC MARKER EXPRESSION
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== LYMPHATIC MARKER EXPRESSION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Check expression of key lymphatic markers across subclusters
lymphatic_markers <- c("PROX1", "LYVE1", "PDPN", "FLT4", "CCL21", "VEGFC")
available_lymphatic <- intersect(lymphatic_markers, rownames(sce_LECs))

cat("Available lymphatic markers:", paste(available_lymphatic, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if(length(available_lymphatic) > 0) {
  # Create feature plots for lymphatic markers
  if(length(available_lymphatic) >= 4) {
    p_markers <- FeaturePlot(sce_LECs, features = available_lymphatic[1:4],
                            ncol = 2, pt.size = 0.8)
    print(p_markers)
  } else {
    p_markers <- FeaturePlot(sce_LECs, features = available_lymphatic,
                            ncol = 2, pt.size = 0.8)
    print(p_markers)
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== LEC SUBCLUSTERING SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total LECs analyzed:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Number of LEC subclusters:", n_clusters, "\n")
cat("Subclusters:", paste(levels(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Resolution used:", selected_resolution, "\n")

# Show distribution across groups
for(group in c("CTRL", "IPF", "SSc-ILD")) {
  group_lecs <- sum(sce_LECs$group == group)
  group_pct <- round(100 * group_lecs / ncol(sce_LECs), 1)
  cat(group, "LECs:", group_lecs, "(", group_pct, "%)\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING LEC SUBCLUSTERING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save the LEC object
saveRDS(sce_LECs, "LECs_subclustered.rds")

# Save plots
ggsave("LEC_Subclusters_UMAP.pdf", p1_lec, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("LEC_by_Group_UMAP.pdf", p2_lec, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("LEC_Split_by_Group_UMAP.pdf", p3_lec, width = 15, height = 5)
ggsave("LEC_Composition_Bars.pdf", p4_lec, width = 10, height = 6)
ggsave("LEC_Combined_Basic.pdf", combined_lec_basic, width = 16, height = 8)
ggsave("LEC_Combined_Full.pdf", combined_lec_full, width = 16, height = 12)

if(exists("p_markers")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Lymphatic_Markers.pdf", p_markers, width = 12, height = 10)
}

# Save data tables
write.csv(lec_group_table, "LEC_subcluster_counts_by_group.csv")
write.csv(lec_group_props, "LEC_subcluster_percentages_by_group.csv")

# Save cluster summary
lec_summary <- data.frame(
  LEC_Subcluster = names(lec_cluster_table),
  Cell_Count = as.numeric(lec_cluster_table),
  Percentage = round(100 * as.numeric(lec_cluster_table) / sum(lec_cluster_table), 1)
)
write.csv(lec_summary, "LEC_subcluster_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("- LECs_subclustered.rds\n")
cat("- LEC_Subclusters_UMAP.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_by_Group_UMAP.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Split_by_Group_UMAP.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Composition_Bars.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Combined_Basic.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Combined_Full.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Lymphatic_Markers.pdf (if markers available)\n")
cat("- CSV files with composition data\n")

cat("\n=== LEC SUBCLUSTERING COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# LEC Signature Dotplot - New Subclusters (LEC0-LEC7) - All Groups
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD NEW LEC SUBCLUSTERED OBJECT
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading new LEC subclustered object...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

cat("New clusters in dataset:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

cat("Total cells in dataset:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups in dataset:", paste(unique(sce_LECs$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE GENE SIGNATURES
# =============================================================================

bottom_gene <- c("HIF1A")
hypoxia_genes <- c("ICAM1", "SELP", "TNFSF4", "CCL2","CXCL1","CXCL2")  # SELP and TNFSF4 right after ICAM1
vegfr3_genes  <- c("CD74")  # Removed FLT4 as it will be in the new top genes
antigen_genes <- c("HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1","HLA-DQA1","HLA-DRB1")
# New genes to replace the top 3 (will appear at the top of the plot)
new_top_genes <- c("D2C4", "PROX1", "FLT4", "TEK", "EPAS1", "S1PR1", "EBF1", "MEOX1")

# Get available genes in new order (bottom to top)
all_genes <- c(bottom_gene, hypoxia_genes, vegfr3_genes, antigen_genes, new_top_genes)
available_genes <- intersect(all_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))

cat("Available genes for signature analysis:\n")
print(available_genes)
cat("Missing genes:", setdiff(all_genes, available_genes), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE CLUSTER ORDER AND SET IDENTITIES
# =============================================================================

# Get all available clusters and sort them (should be LEC0-LEC7)
new_clusters <- sort(unique(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))
cat("Available clusters:", paste(new_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Define cluster order - should be LEC0, LEC1, LEC2, ..., LEC7
cluster_order <- new_clusters

# Set cluster identities
Idents(sce_LECs) <- sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster

cat("Using cluster order:", paste(cluster_order, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# JOIN LAYERS FOR SEURAT V5 COMPATIBILITY
# =============================================================================

# Join layers if using Seurat v5 (fixes GetAssayData error)
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE AVERAGE EXPRESSION
# =============================================================================

cat("Calculating average expression...\n")

# Calculate average expression (for scaling/color)
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(sce_LECs,
                             features = available_genes,
                             group.by = "LEC_subcluster",
                             slot = "data")$RNA

# Ensure all clusters are present in the matrix (add zeros if missing)
for(cluster in cluster_order) {
  if(!cluster %in% colnames(avg_exp)) {
    avg_exp[, cluster] <- 0
    cat("Added missing cluster:", cluster, "\n")
  }
}

# Reorder columns to match cluster_order
avg_exp <- avg_exp[, cluster_order, drop = FALSE]

# Calculate z-scores (scaled expression) per gene across clusters
avg_exp_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp)))

cat("Average expression matrix dimensions:", dim(avg_exp), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE PERCENT EXPRESSING
# =============================================================================

cat("Calculating percent expressing...\n")

# Calculate percent expressing for each gene-cluster combination
percent_exp <- matrix(0, nrow = length(available_genes), ncol = length(cluster_order))
rownames(percent_exp) <- available_genes
colnames(percent_exp) <- cluster_order

for(gene in available_genes) {
  for(cluster in cluster_order) {
    # Get cells in this cluster
    cluster_cells <- Cells(sce_LECs)[sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster == cluster]
    if(length(cluster_cells) > 0) {
      # Get expression data for this gene in these cells - using LayerData for v5 compatibility
      if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
        gene_exp <- LayerData(sce_LECs, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[gene, cluster_cells]
      } else {
        gene_exp <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[gene, cluster_cells]
      }
      # Calculate percent expressing (> 0)
      percent_exp[gene, cluster] <- sum(gene_exp > 0) / length(gene_exp) * 100
    } else {
      percent_exp[gene, cluster] <- 0
    }
  }
}

cat("Percent expressing matrix dimensions:", dim(percent_exp), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR PLOTTING
# =============================================================================

cat("Preparing plot data...\n")

# Convert to long format for plotting
plot_data_scaled <- melt(avg_exp_scaled)
plot_data_percent <- melt(percent_exp)
colnames(plot_data_scaled) <- c("Gene", "Cluster", "Scaled_Expression")
colnames(plot_data_percent) <- c("Gene", "Cluster", "Percent_Expressing")

# Merge the data
plot_data <- merge(plot_data_scaled, plot_data_percent, by = c("Gene", "Cluster"))

# Reorder factors to maintain gene and cluster order
plot_data$Gene <- factor(plot_data$Gene, levels = available_genes)
plot_data$Cluster <- factor(plot_data$Cluster, levels = cluster_order)

# Bin percent expressing into size categories (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%)
plot_data$Size_Bin <- cut(plot_data$Percent_Expressing,
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 20, 40, 60, 80, Inf),
                          labels = c("0-20%", "20-40%", "40-60%", "60-80%", "80-100%"),
                          include.lowest = TRUE)

# Map size bins to actual dot sizes
size_mapping <- c("0-20%" = 1, "20-40%" = 3, "40-60%" = 4, "60-80%" = 5, "80-100%" = 6)
plot_data$Dot_Size <- size_mapping[plot_data$Size_Bin]

cat("Plot data prepared. Rows:", nrow(plot_data), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE THE DOTPLOT
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating signature dotplot for new LEC subclusters...\n")

# Create the dot plot with brown/orange color scheme and no separators
p_signature_dotplot_new <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Cluster, y = Gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Scaled_Expression, size = Size_Bin), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#FFF5EE",   # Seashell (very light peachy)
    mid = "#FF8C00",   # Dark orange
    high = "#8B4513",  # Saddle brown
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Scaled\nExpression"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = size_mapping,
    name = "% Expressing",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black"))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "mm")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "LEC Signature Expression - New Subclusters (All Groups)",
    x = "LEC Subclusters",
    y = "Genes"
  )

# Display the plot
print(p_signature_dotplot_new)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATTING VERSIONS
# =============================================================================

# Version with better padding
p_tight_clean <- p_signature_dotplot_new +
  # add a little side padding so edge dots fit fully
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02, add = 0.35)) +
  # allow geoms to render slightly outside the panel
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  # give the outside area a bit of room
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1.2,  # Adjusted for 8 clusters
    plot.margin = margin(12, 24, 12, 24, "pt")
  )

print(p_tight_clean)

# Version with even tighter formatting - adjusted for 8 clusters
p_tighter <- p_signature_dotplot_new +
  # moderate x padding for 8 clusters
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.01, add = 0.15)) +
  # let points spill a hair outside the panel if needed
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  # adjust aspect ratio for 8 clusters
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1.5,                 # adjusted for 8 clusters
    plot.margin = margin(12, 36, 12, 36, "pt")
  )

print(p_tighter)

# =============================================================================
# DETAILED ANALYSIS OF NEW CLUSTERS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== NEW CLUSTER ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Show detailed cell counts per cluster
cat("Cells per new cluster:\n")
cluster_counts <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster)
print(cluster_counts)

# Show group composition per cluster
cat("\nGroup composition per new cluster:\n")
cluster_group_table <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster, sce_LECs$group)
print(cluster_group_table)

# Show proportions
cat("\nCluster proportions by group:\n")
cluster_group_props <- prop.table(cluster_group_table, margin = 2)
print(round(cluster_group_props, 3))

# Show which clusters are most enriched in each disease group
cat("\nCluster enrichment analysis:\n")
for(group in c("CTRL", "IPF", "SSc-ILD")) {
  group_props <- cluster_group_props[, group]
  if(length(group_props) > 0) {
    max_cluster <- names(which.max(group_props))
    cat("Most enriched in", group, ":", max_cluster, "(", round(max(group_props), 3), ")\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# GENE EXPRESSION SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== GENE EXPRESSION SUMMARY ===\n")

# Find top expressing clusters for each gene
for(gene in available_genes) {
  if(gene %in% rownames(avg_exp)) {
    max_cluster <- colnames(avg_exp)[which.max(avg_exp[gene, ])]
    max_expression <- round(avg_exp[gene, max_cluster], 3)
    cat(gene, "highest in:", max_cluster, "(", max_expression, ")\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SIGNATURE ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups included: CTRL, IPF, SSc-ILD\n")
cat("New clusters analyzed:", paste(cluster_order, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of clusters:", length(cluster_order), "\n")
cat("Genes in signature:", length(available_genes), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save the main plot
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_BrownOrange.pdf",
       p_signature_dotplot_new, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# Save the tight clean version
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_TightClean.pdf",
       p_tight_clean, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# Save the tightest version
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_Tighter.pdf",
       p_tighter, width = 9, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# Save the plot data for reference
write.csv(plot_data, "LEC_signature_plot_data_new_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save cluster composition data
write.csv(cluster_group_table, "LEC_new_cluster_composition_by_group.csv")

# Save average expression matrix
write.csv(avg_exp, "LEC_new_cluster_average_expression.csv")

# Save percent expressing matrix
write.csv(percent_exp, "LEC_new_cluster_percent_expressing.csv")

cat("Plots saved:\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_BrownOrange.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_TightClean.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_NewClusters_Tighter.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_signature_plot_data_new_clusters.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_new_cluster_composition_by_group.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_new_cluster_average_expression.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_new_cluster_percent_expressing.csv\n")

cat("\n=== NEW CLUSTERS SIGNATURE DOTPLOT ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# LEC Signature Dotplot - Reordered Subclusters (0,6,1,4,2,3/5/7 combined)
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD NEW LEC SUBCLUSTERED OBJECT
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading new LEC subclustered object...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

cat("Original clusters in dataset:\n")

cat("Total cells in dataset:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups in dataset:", paste(unique(sce_LECs$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE GENE SIGNATURES
# =============================================================================

bottom_gene <- c("HIF1A")
hypoxia_genes <- c("EPAS1", "ICAM1", "CCL2","CXCL1","CXCL2")  # SELP and TNFSF4 right after ICAM1
vegfr3_genes  <- c("CD74")  # Removed FLT4 as it will be in the new top genes
antigen_genes <- c("HLA-DPA1","HLA-DPB1", "HLA-DRB1")
# New genes to replace the top 3 (will appear at the top of the plot)
new_top_genes <- c("D2C4", "FLT4",  "EBF1")

# Get available genes in new order (bottom to top)
all_genes <- c(bottom_gene, hypoxia_genes, vegfr3_genes, antigen_genes, new_top_genes)
available_genes <- intersect(all_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))

cat("Available genes for signature analysis:\n")

cat("Missing genes:", setdiff(all_genes, available_genes), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE CLUSTER ORDER AND CREATE COMBINED CLUSTERS
# =============================================================================

# Get all available clusters and sort them (should be LEC0-LEC7)
new_clusters <- sort(unique(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))
cat("Available clusters:", paste(new_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Create a new cluster variable that combines LEC3, LEC5, LEC7
sce_LECs$LEC_reordered <- as.character(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster)
sce_LECs$LEC_reordered[sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC3", "LEC5", "LEC7")] <- "LEC3/5/7"

# Define new cluster order: 0, 6, 1, 4, 2, 3/5/7 combined
cluster_order <- c("LEC0", "LEC6", "LEC1", "LEC4", "LEC2", "LEC3/5/7")

# Set cluster identities to the reordered clusters
Idents(sce_LECs) <- sce_LECs$LEC_reordered

cat("Using reordered clusters:", paste(cluster_order, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Show how many cells are in each reordered group
cat("Cells per reordered cluster:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_reordered))

# =============================================================================
# JOIN LAYERS FOR SEURAT V5 COMPATIBILITY
# =============================================================================

# Join layers if using Seurat v5 (fixes GetAssayData error)
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE AVERAGE EXPRESSION
# =============================================================================

cat("Calculating average expression...\n")

# Calculate average expression (for scaling/color)
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(sce_LECs,
                             features = available_genes,
                             group.by = "LEC_reordered",
                             slot = "data")$RNA

# Ensure all clusters are present in the matrix (add zeros if missing)
for(cluster in cluster_order) {
  if(!cluster %in% colnames(avg_exp)) {
    avg_exp[, cluster] <- 0
    cat("Added missing cluster:", cluster, "\n")
  }
}

# Reorder columns to match cluster_order
avg_exp <- avg_exp[, cluster_order, drop = FALSE]

# Calculate z-scores (scaled expression) per gene across clusters
avg_exp_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp)))

cat("Average expression matrix dimensions:", dim(avg_exp), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE PERCENT EXPRESSING
# =============================================================================

cat("Calculating percent expressing...\n")

# Calculate percent expressing for each gene-cluster combination
percent_exp <- matrix(0, nrow = length(available_genes), ncol = length(cluster_order))
rownames(percent_exp) <- available_genes
colnames(percent_exp) <- cluster_order

for(gene in available_genes) {
  for(cluster in cluster_order) {
    # Get cells in this cluster (now using reordered clusters)
    cluster_cells <- Cells(sce_LECs)[sce_LECs$LEC_reordered == cluster]
    if(length(cluster_cells) > 0) {
      # Get expression data for this gene in these cells - using LayerData for v5 compatibility
      if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
        gene_exp <- LayerData(sce_LECs, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[gene, cluster_cells]
      } else {
        gene_exp <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[gene, cluster_cells]
      }
      # Calculate percent expressing (> 0)
      percent_exp[gene, cluster] <- sum(gene_exp > 0) / length(gene_exp) * 100
    } else {
      percent_exp[gene, cluster] <- 0
    }
  }
}

cat("Percent expressing matrix dimensions:", dim(percent_exp), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR PLOTTING
# =============================================================================

cat("Preparing plot data...\n")

# Convert to long format for plotting
plot_data_scaled <- melt(avg_exp_scaled)
plot_data_percent <- melt(percent_exp)
colnames(plot_data_scaled) <- c("Gene", "Cluster", "Scaled_Expression")
colnames(plot_data_percent) <- c("Gene", "Cluster", "Percent_Expressing")

# Merge the data
plot_data <- merge(plot_data_scaled, plot_data_percent, by = c("Gene", "Cluster"))

# Reorder factors to maintain gene and cluster order
plot_data$Gene <- factor(plot_data$Gene, levels = available_genes)
plot_data$Cluster <- factor(plot_data$Cluster, levels = cluster_order)

# Bin percent expressing into size categories (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%)
plot_data$Size_Bin <- cut(plot_data$Percent_Expressing,
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 20, 40, 60, 80, Inf),
                          labels = c("0-20%", "20-40%", "40-60%", "60-80%", "80-100%"),
                          include.lowest = TRUE)

# Map size bins to actual dot sizes
size_mapping <- c("0-20%" = 1, "20-40%" = 3, "40-60%" = 4, "60-80%" = 5, "80-100%" = 6)
plot_data$Dot_Size <- size_mapping[plot_data$Size_Bin]

cat("Plot data prepared. Rows:", nrow(plot_data), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE THE DOTPLOT
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating signature dotplot for reordered LEC subclusters...\n")

# Create the dot plot with brown/orange color scheme and no separators
p_signature_dotplot_new <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Cluster, y = Gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Scaled_Expression, size = Size_Bin), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#FFF5EE",   # Seashell (very light peachy)
    mid = "#FF8C00",   # Dark orange
    high = "#8B4513",  # Saddle brown
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Scaled\nExpression"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = size_mapping,
    name = "% Expressing",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black"))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "mm")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "LEC Signature Expression - Reordered Clusters (0,6,1,4,2,3/5/7)",
    x = "LEC Subclusters",
    y = "Genes"
  )

# Display the plot
print(p_signature_dotplot_new)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATTING VERSIONS
# =============================================================================

# Version with better padding
p_tight_clean <- p_signature_dotplot_new +
  # add a little side padding so edge dots fit fully
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.02, add = 0.35)) +
  # allow geoms to render slightly outside the panel
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  # give the outside area a bit of room
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1.8,  # Adjusted for 6 columns instead of 8
    plot.margin = margin(12, 24, 12, 24, "pt")
  )

print(p_tight_clean)

# Version with even tighter formatting - adjusted for 8 clusters
p_tighter <- p_signature_dotplot_new +
  # moderate x padding for 8 clusters
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.01, add = 0.15)) +
  # let points spill a hair outside the panel if needed
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  # adjust aspect ratio for 6 clusters
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 2.0,                 # adjusted for 6 columns
    plot.margin = margin(12, 36, 12, 36, "pt")
  )

print(p_tighter)

# =============================================================================
# DETAILED ANALYSIS OF REORDERED CLUSTERS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== REORDERED CLUSTER ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Show detailed cell counts per reordered cluster
cat("Cells per reordered cluster:\n")
cluster_counts <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_reordered)
print(cluster_counts)

# Show original cluster composition in the combined group
cat("\nOriginal clusters combined into LEC3/5/7:\n")
combined_original <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster[sce_LECs$LEC_reordered == "LEC3/5/7"])
print(combined_original)

# Show group composition per reordered cluster
cat("\nGroup composition per reordered cluster:\n")
cluster_group_table <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_reordered, sce_LECs$group)
print(cluster_group_table)

# Show proportions
cat("\nReordered cluster proportions by group:\n")
cluster_group_props <- prop.table(cluster_group_table, margin = 2)
print(round(cluster_group_props, 3))

# Show which clusters are most enriched in each disease group
cat("\nCluster enrichment analysis (reordered):\n")
for(group in c("CTRL", "IPF", "SSc-ILD")) {
  group_props <- cluster_group_props[, group]
  if(length(group_props) > 0) {
    max_cluster <- names(which.max(group_props))
    cat("Most enriched in", group, ":", max_cluster, "(", round(max(group_props), 3), ")\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# GENE EXPRESSION SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== GENE EXPRESSION SUMMARY ===\n")

# Find top expressing clusters for each gene
for(gene in available_genes) {
  if(gene %in% rownames(avg_exp)) {
    max_cluster <- colnames(avg_exp)[which.max(avg_exp[gene, ])]
    max_expression <- round(avg_exp[gene, max_cluster], 3)
    cat(gene, "highest in:", max_cluster, "(", max_expression, ")\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SIGNATURE ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups included: CTRL, IPF, SSc-ILD\n")
cat("Reordered clusters analyzed:", paste(cluster_order, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Number of final columns:", length(cluster_order), "\n")
cat("Combined clusters: LEC3, LEC5, LEC7 -> LEC3/5/7\n")
cat("Genes in signature:", length(available_genes), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save the main plot
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_BrownOrange.pdf",
       p_signature_dotplot_new, width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# Save the tight clean version
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_TightClean.pdf",
       p_tight_clean, width = 9, height = 11, dpi = 300)

# Save the tightest version
ggsave("LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_Tighter.pdf",
       p_tighter, width = 8, height = 13, dpi = 300)

# Save the plot data for reference
write.csv(plot_data, "LEC_signature_plot_data_reordered_clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save cluster composition data
write.csv(cluster_group_table, "LEC_reordered_cluster_composition_by_group.csv")

# Save average expression matrix
write.csv(avg_exp, "LEC_reordered_cluster_average_expression.csv")

# Save percent expressing matrix
write.csv(percent_exp, "LEC_reordered_cluster_percent_expressing.csv")

cat("Plots saved:\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_BrownOrange.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_TightClean.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_Signature_DotPlot_Reordered_0-6-1-4-2-357_Tighter.pdf\n")
cat("- LEC_signature_plot_data_reordered_clusters.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_reordered_cluster_composition_by_group.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_reordered_cluster_average_expression.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_reordered_cluster_percent_expressing.csv\n")

cat("\n=== REORDERED CLUSTERS SIGNATURE DOTPLOT ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")

```

```{r}

rm(list = ls())

# =============================================================================
# LEC Heatmap - 8 Clusters (LEC0-LEC7) with Comprehensive Gene Set using pheatmap
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD LEC SUBCLUSTERED OBJECT
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC subclustered object...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

cat("Original 8 clusters in dataset:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

cat("Total cells in dataset:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups in dataset:", paste(unique(sce_LECs$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE COMPREHENSIVE GENE SET FOR LEC HEATMAP
# =============================================================================

# Core lymphatic identity markers
lymphatic_core <- c("PROX1", "LYVE1", "FLT4", "PDPN", "CCL21", "VEGFC", "MMRN1")

# Lymphatic transcription factors and development
lymphatic_tf <- c("PROX1", "SOX18", "EBF1", "MEOX1", "FOXC2", "GATA2")

# Vessel structure and ECM
vessel_structure <- c("TEK", "CDH5", "PECAM1", "VWF", "COL4A1", "LAMA4", "ITGA9")

# Hypoxia and stress response
hypoxia_stress <- c("HIF1A", "EPAS1", "VEGFA", "ICAM1", "SELP", "TNFSF4")

# Immune and antigen presentation
immune_antigen <- c("CD74", "HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-DQA1")

# Chemokines and signaling
chemokine_signaling <- c("CCL2", "CXCL1", "CXCL2", "CCL21", "S1PR1", "ACKR4")

# Cell adhesion and junction
adhesion_junction <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VCAM1", "ICAM1", "OCLN", "TJP1")

# Metabolic and functional
metabolic_functional <- c("FABP4", "ANGPT2", "NOS3", "KDR", "FLT1", "NOTCH1")

# Combine all gene sets
all_heatmap_genes <- c(
  lymphatic_core,
  lymphatic_tf,
  vessel_structure,
  hypoxia_stress,
  immune_antigen,
  chemokine_signaling,
  adhesion_junction,
  metabolic_functional
)

# Remove duplicates and check availability
all_heatmap_genes <- unique(all_heatmap_genes)
available_heatmap_genes <- intersect(all_heatmap_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))

cat("Total genes selected for heatmap:", length(all_heatmap_genes), "\n")
cat("Available genes in dataset:", length(available_heatmap_genes), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", paste(setdiff(all_heatmap_genes, available_heatmap_genes), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Create gene categories for annotation
gene_categories <- c()
gene_categories[intersect(lymphatic_core, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Lymphatic Core"
gene_categories[intersect(lymphatic_tf, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Transcription Factors"
gene_categories[intersect(vessel_structure, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Vessel Structure"
gene_categories[intersect(hypoxia_stress, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Hypoxia/Stress"
gene_categories[intersect(immune_antigen, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Antigen Presentation"
gene_categories[intersect(chemokine_signaling, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Chemokine/Signaling"
gene_categories[intersect(adhesion_junction, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Cell Adhesion"
gene_categories[intersect(metabolic_functional, available_heatmap_genes)] <- "Metabolic/Functional"

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE CLUSTER ORDER
# =============================================================================

# Use custom cluster order: 1, 0, 2, 6, 4, 5, 7, 3
cluster_order <- c("LEC1", "LEC6", "LEC0", "LEC4", "LEC2", "LEC5", "LEC7", "LEC3")
available_clusters <- intersect(cluster_order, unique(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

cat("Custom cluster order for heatmap:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Set identities
Idents(sce_LECs) <- sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster

# =============================================================================
# JOIN LAYERS FOR SEURAT V5 COMPATIBILITY
# =============================================================================

# Join layers if using Seurat v5
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE AVERAGE EXPRESSION FOR HEATMAP
# =============================================================================

cat("Calculating average expression for heatmap...\n")

# Calculate average expression
avg_exp_heatmap <- AverageExpression(sce_LECs,
                                     features = available_heatmap_genes,
                                     group.by = "LEC_subcluster",
                                     slot = "data")$RNA

# Ensure all clusters are present
for(cluster in available_clusters) {
  if(!cluster %in% colnames(avg_exp_heatmap)) {
    avg_exp_heatmap[, cluster] <- 0
    cat("Added missing cluster:", cluster, "\n")
  }
}

# Reorder columns to match cluster order
avg_exp_heatmap <- avg_exp_heatmap[, available_clusters, drop = FALSE]

# Scale the data (z-score normalization per gene)
avg_exp_heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp_heatmap)))

# Check for and handle problematic values
cat("Checking for problematic values...\n")
cat("NA values:", sum(is.na(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")
cat("Inf values:", sum(is.infinite(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")
cat("NaN values:", sum(is.nan(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")

# Remove genes with zero variance (will create NaN after scaling)
gene_vars <- apply(avg_exp_heatmap, 1, var)
zero_var_genes <- names(gene_vars[gene_vars == 0 | is.na(gene_vars)])

if(length(zero_var_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(zero_var_genes), "genes with zero variance:", paste(zero_var_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  avg_exp_heatmap <- avg_exp_heatmap[!rownames(avg_exp_heatmap) %in% zero_var_genes, ]
  available_heatmap_genes <- rownames(avg_exp_heatmap)

  # Update gene categories to match remaining genes
  gene_categories <- gene_categories[available_heatmap_genes]
}

# Re-scale the cleaned data
avg_exp_heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp_heatmap)))

# Replace any remaining problematic values
avg_exp_heatmap_scaled[is.na(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)] <- 0
avg_exp_heatmap_scaled[is.infinite(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)] <- 0
avg_exp_heatmap_scaled[is.nan(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)] <- 0

# Final check
cat("After cleaning - NA values:", sum(is.na(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")
cat("After cleaning - Inf values:", sum(is.infinite(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")
cat("After cleaning - NaN values:", sum(is.nan(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)), "\n")

cat("Final heatmap matrix dimensions:", dim(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ANNOTATIONS FOR PHEATMAP
# =============================================================================

# Calculate group composition for each cluster
cluster_composition <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster, sce_LECs$group)
cluster_composition_props <- prop.table(cluster_composition, margin = 1)

# Create annotation data frame for clusters (columns)
col_annotation <- data.frame(
  Total_cells = cluster_composition[available_clusters, "CTRL"] +
                cluster_composition[available_clusters, "IPF"] +
                cluster_composition[available_clusters, "SSc-ILD"],
  CTRL_pct = cluster_composition_props[available_clusters, "CTRL"] * 100,
  IPF_pct = cluster_composition_props[available_clusters, "IPF"] * 100,
  SSc_ILD_pct = cluster_composition_props[available_clusters, "SSc-ILD"] * 100
)
rownames(col_annotation) <- available_clusters

# Create annotation data frame for genes (rows) - using remaining genes after cleaning
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Category = gene_categories[available_heatmap_genes]
)
rownames(row_annotation) <- available_heatmap_genes

# Define annotation colors
category_colors <- brewer.pal(length(unique(row_annotation$Category)), "Set3")
names(category_colors) <- unique(row_annotation$Category)

annotation_colors <- list(
  Category = category_colors,
  Total_cells = colorRampPalette(c("lightblue", "darkblue"))(50),
  CTRL_pct = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2CA02C"))(50),
  IPF_pct = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FF7F00"))(50),
  SSc_ILD_pct = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#9467BD"))(50)
)

# =============================================================================
# CREATE PHEATMAP HEATMAP
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating comprehensive LEC heatmap with pheatmap...\n")

# Check if we have enough genes for meaningful analysis
if(nrow(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled) < 3) {
  stop("Not enough genes remaining after cleaning for heatmap analysis")
}

# Define color palette for expression values
color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#762A83"))(100)

# Create the main heatmap with clustering - with error handling
tryCatch({
  pheatmap(
    avg_exp_heatmap_scaled,
    color = color_palette,
    scale = "none",  # already scaled

    # Annotations
    annotation_col = col_annotation,
    annotation_row = row_annotation,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,

    # Clustering - specify distance and linkage methods
    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
    clustering_method = "complete",
    clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",

    # Handle potential clustering issues
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,

    # Appearance
    fontsize = 8,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    angle_col = 45,

    # Legends and labels
    main = "LEC Expression Heatmap - 8 Clusters",

    # Size and output
    filename = "LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap2.pdf",
    width = 12,
    height = 14
  )

  cat("Main clustered heatmap saved successfully\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error in clustering, creating heatmap without clustering:\n")
  print(e)

  # Create heatmap without clustering as fallback
  pheatmap(
    avg_exp_heatmap_scaled,
    color = color_palette,
    scale = "none",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_col = col_annotation,
    annotation_row = row_annotation,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    fontsize = 8,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    angle_col = 45,
    main = "LEC Expression Heatmap - 8 Clusters (No Clustering)",
    filename = "LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap2.pdf",
    width = 12,
    height = 14
  )
  cat("Fallback heatmap without clustering saved\n")
})

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ORDERED VERSION WITHOUT CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating ordered heatmap without clustering...\n")

# Order genes by category - using remaining genes after cleaning
ordered_genes <- c()
for(cat in c("Lymphatic Core", "Transcription Factors", "Vessel Structure",
            "Hypoxia/Stress", "Antigen Presentation", "Chemokine/Signaling",
            "Cell Adhesion", "Metabolic/Functional")) {
  cat_genes <- names(gene_categories[gene_categories == cat & !is.na(gene_categories)])
  cat_genes <- intersect(cat_genes, available_heatmap_genes)
  ordered_genes <- c(ordered_genes, cat_genes)
}

# Make sure we have genes to plot
if(length(ordered_genes) == 0) {
  ordered_genes <- available_heatmap_genes
  cat("No genes found in categories, using all available genes\n")
}

# Create ordered heatmap without clustering
pheatmap(
  avg_exp_heatmap_scaled[ordered_genes, available_clusters],
  color = color_palette,
  scale = "none",

  # Turn off clustering
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,

  # Annotations
  annotation_col = col_annotation,
  annotation_row = row_annotation[ordered_genes, , drop = FALSE],
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,

  # Appearance
  fontsize = 8,
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,

  # Legends and labels
  main = "LEC Expression Heatmap - Ordered by Gene Category",

  # Size and output
  filename = "LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_Ordered_pheatmap2.pdf",
  width = 12,
  height = 14
)

cat("Ordered heatmap saved as LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_Ordered_pheatmap.pdf\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE SIMPLIFIED VERSION WITH CORE GENES ONLY
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating simplified heatmap with core LEC genes...\n")

# Select core lymphatic genes for a cleaner view
core_lec_genes <- c(
  # Core lymphatic
  "PROX1", "LYVE1", "FLT4", "PDPN", "CCL21", "VEGFC",
  # Key TFs
  "SOX18", "EBF1", "MEOX1", "FOXC2",
  # Vessel markers
  "TEK", "CDH5", "PECAM1",
  # Hypoxia/stress
  "HIF1A", "EPAS1", "ICAM1", "SELP",
  # Antigen presentation
  "CD74", "HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1",
  # Chemokines
  "CCL2", "CXCL1", "S1PR1",
  # Functional
  "FABP4", "ANGPT2", "KDR"
)

available_core_genes <- intersect(core_lec_genes, available_heatmap_genes)

cat("Available core genes for simplified heatmap:", length(available_core_genes), "\n")

# Only create simplified heatmap if we have core genes
if(length(available_core_genes) > 2) {
  # Create simplified heatmap
  pheatmap(
    avg_exp_heatmap_scaled[available_core_genes, available_clusters],
    color = color_palette,
    scale = "none",

    # Clustering
    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
    clustering_method = "complete",
    cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Keep cluster order

    # Annotations
    annotation_col = col_annotation,
    annotation_row = row_annotation[available_core_genes, , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,

    # Appearance
    fontsize = 9,
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 11,
    angle_col = 45,

    # Legends and labels
    main = "LEC Core Gene Expression - 8 Clusters",

    # Size and output
    filename = "LEC_Core_Genes_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )

  cat("Simplified core genes heatmap saved as LEC_Core_Genes_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap.pdf\n")
} else {
  cat("Not enough core genes available for simplified heatmap\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# CLUSTER-SPECIFIC MARKER ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== TOP EXPRESSING CLUSTERS PER GENE ===\n")

# Find which cluster has highest expression for each gene
top_clusters <- apply(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled, 1, function(x) {
  colnames(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled)[which.max(x)]
})

# Group genes by their top expressing cluster
for(cluster in available_clusters) {
  cluster_top_genes <- names(top_clusters[top_clusters == cluster])
  if(length(cluster_top_genes) > 0) {
    cat(cluster, "top genes:", paste(cluster_top_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Clusters analyzed:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Genes in final heatmap:", length(available_heatmap_genes), "\n")
cat("Gene categories:", length(unique(gene_categories[!is.na(gene_categories)])), "\n")

# Show cluster sizes
cat("\nCluster sizes:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

# Show category breakdown
cat("\nGenes per category (after cleaning):\n")
clean_gene_categories <- gene_categories[!is.na(gene_categories)]
print(table(clean_gene_categories))

# =============================================================================
# SAVE DATA AND RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save expression matrices
write.csv(avg_exp_heatmap, "LEC_heatmap_average_expression.csv")
write.csv(avg_exp_heatmap_scaled, "LEC_heatmap_scaled_expression.csv")

# Save annotations
write.csv(row_annotation, "LEC_heatmap_gene_annotations.csv")
write.csv(col_annotation, "LEC_heatmap_cluster_annotations.csv")

# Save gene lists by category (cleaned data)
clean_gene_categories <- gene_categories[!is.na(gene_categories)]
for(cat in unique(clean_gene_categories)) {
  cat_genes <- names(clean_gene_categories[clean_gene_categories == cat])
  write.csv(data.frame(Gene = cat_genes),
           paste0("LEC_heatmap_genes_", gsub("[/ ]", "_", cat), ".csv"),
           row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("- LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap.pdf (clustered version)\n")
cat("- LEC_Comprehensive_Heatmap_8Clusters_Ordered_pheatmap.pdf (ordered by category)\n")
cat("- LEC_Core_Genes_Heatmap_8Clusters_pheatmap.pdf (simplified core genes)\n")
cat("- LEC_heatmap_average_expression.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_heatmap_scaled_expression.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_heatmap_gene_annotations.csv\n")
cat("- LEC_heatmap_cluster_annotations.csv\n")
cat("- Gene category files (CSV format)\n")

cat("\n=== LEC HEATMAP ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```
