```{r}

# =============================================================================
# LEC Trajectory Analysis - LEC0 through LEC7
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# LEC Trajectory Analysis - Slingshot & Monocle3 (with installation handling)
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# MONOCLE3 IS OPTIONAL
# =============================================================================
# Install it with devtools::install_github("cole-trapnell-lab/monocle3") if you
# want the Monocle3 graph; Slingshot runs either way.
monocle3_available <- requireNamespace("monocle3", quietly = TRUE)
if (monocle3_available) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(monocle3))
  cat("Monocle3 loaded\n")
} else {
  cat("Monocle3 not available; proceeding with Slingshot only\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# LOAD LEC DATA
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC subclustered object for trajectory analysis...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

cat("LEC clusters for trajectory analysis:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

cat("Total cells:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Groups:", paste(unique(sce_LECs$group), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# Set cluster identities
Idents(sce_LECs) <- sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# Get cluster order
cluster_order <- paste0("LEC", 0:7)
available_clusters <- intersect(cluster_order, unique(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster))

cat("Available clusters for trajectory:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# SLINGSHOT TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SLINGSHOT TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Convert to SingleCellExperiment for slingshot
cat("Converting to SingleCellExperiment...\n")
sce_for_slingshot <- as.SingleCellExperiment(sce_LECs)

# Get UMAP coordinates
umap_coords <- Embeddings(sce_LECs, "umap")
colnames(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

# Add UMAP to SCE object
reducedDim(sce_for_slingshot, "UMAP") <- umap_coords

# Add cluster information
sce_for_slingshot$clusters <- sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster

# Run Slingshot trajectory analysis
cat("Running Slingshot trajectory inference...\n")

# Option 1: Let Slingshot automatically determine start/end clusters
sds_auto <- slingshot(sce_for_slingshot,
                      clusterLabels = "clusters",
                      reducedDim = "UMAP",
                      approx_points = 150)

cat("Slingshot found", length(slingCurves(sds_auto)), "trajectory/trajectories\n")

# Option 2: Specify potential start and end clusters based on biology
# You can modify these based on your biological knowledge
# For example, if LEC0 represents progenitor-like cells and LEC7 represents mature cells
sds_guided <- slingshot(sce_for_slingshot,
                        clusterLabels = "clusters",
                        reducedDim = "UMAP",
                        start.clus = "LEC0",  # Modify based on your biology
                        end.clus = c("LEC6", "LEC7"),  # Modify based on your biology
                        approx_points = 150)

cat("Guided Slingshot found", length(slingCurves(sds_guided)), "trajectory/trajectories\n")

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZE SLINGSHOT TRAJECTORIES
# =============================================================================

cat("Creating Slingshot trajectory visualizations...\n")

# Define colors for clusters
cluster_colors <- brewer.pal(length(available_clusters), "Set2")
names(cluster_colors) <- available_clusters

# Create trajectory plot - automatic version
trajectory_data_auto <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
  UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2],
  Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster,
  Group = sce_LECs$group
)

p_slingshot_auto <- ggplot(trajectory_data_auto, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Slingshot Trajectories - Automatic Detection",
       subtitle = paste("Found", length(slingCurves(sds_auto)), "trajectories")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# Add trajectory curves to automatic plot
for(i in seq_along(slingCurves(sds_auto))) {
  curve_data <- data.frame(slingCurves(sds_auto)[[i]]$s[slingCurves(sds_auto)[[i]]$ord, ])
  colnames(curve_data) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  p_slingshot_auto <- p_slingshot_auto +
    geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
              color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
              color = rainbow(length(slingCurves(sds_auto)))[i], size = 1.5)
}

print(p_slingshot_auto)

# Create trajectory plot - guided version
p_slingshot_guided <- ggplot(trajectory_data_auto, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Slingshot Trajectories - Guided (LEC0 start)",
       subtitle = paste("Found", length(slingCurves(sds_guided)), "trajectories")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# Add trajectory curves to guided plot
for(i in seq_along(slingCurves(sds_guided))) {
  curve_data <- data.frame(slingCurves(sds_guided)[[i]]$s[slingCurves(sds_guided)[[i]]$ord, ])
  colnames(curve_data) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  p_slingshot_guided <- p_slingshot_guided +
    geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
              color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
              color = rainbow(length(slingCurves(sds_guided)))[i], size = 1.5)
}

print(p_slingshot_guided)

# =============================================================================
# PSEUDOTIME ANALYSIS WITH SLINGSHOT
# =============================================================================

cat("Analyzing pseudotime with Slingshot...\n")

# Get pseudotime values (using guided version)
pseudotime_matrix <- slingPseudotime(sds_guided)

# Create pseudotime plots for each trajectory
if(ncol(pseudotime_matrix) > 0) {

  pseudotime_plots <- list()

  for(i in 1:ncol(pseudotime_matrix)) {
    trajectory_name <- paste("Trajectory", i)

    # Create data frame with pseudotime
    pt_data <- data.frame(
      UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
      UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2],
      Pseudotime = pseudotime_matrix[, i],
      Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster,
      Group = sce_LECs$group
    )

    # Remove cells not assigned to this trajectory (NA pseudotime)
    pt_data <- pt_data[!is.na(pt_data$Pseudotime), ]

    if(nrow(pt_data) > 0) {
      p_pseudotime <- ggplot(pt_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
        geom_point(aes(color = Pseudotime), size = 1.0, alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Pseudotime") +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = paste("Pseudotime -", trajectory_name),
             subtitle = paste(nrow(pt_data), "cells assigned")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

      pseudotime_plots[[i]] <- p_pseudotime
      print(p_pseudotime)
    }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# MONOCLE3 TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS (if available)
# =============================================================================

if(monocle3_available) {
  cat("\n=== MONOCLE3 TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS ===\n")

  # Convert Seurat to Monocle3 CDS object
  cat("Converting to Monocle3 CDS object...\n")

  # Extract necessary data
  expression_matrix <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")
  cell_metadata <- sce_LECs@meta.data
  gene_metadata <- data.frame(
    gene_short_name = rownames(expression_matrix),
    row.names = rownames(expression_matrix)
  )

  # Create CDS object
  cds <- new_cell_data_set(expression_data = expression_matrix,
                           cell_metadata = cell_metadata,
                           gene_metadata = gene_metadata)

  # Add existing dimensionality reductions
  cds <- preprocess_cds(cds, num_dim = 50, verbose = FALSE)

  # Add UMAP coordinates from Seurat
  reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- umap_coords

  # Add cluster information
  cds$clusters <- sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster
  cds$group <- sce_LECs$group

  # Learn trajectory graph
  cat("Learning trajectory graph with Monocle3...\n")
  cds <- learn_graph(cds, verbose = FALSE)

  # Order cells along trajectory
  # You can specify root cells based on biological knowledge
  # For example, if LEC0 represents the most progenitor-like state:
  root_cells <- colnames(cds)[cds$clusters == "LEC0"]

  if(length(root_cells) > 0) {
    # Use a subset of root cells if too many
    if(length(root_cells) > 50) {
      root_cells <- sample(root_cells, 50)
    }

    cds <- order_cells(cds, root_cells = root_cells, verbose = FALSE)

    cat("Trajectory ordering complete with", length(root_cells), "root cells from LEC0\n")
  } else {
    # If no LEC0 cells, let Monocle3 choose
    cds <- order_cells(cds, verbose = FALSE)
    cat("Trajectory ordering complete with automatic root selection\n")
  }

  # =============================================================================
  # VISUALIZE MONOCLE3 TRAJECTORIES
  # =============================================================================

  cat("Creating Monocle3 trajectory visualizations...\n")

  # Plot trajectory colored by clusters
  p_monocle_clusters <- plot_cells(cds,
                                  color_cells_by = "clusters",
                                  label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
                                  group_label_size = 4) +
    labs(title = "Monocle3 Trajectory - Colored by Clusters") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

  print(p_monocle_clusters)

  # Plot trajectory colored by pseudotime
  p_monocle_pseudotime <- plot_cells(cds,
                                    color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
                                    label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
                                    group_label_size = 4) +
    labs(title = "Monocle3 Trajectory - Colored by Pseudotime") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

  print(p_monocle_pseudotime)

  # Plot trajectory colored by disease group
  p_monocle_group <- plot_cells(cds,
                               color_cells_by = "group",
                               label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
                               group_label_size = 4) +
    labs(title = "Monocle3 Trajectory - Colored by Disease Group") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

  print(p_monocle_group)

} else {
  cat("\n=== MONOCLE3 NOT AVAILABLE - SKIPPING MONOCLE3 ANALYSIS ===\n")
  cat("Continuing with Slingshot analysis only...\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# GENE EXPRESSION ALONG TRAJECTORIES
# =============================================================================

cat("Analyzing gene expression along trajectories...\n")

# Select key LEC genes for trajectory analysis
trajectory_genes <- c("PROX1", "LYVE1", "FLT4", "PDPN", "CCL21", "VEGFC",
                      "HIF1A", "EPAS1", "ICAM1", "CD74", "CCL2", "TEK")

if(monocle3_available && exists("cds")) {
  available_traj_genes <- intersect(trajectory_genes, rownames(cds))

  cat("Available genes for Monocle3 trajectory analysis:", paste(available_traj_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  if(length(available_traj_genes) >= 4) {
    # Plot gene expression along pseudotime
    p_genes_pseudotime <- plot_cells(cds,
                                     genes = available_traj_genes[1:min(4, length(available_traj_genes))],
                                     show_trajectory_graph = FALSE,
                                     label_cell_groups = FALSE,
                                     label_leaves = FALSE)

    print(p_genes_pseudotime)

    # Plot genes in pseudotime order
    cds_subset <- cds[available_traj_genes, ]
    p_genes_time <- plot_genes_in_pseudotime(cds_subset[available_traj_genes[1:min(6, length(available_traj_genes))], ],
                                             color_cells_by = "clusters",
                                             min_expr = 0.1,
                                             ncol = 2)
    print(p_genes_time)
  }
} else {
  cat("Monocle3 not available - skipping gene expression trajectory analysis\n")
  cat("You can still analyze gene expression along Slingshot pseudotime manually\n")

  # Alternative: Simple correlation analysis with Slingshot pseudotime
  if(exists("pseudotime_matrix") && ncol(pseudotime_matrix) > 0) {
    available_traj_genes <- intersect(trajectory_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))

    if(length(available_traj_genes) > 0) {
      cat("Performing simple correlation analysis with Slingshot pseudotime...\n")

      # Get expression data
      expr_data <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[available_traj_genes, , drop = FALSE]

      # Calculate correlations with first trajectory pseudotime
      pt_values <- pseudotime_matrix[, 1]
      valid_cells <- !is.na(pt_values)

      if(sum(valid_cells) > 10) {
        gene_correlations <- apply(expr_data[, valid_cells, drop = FALSE], 1, function(gene_expr) {
          cor(gene_expr, pt_values[valid_cells], method = "spearman")
        })

        cat("Gene correlations with pseudotime (first trajectory):\n")
        print(sort(gene_correlations, decreasing = TRUE))

        # Create simple scatter plots for top correlated genes
        top_genes <- names(sort(abs(gene_correlations), decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(4, length(gene_correlations))]

        for(gene in top_genes) {
          gene_expr <- as.numeric(expr_data[gene, valid_cells])
          plot_data <- data.frame(
            Pseudotime = pt_values[valid_cells],
            Expression = gene_expr,
            Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster[valid_cells]
          )

          p_gene_scatter <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = Expression)) +
            geom_point(aes(color = Cluster), alpha = 0.6) +
            geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
            labs(title = paste("Gene Expression along Pseudotime:", gene),
                 x = "Slingshot Pseudotime", y = "Expression") +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

          print(p_gene_scatter)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# TRAJECTORY COMPARISON BY DISEASE GROUP
# =============================================================================

cat("Comparing trajectories across disease groups...\n")

# Split by disease group and compare
disease_groups <- unique(sce_LECs$group)

# Create pseudotime distribution plots by disease group
if(exists("pseudotime_matrix") && ncol(pseudotime_matrix) > 0) {

  pseudotime_comparison <- data.frame(
    Pseudotime = as.vector(pseudotime_matrix[, 1]),  # Use first trajectory
    Group = rep(sce_LECs$group, ncol(pseudotime_matrix))[1:length(as.vector(pseudotime_matrix[, 1]))],
    Cluster = rep(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster, ncol(pseudotime_matrix))[1:length(as.vector(pseudotime_matrix[, 1]))]
  )

  # Remove NA values
  pseudotime_comparison <- pseudotime_comparison[!is.na(pseudotime_comparison$Pseudotime), ]

  if(nrow(pseudotime_comparison) > 0) {

    # Pseudotime distribution by disease group
    p_pseudotime_dist <- ggplot(pseudotime_comparison, aes(x = Pseudotime, fill = Group)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")) +
      labs(title = "Pseudotime Distribution by Disease Group",
           x = "Pseudotime", y = "Density") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

    print(p_pseudotime_dist)

    # Boxplot comparison
    p_pseudotime_box <- ggplot(pseudotime_comparison, aes(x = Group, y = Pseudotime, fill = Group)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")) +
      labs(title = "Pseudotime by Disease Group",
           x = "Disease Group", y = "Pseudotime") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    print(p_pseudotime_box)
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")

cat("Total LECs analyzed:", ncol(sce_LECs), "\n")
cat("Clusters included:", paste(available_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if(exists("sds_guided")) {
  cat("Slingshot trajectories found:", length(slingCurves(sds_guided)), "\n")

  # Show trajectory assignments
  for(i in 1:length(slingCurves(sds_guided))) {
    assigned_cells <- sum(!is.na(pseudotime_matrix[, i]))
    cat("  Trajectory", i, ":", assigned_cells, "cells assigned\n")
  }
}

if(exists("cds") && monocle3_available) {
  # Monocle3 summary
  pseudotime_range <- range(pseudotime(cds), na.rm = TRUE)
  assigned_cells_monocle <- sum(!is.na(pseudotime(cds)))
  cat("Monocle3 pseudotime range:", round(pseudotime_range[1], 2), "-", round(pseudotime_range[2], 2), "\n")
  cat("Monocle3 cells with pseudotime:", assigned_cells_monocle, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Monocle3 analysis not available\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS RESULTS ===\n")

# Save plots
if(exists("p_slingshot_auto")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Slingshot_Trajectories_Auto.pdf", p_slingshot_auto, width = 10, height = 8)
}
if(exists("p_slingshot_guided")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Slingshot_Trajectories_Guided.pdf", p_slingshot_guided, width = 10, height = 8)
}
if(exists("p_monocle_clusters")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Monocle3_Clusters.pdf", p_monocle_clusters, width = 10, height = 8)
}
if(exists("p_monocle_pseudotime")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Monocle3_Pseudotime.pdf", p_monocle_pseudotime, width = 10, height = 8)
}
if(exists("p_monocle_group")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Monocle3_DiseaseGroup.pdf", p_monocle_group, width = 10, height = 8)
}
if(exists("p_pseudotime_dist")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Pseudotime_Distribution_by_Group.pdf", p_pseudotime_dist, width = 10, height = 6)
}
if(exists("p_pseudotime_box")) {
  ggsave("LEC_Pseudotime_Boxplot_by_Group.pdf", p_pseudotime_box, width = 8, height = 6)
}

# Save trajectory objects
if(exists("sds_guided")) {
  saveRDS(sds_guided, "LEC_Slingshot_Trajectories.rds")
}
if(exists("cds") && monocle3_available) {
  saveRDS(cds, "LEC_Monocle3_CDS.rds")
}

# Save pseudotime data
if(exists("pseudotime_matrix")) {
  slingshot_pseudotime <- data.frame(
    Cell_ID = rownames(pseudotime_matrix),
    pseudotime_matrix,
    Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster,
    Group = sce_LECs$group
  )
  write.csv(slingshot_pseudotime, "LEC_Slingshot_Pseudotime.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

if(exists("cds") && monocle3_available) {
  monocle_pseudotime <- data.frame(
    Cell_ID = colnames(cds),
    Pseudotime = pseudotime(cds),
    Cluster = cds$clusters,
    Group = cds$group
  )
  write.csv(monocle_pseudotime, "LEC_Monocle3_Pseudotime.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Files saved:\n")
if(exists("p_slingshot_auto")) {
  cat("- Slingshot trajectory plots (PDF)\n")
}
if(exists("p_monocle_clusters")) {
  cat("- Monocle3 trajectory plots (PDF)\n")
}
cat("- LEC_Slingshot_Trajectories.rds (Slingshot object)\n")
if(exists("cds") && monocle3_available) {
  cat("- LEC_Monocle3_CDS.rds (Monocle3 CDS object)\n")
  cat("- LEC_Monocle3_Pseudotime.csv\n")
}
cat("- LEC_Slingshot_Pseudotime.csv\n")

cat("\n=== LEC TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")

# =============================================================================
# INTERPRETATION GUIDE
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== INTERPRETATION GUIDE ===\n")
cat("TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS RESULTS:\n\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(slingshot)
library(ggplot2)

# Load saved objects
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")
sds_guided <- readRDS("LEC_Slingshot_Trajectories.rds")

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# Get pseudotime matrix from slingshot object
pseudotime_matrix <- slingPseudotime(sds_guided)

# Define genes to plot
genes_to_plot <- c("PDPN", "EPAS1", "HIF1A", "SPARCL1", "PROX1", "FLT4", "PDPN")

# Get pseudotime matrix from slingshot object
pseudotime_matrix <- slingPseudotime(sds_guided)

# Get pseudotime values for first trajectory
pt_values <- pseudotime_matrix[, 1]
valid_cells <- !is.na(pt_values)

# Create plots for each gene
plot_list <- list()

for(gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # Check if gene exists in the data
  if(gene %in% rownames(sce_LECs)) {

    # Get gene expression data
    gene_expr_data <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[gene, , drop = FALSE]
    gene_expr <- as.numeric(gene_expr_data[1, valid_cells])

    # Create plot data
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      Pseudotime = pt_values[valid_cells],
      Expression = gene_expr
    )

    # Create the plot with trajectory line only
    p_gene <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = Expression)) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "black", se = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
      labs(title = paste("Gene Expression along Pseudotime:", gene),
           x = "Slingshot Pseudotime", y = "Expression") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

    plot_list[[gene]] <- p_gene
    print(p_gene)

  } else {
    cat("Gene", gene, "not found in dataset\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# SPECIFIC GENE TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS - PROX1, EPAS1, HIF1A, SPARCL1
# Normal vs Proinflammatory LEC Differentiation
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(reshape2)

# =============================================================================
# DEFINE TARGET GENES AND SETUP
# =============================================================================

# Target genes for trajectory analysis
target_genes <- c("PROX1", "EPAS1", "HIF1A", "SPARCL1")

# Check which genes are available in the dataset
available_genes <- intersect(target_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))
missing_genes <- setdiff(target_genes, available_genes)

cat("Target genes analysis:\n")
cat("Available genes:", paste(available_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
if(length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  cat("Missing genes:", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  # Check for alternative gene names
  potential_alternatives <- c("PROX-1" = "PROX1",
                             "SPARCl1" = "SPARCL1",
                             "SPARC-like-1" = "SPARCL1")

  for(alt_name in names(potential_alternatives)) {
    if(alt_name %in% rownames(sce_LECs)) {
      cat("Found alternative:", alt_name, "-> using", potential_alternatives[alt_name], "\n")
      available_genes <- c(available_genes, alt_name)
    }
  }
}

if(length(available_genes) == 0) {
  stop("None of the target genes found in the dataset!")
}

# =============================================================================
# CLASSIFY TRAJECTORIES AS NORMAL VS PROINFLAMMATORY
# =============================================================================

# Define proinflammatory vs normal LEC characteristics
# Based on cluster distribution across disease conditions:
# CTRL-enriched: LEC1 (527 vs 104+83), LEC6 (100 vs 29+44)
# Disease-enriched: LEC0 (289 vs 516+222), LEC2 (106 vs 322+216),
#                   LEC3 (21 vs 269+139), LEC5 (9 vs 151+50)

classify_lec_state <- function(cluster_name, disease_group) {
  # Classification based on cluster distribution patterns

  if(cluster_name == "LEC1") {
    # LEC1: Highly enriched in CTRL (527) vs disease (104 IPF + 83 SSc-ILD)
    return("Normal")
  } else if(cluster_name == "LEC6") {
    # LEC6: More abundant in CTRL (100) vs disease (29 IPF + 44 SSc-ILD)
    return("Normal")
  } else if(cluster_name %in% c("LEC0", "LEC2", "LEC3", "LEC5")) {
    # Disease-enriched clusters:
    # LEC0: 289 CTRL vs 516 IPF + 222 SSc-ILD
    # LEC2: 106 CTRL vs 322 IPF + 216 SSc-ILD
    # LEC3: 21 CTRL vs 269 IPF + 139 SSc-ILD (most disease-specific)
    # LEC5: 9 CTRL vs 151 IPF + 50 SSc-ILD (very disease-specific)
    return("Proinflammatory")
  } else if(cluster_name %in% c("LEC4", "LEC7")) {
    # LEC4: Mixed distribution, LEC7: Very few cells
    return("Intermediate")
  } else {
    return("Intermediate")
  }
}

# Add LEC state classification to metadata
sce_LECs$LEC_state <- mapply(classify_lec_state,
                            sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster,
                            sce_LECs$group)

cat("LEC state classification based on cluster distribution:\n")
cat("Normal LECs (CTRL-enriched): LEC1, LEC6\n")
cat("Proinflammatory LECs (Disease-enriched): LEC0, LEC2, LEC3, LEC5\n")
cat("Intermediate LECs: LEC4, LEC7\n\n")

cat("LEC state classification summary:\n")
print(table(sce_LECs$LEC_state, sce_LECs$group))

cat("\nCluster-specific distribution validation:\n")
cluster_state_table <- table(sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster, sce_LECs$LEC_state)
print(cluster_state_table)

# =============================================================================
# GENE EXPRESSION ALONG SLINGSHOT TRAJECTORIES
# =============================================================================

if(exists("pseudotime_matrix") && ncol(pseudotime_matrix) > 0) {

  cat("Creating gene trajectory plots with Slingshot pseudotime...\n")

  # Get expression data for target genes
  expr_data <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[available_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # Create plots for each trajectory
  slingshot_gene_plots <- list()

  for(traj_idx in 1:ncol(pseudotime_matrix)) {

    trajectory_name <- paste("Trajectory", traj_idx)
    pt_values <- pseudotime_matrix[, traj_idx]
    valid_cells <- !is.na(pt_values)

    if(sum(valid_cells) > 10) {

      # Create data frame for this trajectory
      traj_data <- data.frame(
        Cell_ID = colnames(sce_LECs)[valid_cells],
        Pseudotime = pt_values[valid_cells],
        Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster[valid_cells],
        Group = sce_LECs$group[valid_cells],
        LEC_state = sce_LECs$LEC_state[valid_cells],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      # Add gene expression data
      for(gene in available_genes) {
        traj_data[[gene]] <- as.numeric(expr_data[gene, valid_cells])
      }

      # Melt data for plotting
      traj_data_long <- melt(traj_data,
                            id.vars = c("Cell_ID", "Pseudotime", "Cluster", "Group", "LEC_state"),
                            measure.vars = available_genes,
                            variable.name = "Gene",
                            value.name = "Expression")

      # Create trajectory plot colored by LEC state
      p_trajectory_state <- ggplot(traj_data_long, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = Expression)) +
        geom_point(aes(color = LEC_state), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(aes(color = LEC_state), method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3) +
        facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Normal" = "#2CA02C",
                                     "Proinflammatory" = "#FF4500",
                                     "Intermediate" = "#FFB347")) +
        labs(title = paste("Gene Expression Along", trajectory_name),
             subtitle = "Normal vs Proinflammatory LEC Differentiation",
             x = "Pseudotime",
             y = "Expression Level",
             color = "LEC State") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
              strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

      print(p_trajectory_state)
      slingshot_gene_plots[[traj_idx]] <- p_trajectory_state

      # Create disease group comparison
      p_trajectory_disease <- ggplot(traj_data_long, aes(x = Pseudotime, y = Expression)) +
        geom_point(aes(color = Group), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(aes(color = Group), method = "loess", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3) +
        facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C",
                                     "IPF" = "#FF7F00",
                                     "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")) +
        labs(title = paste("Gene Expression Along", trajectory_name),
             subtitle = "Comparison by Disease Group",
             x = "Pseudotime",
             y = "Expression Level",
             color = "Disease Group") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
              strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

      print(p_trajectory_disease)

      # Statistical analysis of gene expression differences
      cat(paste("\n=== Statistical Analysis for", trajectory_name, "===\n"))

      for(gene in available_genes) {
        gene_data <- traj_data[, c("Pseudotime", "LEC_state", gene)]
        colnames(gene_data)[3] <- "Expression"

        # Correlation analysis
        normal_cells <- gene_data$LEC_state == "Normal"
        proinflam_cells <- gene_data$LEC_state == "Proinflammatory"

        if(sum(normal_cells) > 5 && sum(proinflam_cells) > 5) {
          cor_normal <- cor(gene_data$Pseudotime[normal_cells],
                           gene_data$Expression[normal_cells],
                           method = "spearman")
          cor_proinflam <- cor(gene_data$Pseudotime[proinflam_cells],
                              gene_data$Expression[proinflam_cells],
                              method = "spearman")

          cat(paste(gene, "- Normal LEC correlation with pseudotime:", round(cor_normal, 3), "\n"))
          cat(paste(gene, "- Proinflammatory LEC correlation with pseudotime:", round(cor_proinflam, 3), "\n"))

          # T-test for expression differences
          t_test_result <- t.test(gene_data$Expression[normal_cells],
                                 gene_data$Expression[proinflam_cells])
          cat(paste(gene, "- Mean expression difference p-value:", format(t_test_result$p.value, scientific = TRUE), "\n"))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# =============================================================================

if(exists("cds") && monocle3_available) {

cat("Creating comparative gene expression heatmap...\n")

if(exists("pseudotime_matrix") && ncol(pseudotime_matrix) > 0) {

  # Use first trajectory for heatmap
  pt_values <- pseudotime_matrix[, 1]
  valid_cells <- !is.na(pt_values)

  if(sum(valid_cells) > 20) {
    # Bin pseudotime for heatmap
    n_bins <- 20
    pt_bins <- cut(pt_values[valid_cells], breaks = n_bins, labels = FALSE)

    # Create average expression by pseudotime bin and LEC state
    heatmap_data <- data.frame(
      Pseudotime_bin = pt_bins,
      LEC_state = sce_LECs$LEC_state[valid_cells]
    )

    # Add gene expression
    expr_data <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[available_genes, valid_cells, drop = FALSE]
    for(gene in available_genes) {
      heatmap_data[[gene]] <- as.numeric(expr_data[gene, ])
    }

    # Calculate mean expression by bin and state
    heatmap_summary <- heatmap_data %>%
      group_by(Pseudotime_bin, LEC_state) %>%
      summarise_at(available_genes, mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
      ungroup()

    # Create heatmap data
    heatmap_long <- melt(heatmap_summary,
                        id.vars = c("Pseudotime_bin", "LEC_state"),
                        measure.vars = available_genes,
                        variable.name = "Gene",
                        value.name = "Mean_Expression")

    # Filter out combinations with too few cells
    heatmap_long <- heatmap_long[!is.na(heatmap_long$Mean_Expression), ]

    if(nrow(heatmap_long) > 0) {
      p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_long, aes(x = Pseudotime_bin, y = Gene)) +
        geom_tile(aes(fill = Mean_Expression)) +
        facet_wrap(~ LEC_state, ncol = 3) +
        scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean\nExpression") +
        labs(title = "Gene Expression Along Pseudotime",
             subtitle = "Normal vs Proinflammatory LEC States",
             x = "Pseudotime Bin",
             y = "Gene") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
              plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
              axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
              strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

      print(p_heatmap)
    }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
```
```{r}
# TRAJECTORY PATH VISUALIZATION WITH GENE EXPRESSION
# Shows actual trajectory curves colored by gene expression levels
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# SETUP - ENSURE PREVIOUS ANALYSIS IS LOADED
# =============================================================================

# Target genes for trajectory path analysis
target_genes <- c("PROX1", "EPAS1", "HIF1A", "SPARCL1")

# Check which genes are available in the dataset
available_genes <- intersect(target_genes, rownames(sce_LECs))

cat("Creating trajectory path plots for genes:", paste(available_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Get UMAP coordinates
umap_coords <- Embeddings(sce_LECs, "umap")
colnames(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

# =============================================================================
# TRAJECTORY PATH PLOTS - GENE EXPRESSION OVERLAY
# =============================================================================

if(exists("sds_guided") && length(available_genes) > 0) {

  cat("Creating trajectory path plots with gene expression overlay...\n")

  # Get expression data
  expr_data <- GetAssayData(sce_LECs, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[available_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # Create base trajectory data
  trajectory_base_data <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_coords[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_coords[, 2],
    Cluster = sce_LECs$LEC_subcluster,
    Group = sce_LECs$group,
    LEC_state = sce_LECs$LEC_state
  )

  # Add gene expression to base data
  for(gene in available_genes) {
    trajectory_base_data[[gene]] <- as.numeric(expr_data[gene, ])
  }

  # Create plots for each gene
  gene_trajectory_plots <- list()

  for(gene in available_genes) {

    cat(paste("Creating trajectory plot for", gene, "...\n"))

    # Create base plot with gene expression
    p_base <- ggplot(trajectory_base_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
      geom_point(aes_string(color = gene), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_viridis_c(name = paste(gene, "\nExpression"), option = "plasma") +
      labs(title = paste("LEC Trajectory Paths -", gene, "Expression"),
           subtitle = "Trajectory curves overlaid on gene expression",
           x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

    # Add trajectory curves
    for(i in seq_along(slingCurves(sds_guided))) {
      curve_data <- data.frame(slingCurves(sds_guided)[[i]]$s[slingCurves(sds_guided)[[i]]$ord, ])
      colnames(curve_data) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

      # Add thick black outline for visibility
      p_base <- p_base +
        geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
                  color = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_path(data = curve_data, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2),
                  color = "white", size = 2, alpha = 0.9)
    }

    gene_trajectory_plots[[gene]] <- p_base
    print(p_base)
  }

  # Create combined plot showing all genes
  if(length(available_genes) >= 2) {
    combined_gene_plot <- wrap_plots(gene_trajectory_plots, ncol = 2)
    print(combined_gene_plot)

    # Save combined plot
    ggsave("LEC_All_Genes_Trajectory_Paths.pdf", combined_gene_plot,
           width = 16, height = 12)
  }
}

# =============================================================================
```
```{r}
# LEC1 vs LEC3 Pseudobulk Differential Expression Analysis
# =============================================================================


library(Seurat)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA AND SUBSET CLUSTERS
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC data and subsetting LEC1 and LEC3...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

# Subset to only LEC1 and LEC3
sce_comparison <- subset(sce_LECs, subset = LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC1", "LEC3"))

cat("Total cells in LEC1 and LEC3:\n")
print(table(sce_comparison$LEC_subcluster, sce_comparison$group))

# Check we have sufficient donors per group
donor_summary <- sce_comparison@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group, LEC_subcluster, donor) %>%
  summarise(cell_count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(group, LEC_subcluster) %>%
  summarise(donor_count = n(), total_cells = sum(cell_count), .groups = 'drop')

cat("\nDonor and cell counts per group and cluster:\n")
print(donor_summary)

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_comparison[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_comparison[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# CREATE PSEUDOBULK PROFILES
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING PSEUDOBULK PROFILES ===\n")

# Function to create pseudobulk profiles
create_pseudobulk <- function(seurat_obj, group_by = c("donor", "group", "LEC_subcluster")) {

  # Get expression matrix
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")

  # Get metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj@meta.data[, group_by, drop = FALSE]
  metadata$cell_id <- rownames(metadata)

  # Create grouping variable
  metadata$sample_id <- paste(metadata$donor, metadata$group, metadata$LEC_subcluster, sep = "_")

  # Aggregate counts by sample
  pseudobulk_list <- list()
  sample_metadata <- data.frame()

  for(sample in unique(metadata$sample_id)) {
    # Get cells for this sample
    cells_in_sample <- metadata$cell_id[metadata$sample_id == sample]

    if(length(cells_in_sample) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 cells per pseudobulk sample
      # Sum counts across cells
      pseudobulk_counts <- rowSums(expr_matrix[, cells_in_sample, drop = FALSE])
      pseudobulk_list[[sample]] <- pseudobulk_counts

      # Store sample metadata
      sample_info <- metadata[metadata$sample_id == sample, ][1, ]
      sample_metadata <- rbind(sample_metadata, data.frame(
        sample_id = sample,
        donor = sample_info$donor,
        group = sample_info$group,
        cluster = sample_info$LEC_subcluster,
        cell_count = length(cells_in_sample)
      ))
    }
  }

  # Convert to matrix
  pseudobulk_matrix <- do.call(cbind, pseudobulk_list)
  colnames(pseudobulk_matrix) <- names(pseudobulk_list)

  return(list(counts = pseudobulk_matrix, metadata = sample_metadata))
}

# Create pseudobulk profiles
pseudobulk_data <- create_pseudobulk(sce_comparison)
pseudobulk_counts <- pseudobulk_data$counts
pseudobulk_metadata <- pseudobulk_data$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples created:", ncol(pseudobulk_counts), "\n")
cat("Genes:", nrow(pseudobulk_counts), "\n")

# Show sample distribution
cat("\nPseudobulk sample distribution:\n")
print(table(pseudobulk_metadata$group, pseudobulk_metadata$cluster))

# =============================================================================
# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS WITH DESEQ2
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to run DESeq2 analysis
run_deseq2_analysis <- function(counts, metadata, cluster_subset, comparison_groups) {

  # Subset to specific cluster
  cluster_samples <- metadata$sample_id[metadata$cluster == cluster_subset]
  cluster_counts <- counts[, cluster_samples, drop = FALSE]
  cluster_metadata <- metadata[metadata$cluster == cluster_subset, ]

  # Filter lowly expressed genes (at least 10 counts in at least 3 samples)
  keep_genes <- rowSums(cluster_counts >= 10) >= 3
  cluster_counts <- cluster_counts[keep_genes, ]

  cat("For", cluster_subset, "- analyzing", nrow(cluster_counts), "genes across", ncol(cluster_counts), "samples\n")

  # Create DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = cluster_counts,
    colData = cluster_metadata,
    design = ~ group
  )

  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Extract results for each comparison
  results_list <- list()

  for(comp in comparison_groups) {
    contrast <- c("group", comp[1], comp[2])
    res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast, alpha = 0.05)
    res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
      mutate(
        gene = rownames(.),
        cluster = cluster_subset,
        comparison = paste(comp[1], "vs", comp[2])
      ) %>%
      arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

    results_list[[paste(comp[1], "vs", comp[2])]] <- res_df
  }

  return(results_list)
}

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("IPF", "CTRL"),
  c("SSc-ILD", "CTRL"),
  c("IPF", "SSc-ILD")
)

# Run analysis for both clusters
lec1_results <- run_deseq2_analysis(pseudobulk_counts, pseudobulk_metadata, "LEC1", comparisons)
lec3_results <- run_deseq2_analysis(pseudobulk_counts, pseudobulk_metadata, "LEC3", comparisons)

# =============================================================================
# EXTRACT TOP DIFFERENTIALLY EXPRESSED GENES
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== TOP DIFFERENTIALLY EXPRESSED GENES ===\n")

# Function to extract top genes
extract_top_genes <- function(results_list, top_n = 20) {

  top_genes_summary <- data.frame()

  for(comp_name in names(results_list)) {
    res <- results_list[[comp_name]]

    # Get significant genes
    sig_genes <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05, ]

    if(nrow(sig_genes) > 0) {
      # Top upregulated
      top_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0, ][1:min(top_n, sum(sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0)), ]
      if(nrow(top_up) > 0) {
        top_up$direction <- "Upregulated"
        top_up$rank <- 1:nrow(top_up)
      }

      # Top downregulated
      top_down <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0, ][1:min(top_n, sum(sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0)), ]
      if(nrow(top_down) > 0) {
        top_down$direction <- "Downregulated"
        top_down$rank <- 1:nrow(top_down)
      }

      # Combine
      if(nrow(top_up) > 0 && nrow(top_down) > 0) {
        top_genes <- rbind(top_up, top_down)
      } else if(nrow(top_up) > 0) {
        top_genes <- top_up
      } else if(nrow(top_down) > 0) {
        top_genes <- top_down
      } else {
        next
      }

      top_genes$comparison <- comp_name
      top_genes_summary <- rbind(top_genes_summary, top_genes)
    }
  }

  return(top_genes_summary)
}

# Extract top genes for both clusters
lec1_top_genes <- extract_top_genes(lec1_results, top_n = 15)
lec3_top_genes <- extract_top_genes(lec3_results, top_n = 15)

# Add cluster information
lec1_top_genes$cluster <- "LEC1"
lec3_top_genes$cluster <- "LEC3"

# Combine results
all_top_genes <- rbind(lec1_top_genes, lec3_top_genes)

# =============================================================================
# COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS BETWEEN LEC1 AND LEC3
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARING LEC1 vs LEC3 RESPONSES ===\n")

# Function to compare responses between clusters
compare_cluster_responses <- function(lec1_res, lec3_res, comparison_name) {

  # Get significant genes from each cluster
  lec1_sig <- lec1_res[!is.na(lec1_res$padj) & lec1_res$padj < 0.05, ]
  lec3_sig <- lec3_res[!is.na(lec3_res$padj) & lec3_res$padj < 0.05, ]

  # Find common and unique genes
  lec1_genes <- lec1_sig$gene
  lec3_genes <- lec3_sig$gene

  common_genes <- intersect(lec1_genes, lec3_genes)
  lec1_unique <- setdiff(lec1_genes, lec3_genes)
  lec3_unique <- setdiff(lec3_genes, lec1_genes)

  # For common genes, compare fold changes
  common_comparison <- data.frame()
  if(length(common_genes) > 0) {
    lec1_common <- lec1_sig[lec1_sig$gene %in% common_genes, ]
    lec3_common <- lec3_sig[lec3_sig$gene %in% common_genes, ]

    # Merge by gene
    common_merged <- merge(lec1_common, lec3_common, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_LEC1", "_LEC3"))

    common_comparison <- common_merged %>%
      mutate(
        comparison = comparison_name,
        fold_change_diff = log2FoldChange_LEC1 - log2FoldChange_LEC3,
        response_pattern = case_when(
          sign(log2FoldChange_LEC1) == sign(log2FoldChange_LEC3) ~ "Same_direction",
          TRUE ~ "Opposite_direction"
        )
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(fold_change_diff)))
  }

  return(list(
    common_genes = common_genes,
    lec1_unique = lec1_unique,
    lec3_unique = lec3_unique,
    common_comparison = common_comparison,
    stats = c(
      LEC1_sig = length(lec1_genes),
      LEC3_sig = length(lec3_genes),
      Common = length(common_genes),
      LEC1_unique = length(lec1_unique),
      LEC3_unique = length(lec3_unique)
    )
  ))
}

# Compare responses for each disease comparison
comparison_results <- list()
for(comp_name in names(lec1_results)) {
  comparison_results[[comp_name]] <- compare_cluster_responses(
    lec1_results[[comp_name]],
    lec3_results[[comp_name]],
    comp_name
  )
}

# Print comparison summaries
for(comp_name in names(comparison_results)) {
  cat("\n", comp_name, "comparison:\n")
  print(comparison_results[[comp_name]]$stats)
}

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION - VOLCANO PLOTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Function to create volcano plot
create_volcano_plot <- function(de_results, title, top_genes_to_label = 10) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- de_results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "Not significant",
        padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 1 ~ "Significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "Highly significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj + 1e-300)  # Add small constant to avoid -Inf
    )

  # Get top genes to label
  top_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label)

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not significant" = "gray70",
      "Significant" = "lightblue",
      "Highly significant" = "red"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-Log10 (Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

  return(p)
}

  # Get unique genes for heatmap
  heatmap_genes <- unique(top_up_genes$gene)

  # Create expression matrix for heatmap
  heatmap_expr <- GetAssayData(sce_comparison, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[heatmap_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  # Calculate average expression by cluster and group
  avg_expr <- AverageExpression(sce_comparison,
                               features = heatmap_genes,
                               group.by = c("LEC_subcluster", "group"),
                               slot = "data")$RNA

  # Scale for heatmap
  avg_expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))

  # Create annotations
  col_info <- data.frame(
    sample = colnames(avg_expr_scaled),
    cluster = sapply(strsplit(colnames(avg_expr_scaled), "_"), `[`, 1),
    group = sapply(strsplit(colnames(avg_expr_scaled), "_"), `[`, 2)
  )
  rownames(col_info) <- col_info$sample

  annotation_cols <- list(
    cluster = c("LEC1" = "#1f77b4", "LEC3" = "#ff7f0e"),
    group = c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")
  )

  # Create heatmap
  pheatmap(
    avg_expr_scaled,
    annotation_col = col_info[, c("cluster", "group"), drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = annotation_cols,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#762A83"))(100),
    main = "Top Upregulated Genes - LEC1 vs LEC3",
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    filename = "LEC1_vs_LEC3_Top_Genes_Heatmap.pdf",
    width = 8,
    height = 10
  )
}

cat("\n=== CREATING SUMMARY REPORTS ===\n")

# Create comprehensive summary table
create_summary_table <- function(cluster_results, cluster_name) {

  summary_table <- data.frame()

  for(comp_name in names(cluster_results)) {
    res <- cluster_results[[comp_name]]
    sig_res <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05, ]

    if(nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
      # Top 10 upregulated
      top_up <- sig_res[sig_res$log2FoldChange > 0, ] %>% head(10)
      if(nrow(top_up) > 0) {
        top_up$direction <- "Upregulated"
        top_up$cluster <- cluster_name
        top_up$comparison <- comp_name
        summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, top_up[, c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj", "direction", "cluster", "comparison")])
      }

      # Top 10 downregulated
      top_down <- sig_res[sig_res$log2FoldChange < 0, ] %>% head(10)
      if(nrow(top_down) > 0) {
        top_down$direction <- "Downregulated"
        top_down$cluster <- cluster_name
        top_down$comparison <- comp_name
        summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, top_down[, c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj", "direction", "cluster", "comparison")])
      }
    }
  }

  return(summary_table)
}

# Create summary tables
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# Custom Volcano Plots - LEC1 vs LEC3 Specific Comparisons
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA AND PREPARE SUBSETS
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC data for custom comparisons...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# COMPARISON 1: ALL LECs from LEC1 vs ALL LECs from LEC3
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARISON 1: ALL LEC1 vs ALL LEC3 (All Conditions) ===\n")

# Subset to LEC1 and LEC3, all conditions
sce_all_comparison <- subset(sce_LECs, subset = LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC1", "LEC3"))

cat("Cells in ALL comparison:\n")
print(table(sce_all_comparison$LEC_subcluster, sce_all_comparison$group))

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions combined
create_cluster_pseudobulk <- function(seurat_obj, comparison_name) {

  # Get expression matrix
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")

  # Get metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  metadata$cell_id <- rownames(metadata)

  # Create sample IDs by donor and cluster (pooling across disease groups)
  metadata$sample_id <- paste(metadata$donor, metadata$LEC_subcluster, sep = "_")

  # Aggregate counts by sample
  pseudobulk_list <- list()
  sample_metadata <- data.frame()

  for(sample in unique(metadata$sample_id)) {
    # Get cells for this sample
    cells_in_sample <- metadata$cell_id[metadata$sample_id == sample]

    if(length(cells_in_sample) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 cells per pseudobulk sample
      # Sum counts across cells
      pseudobulk_counts <- rowSums(expr_matrix[, cells_in_sample, drop = FALSE])
      pseudobulk_list[[sample]] <- pseudobulk_counts

      # Store sample metadata
      sample_info <- metadata[metadata$sample_id == sample, ][1, ]
      sample_metadata <- rbind(sample_metadata, data.frame(
        sample_id = sample,
        donor = sample_info$donor,
        cluster = sample_info$LEC_subcluster,
        cell_count = length(cells_in_sample),
        comparison = comparison_name
      ))
    }
  }

  # Convert to matrix
  pseudobulk_matrix <- do.call(cbind, pseudobulk_list)
  colnames(pseudobulk_matrix) <- names(pseudobulk_list)

  return(list(counts = pseudobulk_matrix, metadata = sample_metadata))
}

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions
all_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_all_comparison, "All_Conditions")
all_counts <- all_pseudobulk$counts
all_metadata <- all_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for ALL comparison:", ncol(all_counts), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution:\n")
print(table(all_metadata$cluster))

# Run DESeq2 for LEC1 vs LEC3 (all conditions)
run_cluster_deseq2 <- function(counts, metadata, comparison_name) {

  # Filter lowly expressed genes
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3
  counts <- counts[keep_genes, ]

  cat("Analyzing", nrow(counts), "genes across", ncol(counts), "samples for", comparison_name, "\n")

  # Create DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ cluster
  )

  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Extract results (LEC3 vs LEC1)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "LEC3", "LEC1"), alpha = 0.05)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(.),
      comparison = comparison_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

  return(res_df)
}

# Run analysis for all conditions
all_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(all_counts, all_metadata, "All_LEC1_vs_LEC3")

# =============================================================================
# COMPARISON 2: DISEASED LECs (IPF+SSc-ILD) from LEC1 vs LEC3
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARISON 2: DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC3 (IPF + SSc-ILD only) ===\n")

# Subset to diseased samples only
sce_diseased <- subset(sce_LECs, subset = LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC1", "LEC3") & group %in% c("IPF", "SSc-ILD"))

cat("Cells in DISEASED comparison:\n")
print(table(sce_diseased$LEC_subcluster, sce_diseased$group))

# Create pseudobulk for diseased conditions
diseased_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_diseased, "Diseased_Only")
diseased_counts <- diseased_pseudobulk$counts
diseased_metadata <- diseased_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for DISEASED comparison:", ncol(diseased_counts), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution:\n")
print(table(diseased_metadata$cluster))

# Run analysis for diseased conditions
diseased_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(diseased_counts, diseased_metadata, "Diseased_LEC1_vs_LEC3")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS ===\n")

create_enhanced_volcano <- function(de_results, title, top_genes_to_label = 15) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- de_results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "Not significant",
        padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 0.5 ~ "Significant (low FC)",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 1 ~ "Significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "Highly significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),  # Cap at 50 to avoid plotting issues
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "LEC3 higher", "LEC1 higher")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))

  # Get top genes to label (mix of most significant and highest fold change)
  top_sig_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  top_fc_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  genes_to_label <- unique(c(top_sig_genes$gene, top_fc_genes$gene))
  label_data <- plot_data[plot_data$gene %in% genes_to_label, ]

  # Count significant genes
  sig_counts <- table(plot_data$significance)
  n_up_lec3 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up_lec1 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Create subtitle with counts
  subtitle <- paste0("LEC3 higher: ", n_up_lec3, " genes | LEC1 higher: ", n_up_lec1, " genes")

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not significant" = "gray80",
      "Significant (low FC)" = "lightblue",
      "Significant" = "orange",
      "Highly significant" = "red"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_data, aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 20,
                    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1),
               linetype = c("dashed", "dotted", "dotted", "dashed"),
               alpha = 0.6, color = c("red", "blue", "blue", "red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("Total genes:", nrow(plot_data)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (LEC3 vs LEC1)",
      y = "-Log10 (Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    xlim(c(-max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
           max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1))

  return(p)
}

# Create the two volcano plots
volcano_all <- create_enhanced_volcano(
  all_results,
  "ALL LEC1 vs LEC3 (All Conditions)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20
)

volcano_diseased <- create_enhanced_volcano(
  diseased_results,
  "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC3 (IPF + SSc-ILD only)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20
)

# Display plots
print(volcano_all)
print(volcano_diseased)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS AND TOP GENES
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

# Function to summarize results
summarize_results <- function(results, comparison_name) {
  sig_results <- results[!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.05, ]

  cat("\n", comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("Total genes tested:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_results), "\n")
  cat("LEC3 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
  cat("LEC1 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
  cat("Highly significant (|FC| >= 1):", sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1), "\n")

  # Top upregulated in each cluster
  lec3_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  lec1_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  if(nrow(lec3_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC3:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec3_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec3_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, gene_info$log2FoldChange, gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  if(nrow(lec1_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC1:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec1_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec1_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, abs(gene_info$log2FoldChange), gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  return(list(
    total = nrow(results),
    significant = nrow(sig_results),
    lec3_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0),
    lec1_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0),
    high_fc = sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1)
  ))
}

# Summarize both comparisons
all_summary <- summarize_results(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC3")
diseased_summary <- summarize_results(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC3")

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save DE results
write.csv(all_results, "ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC3_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(diseased_results, "DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC3_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save volcano plots
ggsave("ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC3_Volcano.pdf", volcano_all, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC3_Volcano.pdf", volcano_diseased, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Create and save summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC3", "DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC3"),
  Total_genes = c(all_summary$total, diseased_summary$total),
  Significant_genes = c(all_summary$significant, diseased_summary$significant),
  LEC3_higher = c(all_summary$lec3_higher, diseased_summary$lec3_higher),
  LEC1_higher = c(all_summary$lec1_higher, diseased_summary$lec1_higher),
  High_FC_genes = c(all_summary$high_fc, diseased_summary$high_fc)
)

write.csv(summary_stats, "LEC1_vs_LEC3_Volcano_Summary_Stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save top genes for each comparison

cat("- DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC3_Volcano.pdf\n")
cat("- ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC3_DE_results.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# Create pseudobulk for all conditions
all_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_all_comparison, "All_Conditions")
all_counts <- all_pseudobulk$counts
all_metadata <- all_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for ALL comparison:", ncol(all_counts), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution:\n")
print(table(all_metadata$cluster))

# Run DESeq2 for LEC1 vs LEC3 (all conditions)
run_cluster_deseq2 <- function(counts, metadata, comparison_name) {

  # Filter lowly expressed genes
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3
  counts <- counts[keep_genes, ]

  cat("Analyzing", nrow(counts), "genes across", ncol(counts), "samples for", comparison_name, "\n")

  # Create DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ cluster
  )

  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Extract results (LEC3 vs LEC1)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "LEC3", "LEC1"), alpha = 0.05)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(.),
      comparison = comparison_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

  return(res_df)
}

# Run analysis for all conditions
all_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(all_counts, all_metadata, "All_LEC1_vs_LEC3")

# COMPARISON 2: DISEASED LECs (IPF+SSc-ILD) from LEC1 vs LEC3
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS ===\n")

create_enhanced_volcano <- function(de_results, title, top_genes_to_label = 15) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- de_results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "Not significant",
        padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 0.5 ~ "Significant (low FC)",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 1 ~ "Significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "Highly significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),  # Cap at 50 to avoid plotting issues
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "LEC3 higher", "LEC1 higher")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))

  # Get top genes to label from BOTH sides
  # Top upregulated genes (LEC3 higher - right side)
  top_lec3_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Top downregulated genes (LEC1 higher - left side)
  top_lec1_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Combine genes from both sides
  genes_to_label <- unique(c(top_lec3_genes$gene, top_lec1_genes$gene))
  label_data <- plot_data[plot_data$gene %in% genes_to_label, ]

  # Count significant genes
  sig_counts <- table(plot_data$significance)
  n_up_lec3 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up_lec1 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Create subtitle with counts
  subtitle <- paste0("LEC3 higher: ", n_up_lec3, " genes | LEC1 higher: ", n_up_lec1, " genes")

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not significant" = "gray80",
      "Significant (low FC)" = "lightblue",
      "Significant" = "orange",
      "Highly significant" = "red"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_data, aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 25,
                    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1),
               linetype = c("dashed", "dotted", "dotted", "dashed"),
               alpha = 0.6, color = c("red", "blue", "blue", "red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("Total genes:", nrow(plot_data)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (LEC3 vs LEC1)",
      y = "-Log10 (Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    xlim(c(-max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
           max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1))

  return(p)
}

# Create the two volcano plots
volcano_all <- create_enhanced_volcano(

  "ALL LEC1 vs LEC3 (All Conditions)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20
)

# Display plots

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

# Function to summarize results
summarize_results <- function(results, comparison_name) {
  sig_results <- results[!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.05, ]

  cat("\n", comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("Total genes tested:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_results), "\n")
  cat("LEC3 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
  cat("LEC1 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
  cat("Highly significant (|FC| >= 1):", sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1), "\n")

  # Top upregulated in each cluster
  lec3_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  lec1_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  if(nrow(lec3_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC3:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec3_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec3_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, gene_info$log2FoldChange, gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  if(nrow(lec1_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC1:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec1_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec1_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, abs(gene_info$log2FoldChange), gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  return(list(
    total = nrow(results),
    significant = nrow(sig_results),
    lec3_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0),
    lec1_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0),
    high_fc = sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1)
  ))
}

# Summarize both comparisons
all_summary <- summarize_results(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC3")
diseased_summary <- summarize_results(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC3")
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)

cat("\n=== PREPARING GENE LISTS ===\n")

# Function to extract significant gene lists
extract_gene_lists <- function(de_results, comparison_name, padj_threshold = 0.05, fc_threshold = 0.25) {

  # Filter significant genes
  sig_genes <- de_results[!is.na(de_results$padj) &
                         de_results$padj < padj_threshold &
                         abs(de_results$log2FoldChange) > fc_threshold, ]

  # Separate upregulated and downregulated
  lec3_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0, ]$gene
  lec1_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0, ]$gene

  cat(comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("  LEC3 upregulated genes:", length(lec3_up), "\n")
  cat("  LEC1 upregulated genes:", length(lec1_up), "\n")

  return(list(
    lec3_up = lec3_up,
    lec1_up = lec1_up,
    all_sig = sig_genes$gene
  ))
}

# Extract gene lists
all_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(all_lec_results, "ALL LEC comparison")
diseased_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(diseased_lec_results, "DISEASED LEC comparison")

# =============================================================================
# CONVERT GENE SYMBOLS TO ENTREZ IDS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CONVERTING GENE SYMBOLS TO ENTREZ IDS ===\n")

# Function to convert symbols to Entrez IDs
convert_to_entrez <- function(gene_symbols, comparison_name) {

  # Remove any empty or NA values
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""]

  if(length(gene_symbols) == 0) {
    cat("No genes to convert for", comparison_name, "\n")
    return(character(0))
  }

  # Convert using bitr
  gene_conversion <- bitr(gene_symbols,
                         fromType = "SYMBOL",
                         toType = "ENTREZID",
                         OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

  cat(comparison_name, ": converted", nrow(gene_conversion), "out of", length(gene_symbols), "genes\n")

  return(gene_conversion$ENTREZID)
}

# Convert all gene lists
all_lec3_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(all_gene_lists$lec3_up, "ALL LEC3 up")
all_lec1_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, "ALL LEC1 up")

diseased_lec3_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_gene_lists$lec3_up, "DISEASED LEC3 up")
diseased_lec1_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up, "DISEASED LEC1 up")

# =============================================================================
# RUN GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== RUNNING GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to run GO enrichment
run_go_enrichment <- function(entrez_ids, comparison_name, universe = NULL) {

  if(length(entrez_ids) < 5) {
    cat("Skipping", comparison_name, "- too few genes (", length(entrez_ids), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  cat("Running GO enrichment for", comparison_name, "with", length(entrez_ids), "genes\n")

  # Run GO enrichment for all three ontologies
  go_results <- list()

  for(ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
    tryCatch({
      ego <- enrichGO(gene = entrez_ids,
                     universe = universe,
                     OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                     ont = ont,
                     pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                     qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                     readable = TRUE)

      if(nrow(ego) > 0) {
        go_results[[ont]] <- ego
        cat("  ", ont, ": found", nrow(ego), "enriched terms\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error in", ont, "enrichment:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }

  return(go_results)
}

# Get universe (all tested genes)
all_universe <- convert_to_entrez(all_lec_results$gene, "ALL universe")
diseased_universe <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_lec_results$gene, "DISEASED universe")

# Run enrichment for all comparisons
go_all_lec3_up <- run_go_enrichment(all_lec3_up_entrez, "ALL LEC3 up", all_universe)
go_all_lec1_up <- run_go_enrichment(all_lec1_up_entrez, "ALL LEC1 up", all_universe)

go_diseased_lec3_up <- run_go_enrichment(diseased_lec3_up_entrez, "DISEASED LEC3 up", diseased_universe)
go_diseased_lec1_up <- run_go_enrichment(diseased_lec1_up_entrez, "DISEASED LEC1 up", diseased_universe)

cat("\n=== CREATING GO VISUALIZATION PLOTS ===\n")

# Function to create GO plots
create_go_plots <- function(go_result_list, title_prefix, save_prefix) {

  plots <- list()

  for(ont in names(go_result_list)) {
    ego <- go_result_list[[ont]]

    if(nrow(ego) > 0) {

      # Dot plot
      p_dot <- dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15) +
        ggtitle(paste(title_prefix, "-", ont)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

      plots[[paste(ont, "dot")]] <- p_dot
      print(p_dot)

      # Bar plot
      p_bar <- barplot(ego, showCategory = 10) +
        ggtitle(paste(title_prefix, "-", ont, "Top 10")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

      plots[[paste(ont, "bar")]] <- p_bar
      print(p_bar)

      # Save individual plots
      ggsave(paste0(save_prefix, "_", ont, "_dotplot.pdf"), p_dot, width = 12, height = 8)
      ggsave(paste0(save_prefix, "_", ont, "_barplot.pdf"), p_bar, width = 10, height = 8)
    }
  }

  return(plots)
}

cat("\n=== COMPARING PATHWAYS BETWEEN CONDITIONS ===\n")

# Function to extract top pathways for comparison
extract_top_pathways <- function(go_results, ont_type, top_n = 10) {

  if(is.null(go_results) || is.null(go_results[[ont_type]])) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  ego <- go_results[[ont_type]]

  if(nrow(ego) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  top_paths <- ego@result %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, Count) %>%
    mutate(
      Gene_Ratio_Numeric = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) {
        parts <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
        as.numeric(parts[1]) / as.numeric(parts[2])
      })
    )

  return(top_paths)
}

# Extract top biological process pathways for comparison
bp_comparisons <- list(
  "ALL_LEC3_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_all_lec3_up, "BP"),
  "ALL_LEC1_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_all_lec1_up, "BP"),
  "DISEASED_LEC3_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_diseased_lec3_up, "BP"),
  "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_diseased_lec1_up, "BP")
)

# Combine and save pathway comparison

for(comp_name in names(bp_comparisons)) {
  if(nrow(bp_comparisons[[comp_name]]) > 0) {
    pathways <- bp_comparisons[[comp_name]]
    pathways$Comparison <- comp_name
    bp_combined <- rbind(bp_combined, pathways)
  }
}

  p_pathway_comparison <- bp_combined %>%

    ggplot(aes(x = Gene_Ratio_Numeric, y = reorder(Description, Gene_Ratio_Numeric))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = -log10(p.adjust), size = Count)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "-Log10(padj)") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Gene Count") +
    facet_wrap(~ Comparison, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = "Top GO Biological Process Pathways",
      subtitle = "LEC1 vs LEC3 Comparisons",
      x = "Gene Ratio",
      y = "GO Terms"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  print(p_pathway_comparison)
  ggsave("GO_Pathway_Comparison_LEC1_vs_LEC3.pdf", p_pathway_comparison, width = 16, height = 12)

# Function to save GO results as CSV
save_go_results <- function(go_results, file_prefix) {

  if(is.null(go_results)) {
    return()

  for(ont in names(go_results)) {
    ego <- go_results[[ont]]

    if(nrow(ego) > 0) {
      go_df <- ego@result
      write.csv(go_df, paste0(file_prefix, "_", ont, "_GO_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```
