```{r}
cat("\n=== PATHWAY OVERLAP ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to compare pathway overlaps
compare_pathway_overlaps <- function(go_results_list, ont = "BP") {

  # Extract pathway IDs from each comparison
  pathway_lists <- list()

  for(comp_name in names(go_results_list)) {
    if(!is.null(go_results_list[[comp_name]]) &&
       !is.null(go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]) &&
       nrow(go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]) > 0) {

      pathways <- go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]@result
      significant_pathways <- pathways[pathways$p.adjust < 0.05, ]$ID
      pathway_lists[[comp_name]] <- significant_pathways

      cat(comp_name, ":", length(significant_pathways), "significant", ont, "pathways\n")
    }
  }

  return(pathway_lists)
}

# Compare biological process pathways
all_go_results <- list(
  "ALL_LEC3_UP" = go_all_lec3_up,
  "ALL_LEC1_UP" = go_all_lec1_up,
  "DISEASED_LEC3_UP" = go_diseased_lec3_up,
  "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" = go_diseased_lec1_up
)

bp_pathway_lists <- compare_pathway_overlaps(all_go_results, "BP")

# Find shared pathways
if(length(bp_pathway_lists) >= 2) {

  # Compare ALL vs DISEASED for each cluster
  if("ALL_LEC3_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "DISEASED_LEC3_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    lec3_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC3_UP, bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC3_UP)
    cat("LEC3 shared pathways (ALL vs DISEASED):", length(lec3_shared), "\n")
  }

  if("ALL_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    lec1_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC1_UP, bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC1_UP)
    cat("LEC1 shared pathways (ALL vs DISEASED):", length(lec1_shared), "\n")
  }

  # Compare LEC1 vs LEC3 within each condition
  if("ALL_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "ALL_LEC3_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    all_cluster_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC1_UP, bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC3_UP)
    cat("Shared pathways between clusters (ALL condition):", length(all_cluster_shared), "\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# CREATE SUMMARY REPORT
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING SUMMARY REPORT ===\n")

# Function to get top pathway descriptions
get_top_pathway_names <- function(go_results, ont = "BP", top_n = 5) {

  if(is.null(go_results) || is.null(go_results[[ont]]) || nrow(go_results[[ont]]) == 0) {
    return("No significant pathways found")
  }

  top_paths <- go_results[[ont]]@result %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    pull(Description)

  return(paste(top_paths, collapse = "; "))
}

# Create summary report
summary_report <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("ALL_LEC3_UP", "ALL_LEC1_UP", "DISEASED_LEC3_UP", "DISEASED_LEC1_UP"),
  Gene_Count = c(
    length(all_lec3_up_entrez),
    length(all_lec1_up_entrez),
    length(diseased_lec3_up_entrez),
    length(diseased_lec1_up_entrez)
  ),
  Top_BP_Pathways = c(
    get_top_pathway_names(go_all_lec3_up, "BP"),
    get_top_pathway_names(go_all_lec1_up, "BP"),
    get_top_pathway_names(go_diseased_lec3_up, "BP"),
    get_top_pathway_names(go_diseased_lec1_up, "BP")
  )
)

write.csv(summary_report, "GO_Analysis_Summary_Report.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Print key findings
cat("\nKEY PATHWAY FINDINGS:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(summary_report)) {
  cat("\n", summary_report$Comparison[i], "(", summary_report$Gene_Count[i], "genes):\n")
  pathways <- summary_report$Top_BP_Pathways[i]
  if(pathways != "No significant pathways found") {
    cat("  Top pathways:", substr(pathways, 1, 200), "...\n")
  } else {
    cat("  No significant pathways found\n")
  }
}

cat("\nFiles saved:\n")
cat("- Individual GO results: *_GO_results.csv for each ontology\n")
cat("- GO pathway plots: *_dotplot.pdf and *_barplot.pdf\n")
cat("- Pathway comparison: GO_Pathway_Comparison_LEC1_vs_LEC3.pdf\n")
cat("- Summary tables: GO_*.csv files\n")

cat("\n=== GO PATHWAY ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# LEC1 vs LEC6 Pseudobulk Analysis with Volcano Plots
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA AND PREPARE SUBSETS
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC data for LEC1 vs LEC6 comparisons...\n")
sce_LECs <- readRDS("LECs_subclustered.rds")

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================
# COMPARISON 1: ALL LECs from LEC1 vs ALL LECs from LEC6
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARISON 1: ALL LEC1 vs ALL LEC6 (All Conditions) ===\n")

# Subset to LEC1 and LEC6, all conditions
sce_all_comparison <- subset(sce_LECs, subset = LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC1", "LEC6"))

cat("Cells in ALL LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison:\n")
print(table(sce_all_comparison$LEC_subcluster, sce_all_comparison$group))

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions combined
create_cluster_pseudobulk <- function(seurat_obj, comparison_name) {

  # Get expression matrix
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")

  # Get metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  metadata$cell_id <- rownames(metadata)

  # Create sample IDs by donor and cluster (pooling across disease groups)
  metadata$sample_id <- paste(metadata$donor, metadata$LEC_subcluster, sep = "_")

  # Aggregate counts by sample
  pseudobulk_list <- list()
  sample_metadata <- data.frame()

  for(sample in unique(metadata$sample_id)) {
    # Get cells for this sample
    cells_in_sample <- metadata$cell_id[metadata$sample_id == sample]

    if(length(cells_in_sample) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 cells per pseudobulk sample
      # Sum counts across cells
      pseudobulk_counts <- rowSums(expr_matrix[, cells_in_sample, drop = FALSE])
      pseudobulk_list[[sample]] <- pseudobulk_counts

      # Store sample metadata
      sample_info <- metadata[metadata$sample_id == sample, ][1, ]
      sample_metadata <- rbind(sample_metadata, data.frame(
        sample_id = sample,
        donor = sample_info$donor,
        cluster = sample_info$LEC_subcluster,
        cell_count = length(cells_in_sample),
        comparison = comparison_name
      ))
    }
  }

  # Convert to matrix
  pseudobulk_matrix <- do.call(cbind, pseudobulk_list)
  colnames(pseudobulk_matrix) <- names(pseudobulk_list)

  return(list(counts = pseudobulk_matrix, metadata = sample_metadata))
}

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions
all_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_all_comparison, "All_Conditions")
all_counts <- all_pseudobulk$counts
all_metadata <- all_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for ALL LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison:", ncol(all_counts), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution:\n")
print(table(all_metadata$cluster))

# Run DESeq2 for LEC1 vs LEC6 (all conditions)
run_cluster_deseq2 <- function(counts, metadata, comparison_name) {

  # Filter lowly expressed genes
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3
  counts <- counts[keep_genes, ]

  cat("Analyzing", nrow(counts), "genes across", ncol(counts), "samples for", comparison_name, "\n")

  # Create DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ cluster
  )

  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Extract results (LEC6 vs LEC1)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "LEC6", "LEC1"), alpha = 0.05)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(.),
      comparison = comparison_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

  return(res_df)
}

# Run analysis for all conditions
all_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(all_counts, all_metadata, "All_LEC1_vs_LEC6")

# =============================================================================
# COMPARISON 2: DISEASED LECs (IPF+SSc-ILD) from LEC1 vs LEC6
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARISON 2: DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6 (IPF + SSc-ILD only) ===\n")

# Subset to diseased samples only
sce_diseased <- subset(sce_LECs, subset = LEC_subcluster %in% c("LEC1", "LEC6") & group %in% c("IPF", "SSc-ILD"))

cat("Cells in DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison:\n")
print(table(sce_diseased$LEC_subcluster, sce_diseased$group))

diseased_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_diseased, "Diseased_Only")
diseased_counts <- diseased_pseudobulk$counts
diseased_metadata <- diseased_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison:", ncol(diseased_counts), "\n")

print(table(diseased_metadata$cluster))

# Run analysis for diseased conditions
diseased_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(diseased_counts, diseased_metadata, "Diseased_LEC1_vs_LEC6")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS WITH BALANCED LABELING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS ===\n")

create_enhanced_volcano <- function(de_results, title, top_genes_to_label = 15) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- de_results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "Not significant",
        padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 0.5 ~ "Significant (low FC)",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 1 ~ "Significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "Highly significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),  # Cap at 50 to avoid plotting issues
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "LEC6 higher", "LEC1 higher")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))

  # Get top genes to label from BOTH sides
  # Top upregulated genes (LEC6 higher - right side)
  top_lec6_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Top downregulated genes (LEC1 higher - left side)
  top_lec1_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Combine genes from both sides
  genes_to_label <- unique(c(top_lec6_genes$gene, top_lec1_genes$gene))
  label_data <- plot_data[plot_data$gene %in% genes_to_label, ]

  # Count significant genes
  n_up_lec6 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up_lec1 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Create subtitle with counts
  subtitle <- paste0("LEC6 higher: ", n_up_lec6, " genes | LEC1 higher: ", n_up_lec1, " genes")

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not significant" = "gray80",
      "Significant (low FC)" = "lightblue",
      "Significant" = "orange",
      "Highly significant" = "red"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_data, aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 25,
                    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1),
               linetype = c("dashed", "dotted", "dotted", "dashed"),
               alpha = 0.6, color = c("red", "blue", "blue", "red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("Total genes:", nrow(plot_data)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (LEC6 vs LEC1)",
      y = "-Log10 (Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    xlim(c(-max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
           max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1))

  return(p)
}

# Create the two volcano plots for LEC1 vs LEC6
volcano_all <- create_enhanced_volcano(
  all_results,
  "ALL LEC1 vs LEC6 (All Conditions)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20

volcano_diseased <- create_enhanced_volcano(

# Display plots
print(volcano_all)
print(volcano_diseased)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

# Function to summarize results
summarize_results <- function(results, comparison_name) {
  sig_results <- results[!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.05, ]

  cat("\n", comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("Total genes tested:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_results), "\n")
  cat("LEC6 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
  cat("LEC1 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
  cat("Highly significant (|FC| >= 1):", sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1), "\n")

  # Top upregulated in each cluster
  lec6_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  lec1_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  if(nrow(lec6_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC6:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec6_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec6_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, gene_info$log2FoldChange, gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  if(nrow(lec1_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC1:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec1_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec1_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, abs(gene_info$log2FoldChange), gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  return(list(
    total = nrow(results),
    significant = nrow(sig_results),
    lec6_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0),
    lec1_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0),
    high_fc = sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1)
  ))
}

# Summarize both comparisons
all_summary <- summarize_results(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC6")
diseased_summary <- summarize_results(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6")

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save DE results
write.csv(all_results, "ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC6_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  Significant_genes = c(all_summary$significant, diseased_summary$significant),
  LEC6_higher = c(all_summary$lec6_higher, diseased_summary$lec6_higher),
  LEC1_higher = c(all_summary$lec1_higher, diseased_summary$lec1_higher),
  High_FC_genes = c(all_summary$high_fc, diseased_summary$high_fc)
)

write.csv(summary_stats, "LEC1_vs_LEC6_Volcano_Summary_Stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  head(50)

write.csv(top_all, "TOP_50_ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC6.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_diseased, "TOP_50_DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC6.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# GENE LIST EXTRACTION FOR GO ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== EXTRACTING GENE LISTS FOR POTENTIAL GO ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to extract significant gene lists
extract_gene_lists <- function(de_results, comparison_name, padj_threshold = 0.05, fc_threshold = 0.25) {

  # Filter significant genes
  sig_genes <- de_results[!is.na(de_results$padj) &
                         de_results$padj < padj_threshold &
                         abs(de_results$log2FoldChange) > fc_threshold, ]

  # Separate upregulated and downregulated
  lec6_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0, ]$gene
  lec1_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0, ]$gene

  cat(comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("  LEC6 upregulated genes:", length(lec6_up), "\n")
  cat("  LEC1 upregulated genes:", length(lec1_up), "\n")

  # Save gene lists
  if(length(lec6_up) > 0) {
    write.csv(data.frame(gene = lec6_up),
             paste0(gsub(" ", "_", comparison_name), "_LEC6_upregulated_genes.csv"),
             row.names = FALSE)
  }

  if(length(lec1_up) > 0) {
    write.csv(data.frame(gene = lec1_up),
             paste0(gsub(" ", "_", comparison_name), "_LEC1_upregulated_genes.csv"),
             row.names = FALSE)
  }

  return(list(
    lec6_up = lec6_up,
    lec1_up = lec1_up,
    all_sig = sig_genes$gene
  ))
}

# Extract gene lists for both comparisons
all_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC6")
diseased_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6")

# =============================================================================
# COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS: ALL vs DISEASED ===\n")

# Compare shared vs unique genes between ALL and DISEASED conditions
if(length(all_gene_lists$lec6_up) > 0 && length(diseased_gene_lists$lec6_up) > 0) {
  lec6_shared <- intersect(all_gene_lists$lec6_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec6_up)
  lec6_all_unique <- setdiff(all_gene_lists$lec6_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec6_up)
  lec6_diseased_unique <- setdiff(diseased_gene_lists$lec6_up, all_gene_lists$lec6_up)

  cat("LEC6 upregulated genes:\n")
  cat("  Shared (ALL & DISEASED):", length(lec6_shared), "\n")
  cat("  ALL conditions only:", length(lec6_all_unique), "\n")
  cat("  DISEASED only:", length(lec6_diseased_unique), "\n")
}

if(length(all_gene_lists$lec1_up) > 0 && length(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up) > 0) {
  lec1_shared <- intersect(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up)
  lec1_all_unique <- setdiff(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up)
  lec1_diseased_unique <- setdiff(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up, all_gene_lists$lec1_up)

  cat("LEC1 upregulated genes:\n")
  cat("  Shared (ALL & DISEASED):", length(lec1_shared), "\n")
  cat("  ALL conditions only:", length(lec1_all_unique), "\n")
  cat("  DISEASED only:", length(lec1_diseased_unique), "\n")
}

cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("- ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC6_Volcano.pdf\n")
cat("- DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC6_Volcano.pdf\n")
cat("- ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC6_DE_results.csv\n")
cat("- DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC6_DE_results.csv\n")
cat("- LEC1_vs_LEC6_Volcano_Summary_Stats.csv\n")
cat("- TOP_50_*.csv files\n")
cat("- Gene lists: *_upregulated_genes.csv files\n")
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# GO Pathway Analysis - LEC1 vs LEC6 Comparisons
# =============================================================================

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggupset)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading LEC1 vs LEC6 differential expression results...\n")

# Load the DE results from LEC1 vs LEC6 analysis
all_lec_results <- read.csv("ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC6_DE_results.csv")
diseased_lec_results <- read.csv("DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC6_DE_results.csv")

cat("ALL LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison: ", nrow(all_lec_results), "genes\n")
cat("DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison: ", nrow(diseased_lec_results), "genes\n")

# =============================================================================
# PREPARE GENE LISTS FOR PATHWAY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== PREPARING GENE LISTS ===\n")

# Function to extract significant gene lists
extract_gene_lists <- function(de_results, comparison_name, padj_threshold = 0.05, fc_threshold = 0.25) {

  # Filter significant genes
  sig_genes <- de_results[!is.na(de_results$padj) &
                         de_results$padj < padj_threshold &
                         abs(de_results$log2FoldChange) > fc_threshold, ]

  # Separate upregulated and downregulated
  lec6_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0, ]$gene
  lec1_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0, ]$gene

  cat(comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("  LEC6 upregulated genes:", length(lec6_up), "\n")
  cat("  LEC1 upregulated genes:", length(lec1_up), "\n")

  return(list(
    lec6_up = lec6_up,
    lec1_up = lec1_up,
    all_sig = sig_genes$gene
  ))
}

# Extract gene lists
all_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(all_lec_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison")
diseased_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(diseased_lec_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC6 comparison")

# =============================================================================
# CONVERT GENE SYMBOLS TO ENTREZ IDS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CONVERTING GENE SYMBOLS TO ENTREZ IDS ===\n")

# Function to convert symbols to Entrez IDs
convert_to_entrez <- function(gene_symbols, comparison_name) {

  # Remove any empty or NA values
  gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[!is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""]

  if(length(gene_symbols) == 0) {
    cat("No genes to convert for", comparison_name, "\n")
    return(character(0))
  }

  # Convert using bitr
  gene_conversion <- bitr(gene_symbols,
                         fromType = "SYMBOL",
                         toType = "ENTREZID",
                         OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

  cat(comparison_name, ": converted", nrow(gene_conversion), "out of", length(gene_symbols), "genes\n")

  return(gene_conversion$ENTREZID)
}

# Convert all gene lists
all_lec6_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(all_gene_lists$lec6_up, "ALL LEC6 up")
all_lec1_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, "ALL LEC1 up")

diseased_lec6_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_gene_lists$lec6_up, "DISEASED LEC6 up")
diseased_lec1_up_entrez <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up, "DISEASED LEC1 up")

# RUN GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS

cat("\n=== RUNNING GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to run GO enrichment
run_go_enrichment <- function(entrez_ids, comparison_name, universe = NULL) {

  if(length(entrez_ids) < 5) {
    cat("Skipping", comparison_name, "- too few genes (", length(entrez_ids), ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  cat("Running GO enrichment for", comparison_name, "with", length(entrez_ids), "genes\n")

  # Run GO enrichment for all three ontologies
  go_results <- list()

  for(ont in c("BP", "MF", "CC")) {
    tryCatch({
      ego <- enrichGO(gene = entrez_ids,
                     universe = universe,
                     OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                     ont = ont,
                     pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                     qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                     readable = TRUE)

      if(nrow(ego) > 0) {
        go_results[[ont]] <- ego
        cat("  ", ont, ": found", nrow(ego), "enriched terms\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error in", ont, "enrichment:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }

  return(go_results)
}

diseased_universe <- convert_to_entrez(diseased_lec_results$gene, "DISEASED universe")

go_all_lec1_up <- run_go_enrichment(all_lec1_up_entrez, "ALL LEC1 up", all_universe)

go_diseased_lec1_up <- run_go_enrichment(diseased_lec1_up_entrez, "DISEASED LEC1 up", diseased_universe)

cat("\n=== CREATING GO VISUALIZATION PLOTS ===\n")

# Function to create GO plots
create_go_plots <- function(go_result_list, title_prefix, save_prefix) {

  plots <- list()

  for(ont in names(go_result_list)) {
    ego <- go_result_list[[ont]]

    if(nrow(ego) > 0) {

      # Dot plot
      p_dot <- dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15) +
        ggtitle(paste(title_prefix, "-", ont)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

      plots[[paste(ont, "dot")]] <- p_dot
      print(p_dot)

      # Bar plot
      p_bar <- barplot(ego, showCategory = 10) +
        ggtitle(paste(title_prefix, "-", ont, "Top 10")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

      plots[[paste(ont, "bar")]] <- p_bar
      print(p_bar)

      # Save individual plots
      ggsave(paste0(save_prefix, "_", ont, "_dotplot.pdf"), p_dot, width = 12, height = 8)
      ggsave(paste0(save_prefix, "_", ont, "_barplot.pdf"), p_bar, width = 10, height = 8)
    }
  }

  return(plots)
}

cat("\n=== COMPARING PATHWAYS BETWEEN CONDITIONS ===\n")

# Function to extract top pathways for comparison
extract_top_pathways <- function(go_results, ont_type, top_n = 10) {

  if(is.null(go_results) || is.null(go_results[[ont_type]])) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  ego <- go_results[[ont_type]]

  if(nrow(ego) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  top_paths <- ego@result %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, Count) %>%
    mutate(
      Gene_Ratio_Numeric = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) {
        parts <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
        as.numeric(parts[1]) / as.numeric(parts[2])
      })
    )

  return(top_paths)
}

# Extract top biological process pathways for comparison
bp_comparisons <- list(
  "ALL_LEC6_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_all_lec6_up, "BP"),
  "ALL_LEC1_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_all_lec1_up, "BP"),
  "DISEASED_LEC6_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_diseased_lec6_up, "BP"),
  "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" = extract_top_pathways(go_diseased_lec1_up, "BP")
)

# Combine and save pathway comparison

for(comp_name in names(bp_comparisons)) {
  if(nrow(bp_comparisons[[comp_name]]) > 0) {
    pathways <- bp_comparisons[[comp_name]]
    pathways$Comparison <- comp_name
    bp_combined <- rbind(bp_combined, pathways)
  }
}

cat("\n=== PATHWAY OVERLAP ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to compare pathway overlaps
compare_pathway_overlaps <- function(go_results_list, ont = "BP") {

  # Extract pathway IDs from each comparison
  pathway_lists <- list()

  for(comp_name in names(go_results_list)) {
    if(!is.null(go_results_list[[comp_name]]) &&
       !is.null(go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]) &&
       nrow(go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]) > 0) {

      pathways <- go_results_list[[comp_name]][[ont]]@result
      significant_pathways <- pathways[pathways$p.adjust < 0.05, ]$ID
      pathway_lists[[comp_name]] <- significant_pathways

      cat(comp_name, ":", length(significant_pathways), "significant", ont, "pathways\n")
    }
  }

  return(pathway_lists)
}

# Compare biological process pathways

  "ALL_LEC1_UP" = go_all_lec1_up,
  "DISEASED_LEC6_UP" = go_diseased_lec6_up,
  "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" = go_diseased_lec1_up
)

bp_pathway_lists <- compare_pathway_overlaps(all_go_results, "BP")

# Find shared pathways
if(length(bp_pathway_lists) >= 2) {

  # Compare ALL vs DISEASED for each cluster
  if("ALL_LEC6_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "DISEASED_LEC6_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    lec6_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC6_UP, bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC6_UP)
    cat("LEC6 shared pathways (ALL vs DISEASED):", length(lec6_shared), "\n")
  }

  if("ALL_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "DISEASED_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    lec1_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC1_UP, bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC1_UP)
    cat("LEC1 shared pathways (ALL vs DISEASED):", length(lec1_shared), "\n")
  }

  # Compare LEC1 vs LEC6 within each condition
  if("ALL_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "ALL_LEC6_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    all_cluster_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC1_UP, bp_pathway_lists$ALL_LEC6_UP)
    cat("Shared pathways between clusters (ALL condition):", length(all_cluster_shared), "\n")
  }

  if("DISEASED_LEC1_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists) && "DISEASED_LEC6_UP" %in% names(bp_pathway_lists)) {
    diseased_cluster_shared <- intersect(bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC1_UP, bp_pathway_lists$DISEASED_LEC6_UP)
    cat("Shared pathways between clusters (DISEASED condition):", length(diseased_cluster_shared), "\n")
  }
}

# Function to save GO results as CSV
save_go_results <- function(go_results, file_prefix) {

  if(is.null(go_results)) {
    return()
  }

  for(ont in names(go_results)) {
    ego <- go_results[[ont]]

    if(nrow(ego) > 0) {
      go_df <- ego@result
      write.csv(go_df, paste0(file_prefix, "_", ont, "_GO_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }
}

# Function to get top pathway descriptions
get_top_pathway_names <- function(go_results, ont = "BP", top_n = 5) {

  if(is.null(go_results) || is.null(go_results[[ont]]) || nrow(go_results[[ont]]) == 0) {
    return("No significant pathways found")
  }

  top_paths <- go_results[[ont]]@result %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    pull(Description)

  return(paste(top_paths, collapse = "; "))
}
```

```{r}
# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  sce_LECs[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sce_LECs[["RNA"]])
}

# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARISON 1: ALL LEC1 vs ALL LEC5 (All Conditions) ===\n")

# Subset to LEC1 and LEC5, all conditions

cat("Cells in ALL LEC1 vs LEC5 comparison:\n")

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions combined
create_cluster_pseudobulk <- function(seurat_obj, comparison_name) {

  # Get expression matrix
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts", assay = "RNA")

  # Get metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  metadata$cell_id <- rownames(metadata)

  # Create sample IDs by donor and cluster (pooling across disease groups)
  metadata$sample_id <- paste(metadata$donor, metadata$LEC_subcluster, sep = "_")

  # Aggregate counts by sample
  pseudobulk_list <- list()
  sample_metadata <- data.frame()

  for(sample in unique(metadata$sample_id)) {
    # Get cells for this sample
    cells_in_sample <- metadata$cell_id[metadata$sample_id == sample]

    if(length(cells_in_sample) >= 5) {  # Minimum 5 cells per pseudobulk sample
      # Sum counts across cells
      pseudobulk_counts <- rowSums(expr_matrix[, cells_in_sample, drop = FALSE])
      pseudobulk_list[[sample]] <- pseudobulk_counts

      # Store sample metadata
      sample_info <- metadata[metadata$sample_id == sample, ][1, ]
      sample_metadata <- rbind(sample_metadata, data.frame(
        sample_id = sample,
        donor = sample_info$donor,
        cluster = sample_info$LEC_subcluster,
        cell_count = length(cells_in_sample),
        comparison = comparison_name
      ))
    }
  }

  # Convert to matrix
  pseudobulk_matrix <- do.call(cbind, pseudobulk_list)
  colnames(pseudobulk_matrix) <- names(pseudobulk_list)

  return(list(counts = pseudobulk_matrix, metadata = sample_metadata))
}

# Create pseudobulk for all conditions
all_pseudobulk <- create_cluster_pseudobulk(sce_all_comparison, "All_Conditions")
all_counts <- all_pseudobulk$counts
all_metadata <- all_pseudobulk$metadata

cat("Pseudobulk samples for ALL LEC1 vs LEC5 comparison:", ncol(all_counts), "\n")
cat("Sample distribution:\n")
print(table(all_metadata$cluster))

# Run DESeq2 for LEC1 vs LEC5 (all conditions)
run_cluster_deseq2 <- function(counts, metadata, comparison_name) {

  # Filter lowly expressed genes
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts >= 10) >= 3
  counts <- counts[keep_genes, ]

  cat("Analyzing", nrow(counts), "genes across", ncol(counts), "samples for", comparison_name, "\n")

  # Create DESeq2 dataset
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = metadata,
    design = ~ cluster
  )

  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Extract results (LEC5 vs LEC1)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("cluster", "LEC5", "LEC1"), alpha = 0.05)
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = rownames(.),
      comparison = comparison_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))

  return(res_df)
}

# Run analysis for all conditions
all_results <- run_cluster_deseq2(all_counts, all_metadata, "All_LEC1_vs_LEC5")

# CREATE ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS WITH BALANCED LABELING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING ENHANCED VOLCANO PLOTS ===\n")

create_enhanced_volcano <- function(de_results, title, top_genes_to_label = 15) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- de_results %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(padj) ~ "Not significant",
        padj >= 0.05 ~ "Not significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 0.5 ~ "Significant (low FC)",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.5 & abs(log2FoldChange) < 1 ~ "Significant",
        padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 ~ "Highly significant"
      ),
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj + 1e-300), 50),  # Cap at 50 to avoid plotting issues
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "LEC5 higher", "LEC1 higher")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))

  # Get top genes to label from BOTH sides
  # Top upregulated genes (LEC5 higher - right side)
  top_lec5_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Top downregulated genes (LEC1 higher - left side)
  top_lec1_genes <- plot_data %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(top_genes_to_label/2)

  # Combine genes from both sides
  genes_to_label <- unique(c(top_lec5_genes$gene, top_lec1_genes$gene))
  label_data <- plot_data[plot_data$gene %in% genes_to_label, ]

  # Count significant genes
  n_up_lec5 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_up_lec1 <- sum(plot_data$padj < 0.05 & plot_data$log2FoldChange < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Create subtitle with counts
  subtitle <- paste0("LEC5 higher: ", n_up_lec5, " genes | LEC1 higher: ", n_up_lec1, " genes")

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = significance), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Not significant" = "gray80",
      "Significant (low FC)" = "lightblue",
      "Significant" = "orange",
      "Highly significant" = "red"
    )) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_data, aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 25,
                    box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1),
               linetype = c("dashed", "dotted", "dotted", "dashed"),
               alpha = 0.6, color = c("red", "blue", "blue", "red")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste("Total genes:", nrow(plot_data)),
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (LEC5 vs LEC1)",
      y = "-Log10 (Adjusted P-value)",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    xlim(c(-max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
           max(abs(plot_data$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1))

  return(p)
}

# Create the two volcano plots for LEC1 vs LEC5
volcano_all <- create_enhanced_volcano(
  all_results,
  "ALL LEC1 vs LEC5 (All Conditions)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20
)

volcano_diseased <- create_enhanced_volcano(
  diseased_results,
  "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC5 (IPF + SSc-ILD only)",
  top_genes_to_label = 20
)

# Display plots
print(volcano_all)
print(volcano_diseased)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS AND TOP GENES
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")

# Function to summarize results
summarize_results <- function(results, comparison_name) {
  sig_results <- results[!is.na(results$padj) & results$padj < 0.05, ]

  cat("\n", comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("Total genes tested:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(sig_results), "\n")
  cat("LEC5 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
  cat("LEC1 higher:", sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
  cat("Highly significant (|FC| >= 1):", sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1), "\n")

  # Top upregulated in each cluster
  lec5_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  lec1_up <- sig_results[sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0, ] %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(10)

  if(nrow(lec5_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC5:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec5_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec5_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, gene_info$log2FoldChange, gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  if(nrow(lec1_up) > 0) {
    cat("\nTop genes higher in LEC1:\n")
    for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(lec1_up))) {
      gene_info <- lec1_up[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("  %s: FC=%.2f, padj=%.2e\n",
                 gene_info$gene, abs(gene_info$log2FoldChange), gene_info$padj))
    }
  }

  return(list(
    total = nrow(results),
    significant = nrow(sig_results),
    lec5_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange > 0),
    lec1_higher = sum(sig_results$log2FoldChange < 0),
    high_fc = sum(abs(sig_results$log2FoldChange) >= 1)
  ))
}

# Summarize both comparisons
all_summary <- summarize_results(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC5")
diseased_summary <- summarize_results(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC5")

# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save DE results
write.csv(all_results, "ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(diseased_results, "DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5_DE_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save volcano plots
ggsave("ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano.pdf", volcano_all, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano.pdf", volcano_diseased, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Create and save summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5", "DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5"),
  Total_genes = c(all_summary$total, diseased_summary$total),
  Significant_genes = c(all_summary$significant, diseased_summary$significant),
  LEC5_higher = c(all_summary$lec5_higher, diseased_summary$lec5_higher),
  LEC1_higher = c(all_summary$lec1_higher, diseased_summary$lec1_higher),
  High_FC_genes = c(all_summary$high_fc, diseased_summary$high_fc)
)

write.csv(summary_stats, "LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano_Summary_Stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save top genes for each comparison
top_all <- all_results[!is.na(all_results$padj) & all_results$padj < 0.05, ] %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(50)

top_diseased <- diseased_results[!is.na(diseased_results$padj) & diseased_results$padj < 0.05, ] %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(50)

write.csv(top_all, "TOP_50_ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_diseased, "TOP_50_DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# GENE LIST EXTRACTION FOR GO ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== EXTRACTING GENE LISTS FOR POTENTIAL GO ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to extract significant gene lists
extract_gene_lists <- function(de_results, comparison_name, padj_threshold = 0.05, fc_threshold = 0.25) {

  # Filter significant genes
  sig_genes <- de_results[!is.na(de_results$padj) &
                         de_results$padj < padj_threshold &
                         abs(de_results$log2FoldChange) > fc_threshold, ]

  # Separate upregulated and downregulated
  lec5_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange > 0, ]$gene
  lec1_up <- sig_genes[sig_genes$log2FoldChange < 0, ]$gene

  cat(comparison_name, ":\n")
  cat("  LEC5 upregulated genes:", length(lec5_up), "\n")
  cat("  LEC1 upregulated genes:", length(lec1_up), "\n")

  # Save gene lists
  if(length(lec5_up) > 0) {
    write.csv(data.frame(gene = lec5_up),
             paste0(gsub(" ", "_", comparison_name), "_LEC5_upregulated_genes.csv"),
             row.names = FALSE)
  }

  if(length(lec1_up) > 0) {
    write.csv(data.frame(gene = lec1_up),
             paste0(gsub(" ", "_", comparison_name), "_LEC1_upregulated_genes.csv"),
             row.names = FALSE)
  }

  return(list(
    lec5_up = lec5_up,
    lec1_up = lec1_up,
    all_sig = sig_genes$gene
  ))
}

# Extract gene lists for both comparisons
all_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(all_results, "ALL LEC1 vs LEC5")
diseased_gene_lists <- extract_gene_lists(diseased_results, "DISEASED LEC1 vs LEC5")

# =============================================================================
# COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS: ALL vs DISEASED ===\n")

# Compare shared vs unique genes between ALL and DISEASED conditions
if(length(all_gene_lists$lec5_up) > 0 && length(diseased_gene_lists$lec5_up) > 0) {
  lec5_shared <- intersect(all_gene_lists$lec5_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec5_up)
  lec5_all_unique <- setdiff(all_gene_lists$lec5_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec5_up)
  lec5_diseased_unique <- setdiff(diseased_gene_lists$lec5_up, all_gene_lists$lec5_up)

  cat("LEC5 upregulated genes:\n")
  cat("  Shared (ALL & DISEASED):", length(lec5_shared), "\n")
  cat("  ALL conditions only:", length(lec5_all_unique), "\n")
  cat("  DISEASED only:", length(lec5_diseased_unique), "\n")
}

if(length(all_gene_lists$lec1_up) > 0 && length(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up) > 0) {
  lec1_shared <- intersect(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up)
  lec1_all_unique <- setdiff(all_gene_lists$lec1_up, diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up)
  lec1_diseased_unique <- setdiff(diseased_gene_lists$lec1_up, all_gene_lists$lec1_up)

  cat("LEC1 upregulated genes:\n")
  cat("  Shared (ALL & DISEASED):", length(lec1_shared), "\n")
  cat("  ALL conditions only:", length(lec1_all_unique), "\n")
  cat("  DISEASED only:", length(lec1_diseased_unique), "\n")
}

cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("- ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano.pdf\n")
cat("- DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano.pdf\n")
cat("- ALL_LEC1_vs_LEC5_DE_results.csv\n")
cat("- DISEASED_LEC1_vs_LEC5_DE_results.csv\n")
cat("- LEC1_vs_LEC5_Volcano_Summary_Stats.csv\n")
cat("- TOP_50_*.csv files\n")
cat("- Gene lists: *_upregulated_genes.csv files\n")

cat("\n=== LEC1 vs LEC5 PSEUDOBULK ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# Immune Cell Extraction and Clustering Analysis
# =============================================================================

library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA AND EXTRACT IMMUNE CELLS
# =============================================================================

cat("Loading combined dataset and extracting immune cells...\n")

# Load the combined dataset
combined_seurat <- readRDS("GSE159354_ThreeGroup_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")

cat("Total cells in combined dataset:", ncol(combined_seurat), "\n")
cat("Cell types in dataset:\n")
print(table(combined_seurat$cellset))

# Extract only immune cells
immune_cells <- subset(combined_seurat, subset = cellset == "Immune")

cat("Immune cells extracted:", ncol(immune_cells), "\n")
cat("Immune cells by disease group:\n")
print(table(immune_cells$group))

cat("Immune cells by donor:\n")
print(table(immune_cells$donor))

cat("Immune cells by fraction:\n")
print(table(immune_cells$fraction))

# Check if we have sufficient cells for analysis
if(ncol(immune_cells) < 100) {
  stop("Too few immune cells for meaningful clustering analysis")
}

# =============================================================================
# RE-PROCESS IMMUNE CELLS FOR CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== RE-PROCESSING IMMUNE CELLS FOR CLUSTERING ===\n")

# Clear existing reductions to start fresh
immune_cells@reductions <- list()

# Set default assay
DefaultAssay(immune_cells) <- "RNA"

# Join layers for Seurat v5 compatibility
if(packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0") {
  immune_cells[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(immune_cells[["RNA"]])
}

# Normalize data
cat("Normalizing immune cell data...\n")
immune_cells <- NormalizeData(immune_cells, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                             scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)

# Find variable features
cat("Finding variable features...\n")
immune_cells <- FindVariableFeatures(immune_cells, selection.method = "vst",
                                    nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)

# Scale data
cat("Scaling immune cell data...\n")
immune_cells <- ScaleData(immune_cells, verbose = FALSE)

# Run PCA
cat("Running PCA...\n")
n_pcs <- min(50, ncol(immune_cells) - 1, nrow(immune_cells) - 1)
immune_cells <- RunPCA(immune_cells, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)

cat("Using", n_pcs, "principal components\n")

# =============================================================================
# HARMONY BATCH CORRECTION FOR IMMUNE CELLS
# =============================================================================

cat("Running Harmony batch correction for immune cells...\n")

# Run Harmony to correct for donor and fraction effects
immune_cells <- RunHarmony(immune_cells,
                          group.by.vars = c("donor", "fraction"),
                          verbose = TRUE)

# =============================================================================
# UMAP AND CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

cat("Running UMAP and clustering...\n")

# Run UMAP
immune_cells <- RunUMAP(immune_cells, reduction = "harmony",
                       dims = 1:min(30, n_pcs), verbose = FALSE)

# Find neighbors
immune_cells <- FindNeighbors(immune_cells, reduction = "harmony",
                             dims = 1:min(30, n_pcs), verbose = FALSE)

# Test different resolutions for clustering
resolutions <- c(0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, 1.3)
cat("Testing different clustering resolutions:\n")

for(res in resolutions) {
  immune_cells <- FindClusters(immune_cells, resolution = res, verbose = FALSE)
  n_clusters <- length(unique(Idents(immune_cells)))
  cat("Resolution", res, ":", n_clusters, "clusters\n")
}

# Choose optimal resolution (adjust based on your preference - aim for 8-15 clusters typically)
selected_resolution <- 0.8
immune_cells <- FindClusters(immune_cells, resolution = selected_resolution, verbose = FALSE)

# Rename clusters for clarity
n_clusters <- length(unique(Idents(immune_cells)))
cluster_names <- paste0("IMM", 0:(n_clusters-1))
names(cluster_names) <- levels(Idents(immune_cells))
immune_cells <- RenameIdents(immune_cells, cluster_names)
immune_cells$immune_cluster <- Idents(immune_cells)

cat("Immune cell clustering complete. Found", n_clusters, "clusters:",
    paste(levels(immune_cells$immune_cluster), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# CREATE VISUALIZATIONS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== CREATING IMMUNE CELL VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Define colors
group_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2CA02C", "IPF" = "#FF7F00", "SSc-ILD" = "#9467BD")

# Generate colors for immune clusters
if(n_clusters <= 12) {
  immune_colors <- brewer.pal(max(3, n_clusters), "Set3")[1:n_clusters]
} else {
  immune_colors <- rainbow(n_clusters)
}
names(immune_colors) <- levels(immune_cells$immune_cluster)

# 1. UMAP colored by immune clusters
p1_immune <- DimPlot(immune_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "immune_cluster",
                    cols = immune_colors, label = TRUE, label.size = 5, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("Immune Cell Clusters") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

print(p1_immune)

# 2. UMAP colored by disease group
p2_immune <- DimPlot(immune_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "group",
                    cols = group_colors, pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("Immune Cells by Disease Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

print(p2_immune)

# 3. Split by disease group
p3_immune <- DimPlot(immune_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "immune_cluster",
                    split.by = "group", cols = immune_colors,
                    label = TRUE, label.size = 4, pt.size = 0.8, ncol = 3) +
  ggtitle("Immune Clusters by Disease Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p3_immune)

# 4. UMAP colored by donor
p4_immune <- DimPlot(immune_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = "donor",
                    pt.size = 1.0) +
  ggtitle("Immune Cells by Donor") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p4_immune)

# =============================================================================
# CLUSTER COMPOSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== IMMUNE CLUSTER COMPOSITION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Show cluster sizes
cat("Immune cluster sizes:\n")
immune_cluster_table <- table(immune_cells$immune_cluster)
print(immune_cluster_table)

# Show composition by group
cat("Immune clusters by disease group:\n")
immune_group_table <- table(immune_cells$immune_cluster, immune_cells$group)
print(immune_group_table)

# Calculate proportions within each cluster
immune_group_props <- prop.table(immune_group_table, margin = 1) * 100
cat("Percentages within each immune cluster:\n")

# Show composition by donor
cat("Immune clusters by donor:\n")
immune_donor_table <- table(immune_cells$immune_cluster, immune_cells$donor)
print(immune_donor_table)

# Create composition bar plot
immune_prop_df <- as.data.frame(immune_group_props)
colnames(immune_prop_df) <- c("Immune_Cluster", "Group", "Percentage")

p5_immune <- ggplot(immune_prop_df, aes(x = Immune_Cluster, y = Percentage, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.7) +

cat("\n=== SAVING IMMUNE CLUSTERING RESULTS ===\n")

# Save the immune cell object
saveRDS(immune_cells, "immune_cells_clustered.rds")

# Save plots
ggsave("Immune_Clusters_UMAP.pdf", p1_immune, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("Immune_by_Group_UMAP.pdf", p2_immune, width = 10, height = 8)

# =============================================================================
# IMMUNE CELL TYPE IDENTIFICATION MARKERS
# =============================================================================

cat("\n=== IMMUNE CELL TYPE IDENTIFICATION ===\n")

# Define marker gene sets for major immune cell types
immune_marker_sets <- list(
  "T_cells" = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G"),
  "CD4_T_cells" = c("CD4", "IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD8_T_cells" = c("CD8A", "CD8B", "GZMK"),
  "NK_cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7", "GZMB", "PRF1", "KLRD1"),
  "B_cells" = c("MS4A1", "CD19", "IGHM", "IGHD"),
  "Plasma_cells" = c("IGHG1", "IGHG3", "MZB1", "SDC1"),
  "Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ", "S100A8", "S100A9"),
  "Macrophages" = c("CD68", "CD163", "MRC1", "MARCO"),
  "Dendritic_cells" = c("CLEC4C", "IRF8", "CLEC9A", "CD1C"),
  "Neutrophils" = c("FCGR3B", "CEACAM8", "CSF3R")
)

# Calculate average expression for each marker set
marker_expression <- data.frame()

for(cell_type in names(immune_marker_sets)) {
  markers <- immune_marker_sets[[cell_type]]
  available_markers <- intersect(markers, rownames(immune_cells))

  if(length(available_markers) > 0) {
    # Calculate average expression across clusters
    avg_exp <- AverageExpression(immune_cells,
                               features = available_markers,
                               group.by = "immune_cluster",
                               slot = "data")$RNA

    # Average across markers for this cell type
    if(length(available_markers) == 1) {
      cell_type_score <- avg_exp[1, ]
    } else {
      cell_type_score <- colMeans(avg_exp)
    }

    # Add to summary
    for(cluster in names(cell_type_score)) {
      marker_expression <- rbind(marker_expression, data.frame(
        cluster = cluster,
        cell_type = cell_type,
        avg_expression = cell_type_score[[cluster]],
        markers_available = paste(available_markers, collapse = ", ")
      ))
    }
  }
}

# Find predicted cell type for each cluster
if(nrow(marker_expression) > 0) {
  cluster_predictions <- marker_expression %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(avg_expression, n = 1) %>%
    select(cluster, predicted_type = cell_type, expression_score = avg_expression)

  cat("Predicted immune cell types by cluster:\n")
  print(cluster_predictions)

  # Save predictions
  write.csv(marker_expression, "immune_cluster_marker_expression.csv", row.names = FALSE)

}
```

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(harmony)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ── 1) Load the clean EC+Immune object ─────────────────────────────────────────
# If the object is already in memory, this keeps it. Otherwise it loads from disk.
if (!exists("clean_lung_seurat")) {
  obj_path <- "GSE159354_Clean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds"
  if (!file.exists(obj_path)) stop("Cannot find '", obj_path, "' in the working directory.")
  clean_lung_seurat <- readRDS(obj_path)
}

# ── 2) Subset to IMMUNE only ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
immune_seurat <- subset(clean_lung_seurat, subset = cellset == "Immune")
stopifnot(ncol(immune_seurat) > 0)

# Seurat v5 layered assay? Join layers before PCA/Harmony
if (packageVersion("Seurat") >= "5.0.0" && inherits(immune_seurat[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) {
  immune_seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(immune_seurat[["RNA"]])
}

# ── 3) Prepare metadata; keep only covariates that actually vary ───────────────
meta_candidates <- intersect(c("donor","group","fraction","gsm"), colnames(immune_seurat@meta.data))

# Make them clean factors (replace NA with "Unknown", drop unused levels)
for (v in meta_candidates) {
  x <- as.character(immune_seurat[[v]][,1])
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Unknown"
  immune_seurat[[v]] <- droplevels(factor(x))
}

# Count levels and pick those with ≥ 2 levels
lev_counts <- sapply(meta_candidates, function(v) nlevels(immune_seurat[[v]]))
vars_for_harmony <- names(lev_counts[lev_counts >= 2])

cat("\n=== HARMONY COVARIATE CHECK (Immune subset) ===\n")
print(lev_counts)
cat("Using for Harmony:", ifelse(length(vars_for_harmony) > 0, paste(vars_for_harmony, collapse = ", "), "NONE (skip Harmony)"), "\n\n")

# ── 4) Standard preprocessing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
DefaultAssay(immune_seurat) <- "RNA"
immune_seurat <- NormalizeData(immune_seurat, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                               scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
immune_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(immune_seurat, nfeatures = 3000,
                                      selection.method = "vst", verbose = FALSE)
immune_seurat <- ScaleData(immune_seurat, verbose = FALSE)
immune_seurat <- RunPCA(immune_seurat, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

# ── 5) Harmony if possible; otherwise skip ─────────────────────────────────────
if (length(vars_for_harmony) >= 1) {
  message("Running Harmony over: ", paste(vars_for_harmony, collapse = ", "))
  # Note: we rely on default dims for compatibility across Seurat/Harmony versions
  immune_seurat <- RunHarmony(immune_seurat, group.by.vars = vars_for_harmony, verbose = TRUE)
  immune_seurat <- RunUMAP(immune_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
  immune_seurat <- FindNeighbors(immune_seurat, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
} else {
  message("No covariate has ≥2 levels in the Immune subset; skipping Harmony.")
  immune_seurat <- RunUMAP(immune_seurat, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  immune_seurat <- FindNeighbors(immune_seurat, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
}

immune_seurat <- FindClusters(immune_seurat, resolution = 0.6)

# ── 6) Quick visuals & save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_by_group   <- DimPlot(immune_seurat, reduction = "umap", group.by = "group") +
  ggtitle("Immune cells: UMAP by disease group")

p_clusters   <- DimPlot(immune_seurat, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Immune cells: UMAP by clusters")

print(p_by_group)
print(p_clusters)

saveRDS(immune_seurat, file = "Immune_only_seurat_processed.rds")
ggsave("Immune_UMAP_by_group.pdf",   p_by_group, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("Immune_UMAP_clusters.pdf",   p_clusters, width = 8, height = 6)

cat("\n=== DONE ===\nSaved object: Immune_only_seurat_processed.rds\n",
    "Plots: Immune_UMAP_by_group.pdf, Immune_UMAP_clusters.pdf\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
resolutions <- c(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2)

}

# UMAP colored by donor

                    ggtitle("Immune Cells: Donors") +

# Create disease status for CTRL vs Disease comparison
immune_seurat$disease_status <- ifelse(immune_seurat$group == "CTRL", "CTRL", "Disease")

# CTRL vs Disease plot

print(immune_cluster_plot)

}

# Print all resolution plots
for (plot in res_plots) {
  print(plot)
}

# ===== 8) Summary statistics =====

  group_by(RNA_snn_res.0.8, group) %>%

  mutate(Total = CTRL + IPF + `SSc-ILD`) %>%

cat("Cluster distribution by disease group:\n")

# Summary by resolution

}
```

```{r}
# ── 8) DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS ────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== RUNNING DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Finding markers for each immune cell cluster...\n")

# Find all markers for each cluster
# This may take several minutes depending on the number of cells
immune_markers <- FindAllMarkers(immune_seurat,
                                only.pos = TRUE,           # Only positive markers
                                min.pct = 0.25,            # Gene must be expressed in 25% of cells
                                logfc.threshold = 0.25,    # Minimum log fold change
                                verbose = TRUE)

# Check the results
cat("Total marker genes found:", nrow(immune_markers), "\n")
cat("Clusters analyzed:", length(unique(immune_markers$cluster)), "\n")

# Display top markers per cluster
top_markers_summary <- immune_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_markers = n(),
    top_gene = gene[which.max(avg_log2FC)],
    max_logfc = max(avg_log2FC),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(cluster))

cat("\n=== TOP MARKER SUMMARY BY CLUSTER ===\n")
print(top_markers_summary)

# ── 9) SELECT TOP 10 MARKERS PER CLUSTER ───────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nSelecting top 10 upregulated genes per cluster...\n")

# Get top 10 markers per cluster based on avg_log2FC
top10_markers <- immune_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(10, avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

# Create a unique list of genes for the heatmap
heatmap_genes <- unique(top10_markers$gene)
cat("Total unique genes for heatmap:", length(heatmap_genes), "\n")

# Save the marker results
write.csv(immune_markers, "Immune_all_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top10_markers, "Immune_top10_markers_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ── 10) CREATE HEATMAP OF TOP CLUSTER MARKERS ──────────────────────────────────
cat("\nCreating heatmap of top cluster markers...\n")

# Calculate average expression of marker genes per cluster
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(immune_seurat,
                            features = heatmap_genes,
                            group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.8",
                            slot = "data")$RNA

# Z-score normalize across clusters (rows = genes, cols = clusters)
avg_exp_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp)))

# Handle any NaN values (replace with 0)
avg_exp_scaled[!is.finite(avg_exp_scaled)] <- 0

# Create cluster annotation
cluster_names <- colnames(avg_exp_scaled)
cluster_annotation <- data.frame(
  Cluster = paste("Cluster", cluster_names),
  row.names = cluster_names
)

# Create a discrete color palette for clusters
n_clusters <- ncol(avg_exp_scaled)
cluster_colors <- rainbow(n_clusters, start = 0, end = 0.8)
names(cluster_colors) <- paste("Cluster", cluster_names)

annotation_colors <- list(Cluster = cluster_colors)

# ── 11) PLOT HEATMAP USING PHEATMAP ────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Generating heatmap...\n")

# Create the heatmap
marker_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  avg_exp_scaled,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,          # Cluster genes
  cluster_cols = FALSE,         # Keep cluster order
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  border_color = "grey60",
  annotation_col = cluster_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Top 10 Marker Genes per Immune Cell Cluster",
  angle_col = 45
)

# ── 12) ALTERNATIVE HEATMAP: TOP 5 MARKERS ONLY ───────────────────────────────
cat("Creating simplified heatmap with top 5 markers per cluster...\n")

# Get top 5 markers per cluster for a cleaner visualization
top5_markers <- immune_markers %>%

heatmap_genes_top5 <- unique(top5_markers$gene)

# Calculate average expression for top 5 markers
```

```{r}
# ===== CREATE READABLE HEATMAP WITH TOP 10 MARKERS =====
library(pheatmap)

# Get top 10 markers per cluster (assuming immune_markers already exists)
top10_markers <- immune_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(10, avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

heatmap_genes_top10 <- unique(top10_markers$gene)

# Calculate average expression per cluster
avg_exp_top10 <- AverageExpression(immune_seurat,
                                  features = heatmap_genes_top10,
                                  group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.8",
                                  slot = "data")$RNA

# Z-score normalize
avg_exp_top10_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_exp_top10)))
avg_exp_top10_scaled[!is.finite(avg_exp_top10_scaled)] <- 0

# Create cluster annotation
cluster_annotation <- data.frame(
  Cluster = paste("Cluster", colnames(avg_exp_top10_scaled)),
  row.names = colnames(avg_exp_top10_scaled)
)

# ===== SAVE AS READABLE PDF =====
# Make PDF even taller for more genes and adjust spacing
pdf("Readable_Top10_Immune_Markers_Heatmap.pdf", height = 55, width = 12)

pheatmap(
  avg_exp_top10_scaled,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 12,        # Larger font for gene names
  fontsize_col = 14,        # Larger font for cluster names
  border_color = "grey60",
  annotation_col = cluster_annotation,
  main = "Top 10 Marker Genes per Immune Cell Cluster",
  angle_col = 0,           # Horizontal cluster labels
  cellwidth = 25,          # Wider cells
  cellheight = 15          # Taller cells for better spacing
)

dev.off()

cat("Readable top 10 heatmap saved as: Readable_Top10_Immune_Markers_Heatmap.pdf\n")
cat("Dimensions: 30 inches tall x 12 inches wide for easy reading\n")
```

```{r}

# ===== REMOVE SPECIFIED CLUSTERS AND CREATE NEW UMAPS =====
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ===== 1) Remove clusters 13, 20, 22, and 24 =====
clusters_to_remove <- c("13", "20", "22", "24")

cat("Original immune object:\n")
cat("Total cells:", ncol(immune_seurat), "\n")
cat("Clusters present:", paste(sort(unique(immune_seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.8)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Subset to keep only desired clusters
immune_filtered <- subset(immune_seurat,
                         subset = RNA_snn_res.0.8 %in% setdiff(levels(immune_seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.8),
                                                              clusters_to_remove))

cat("\nFiltered immune object:\n")
cat("Total cells:", ncol(immune_filtered), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", ncol(immune_seurat) - ncol(immune_filtered), "\n")
cat("Remaining clusters:", paste(sort(unique(immune_filtered$RNA_snn_res.0.8)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ===== 2) Create disease status column =====
immune_filtered$disease_status <- ifelse(immune_filtered$group == "CTRL", "CTRL", "Disease")
immune_filtered$disease_status <- factor(immune_filtered$disease_status, levels = c("CTRL", "Disease"))

# ===== 3) Create UMAP: Disease Groups =====
immune_groups_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                             group.by = "group",
                             reduction = "umap",
                             cols = c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57", "IPF" = "#9370DB", "SSc-ILD" = "#DC143C")) +
                     ggtitle("Filtered Immune Cells: Disease Groups") +
                     theme_minimal() +
                     theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

print(immune_groups_plot)

# ===== 4) Create UMAP: CTRL vs Disease =====
immune_ctrl_disease_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                                   group.by = "disease_status",
                                   reduction = "umap",
                                   cols = c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57", "Disease" = "#DC143C")) +
                           ggtitle("Filtered Immune Cells: CTRL vs Disease") +
                           theme_minimal() +
                           theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

print(immune_ctrl_disease_plot)

# ===== 5) Create clusters plot for reference =====
immune_clusters_filtered_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                                        group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.8",
                                        reduction = "umap",
                                        label = TRUE,
                                        label.size = 4) +
                                ggtitle("Filtered Immune Cells: Clusters (without 13, 20, 22, 24)") +
                                theme_minimal() +
                                theme(legend.position = "none",
                                      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14))

print(immune_clusters_filtered_plot)

# ===== 6) Summary statistics =====
cat("\n=== FILTERED IMMUNE CELL SUMMARY ===\n")

# Cell counts by disease group
group_summary <- immune_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(percentage = round((n_cells / sum(n_cells)) * 100, 1))

print(group_summary)

# Cell counts by CTRL vs Disease
disease_summary <- immune_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(disease_status) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(percentage = round((n_cells / sum(n_cells)) * 100, 1))

print(disease_summary)

# Remaining cluster distribution
cluster_summary <- immune_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(RNA_snn_res.0.8) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(RNA_snn_res.0.8))

print(cluster_summary)

# ===== 7) Save results =====
# Save filtered object
saveRDS(immune_filtered, file = "Immune_Filtered_NoContamination.rds")

# Save individual plots
ggsave("Filtered_Immune_Disease_Groups.pdf", immune_groups_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("Filtered_Immune_CTRL_vs_Disease.pdf", immune_ctrl_disease_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("Filtered_Immune_Clusters.pdf", immune_clusters_filtered_plot, width = 10, height = 8)

# Create combined plot PDF
pdf("Filtered_Immune_Analysis.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)

print(immune_groups_plot)
print(immune_ctrl_disease_plot)
print(immune_clusters_filtered_plot)

# Create side-by-side comparison
library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(immune_groups_plot, immune_ctrl_disease_plot, ncol = 2,
            top = "Filtered Immune Cell Analysis (Clusters 13, 20, 22, 24 Removed)")

dev.off()

# ===== 8) Final summary =====
cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Removed clusters: 13 (epithelial contamination), 20 (unknown), 22 (proliferating B cells), 24 (mast/basophils)\n")
cat("Remaining cells:", ncol(immune_filtered), "\n")
cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("  - Immune_Filtered_NoContamination.rds\n")
cat("  - Filtered_Immune_Disease_Groups.pdf\n")
cat("  - Filtered_Immune_CTRL_vs_Disease.pdf\n")
cat("  - Filtered_Immune_Analysis.pdf (combined)\n")

cat("\nFiltered dataset ready for downstream analysis!\n")

```

```{r}

# ===== USE SEURAT'S BUILT-IN RENAMING FUNCTIONS =====
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load original immune object
if (file.exists("Immune_only_seurat_processed.rds")) {
  immune_seurat_original <- readRDS("Immune_only_seurat_processed.rds")
} else {
  clean_lung_seurat <- readRDS("GSE159354_Clean_EC-Immune_harmony.rds")
  immune_seurat_original <- subset(clean_lung_seurat, subset = cellset == "Immune")
}

cat("Original clusters:", paste(sort(unique(immune_seurat_original$RNA_snn_res.0.8)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Remove specified clusters
clusters_to_remove <- c("13", "20", "22", "24")
immune_filtered <- subset(immune_seurat_original,
                         subset = RNA_snn_res.0.8 %in% setdiff(levels(immune_seurat_original$RNA_snn_res.0.8),
                                                              clusters_to_remove))

cat("After filtering clusters:", paste(sort(unique(immune_filtered$RNA_snn_res.0.8)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ===== USE RenameIdents() TO RENAME CLUSTERS =====
# Set the current clustering as active identity
Idents(immune_filtered) <- immune_filtered$RNA_snn_res.0.8

# Get remaining clusters in order
remaining_clusters <- sort(as.numeric(levels(immune_filtered$RNA_snn_res.0.8)))
cat("Remaining clusters:", paste(remaining_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Create renaming vector: old_name = new_name
new_names <- 0:(length(remaining_clusters) - 1)
rename_vector <- setNames(as.character(new_names), as.character(remaining_clusters))

cat("Renaming mapping:\n")
for (i in 1:length(rename_vector)) {
  cat("  Cluster", names(rename_vector)[i], "-> Cluster", rename_vector[i], "\n")
}

# Apply the renaming using RenameIdents
immune_filtered <- RenameIdents(immune_filtered, rename_vector)

# Add the new cluster names to metadata
immune_filtered$renamed_clusters <- Idents(immune_filtered)

cat("Renaming complete! New clusters:", paste(sort(unique(Idents(immune_filtered))), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ===== CREATE DISEASE STATUS =====
immune_filtered$disease_status <- ifelse(immune_filtered$group == "CTRL", "CTRL", "Disease")
immune_filtered$disease_status <- factor(immune_filtered$disease_status, levels = c("CTRL", "Disease"))

# ===== CREATE PLOTS =====
clusters_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                        reduction = "umap",
                        label = TRUE,
                        label.size = 4) +
                 ggtitle("Renumbered Immune Clusters (0-20)") +
                 theme_minimal() +
                 theme(legend.position = "none")

disease_groups_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                              group.by = "group",
                              reduction = "umap",
                              cols = c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57", "IPF" = "#9370DB", "SSc-ILD" = "#DC143C")) +
                      ggtitle("Immune Cells: Disease Groups") +
                      theme_minimal()

ctrl_disease_plot <- DimPlot(immune_filtered,
                            group.by = "disease_status",
                            reduction = "umap",
                            cols = c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57", "Disease" = "#DC143C")) +
                    ggtitle("Immune Cells: CTRL vs Disease") +
                    theme_minimal()

print(clusters_plot)
print(disease_groups_plot)
print(ctrl_disease_plot)

# ===== SUMMARY TABLE =====
cat("\n=== CLUSTER RENAMING SUMMARY ===\n")
cluster_counts <- table(Idents(immune_filtered))
print(cluster_counts)

disease_summary <- immune_filtered@meta.data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(percentage = round((n_cells / sum(n_cells)) * 100, 1))

cat("\nDisease group distribution:\n")
print(disease_summary)

# ===== SAVE RESULTS =====
saveRDS(immune_filtered, file = "Immune_Renamed_0to20_Final.rds")

ggsave("Final_Renumbered_Clusters.pdf", clusters_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("Final_Disease_Groups.pdf", disease_groups_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
ggsave("Final_CTRL_vs_Disease.pdf", ctrl_disease_plot, width = 10, height = 8)

# Create combined PDF
pdf("Final_Immune_Analysis_Renamed.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
print(clusters_plot)
print(disease_groups_plot)
print(ctrl_disease_plot)

library(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(disease_groups_plot, ctrl_disease_plot, ncol = 2,
            top = "Immune Cells: Disease Analysis (Renumbered Clusters)")
dev.off()

# ===== FINAL SUCCESS MESSAGE =====
cat("\n=== SUCCESS! CLUSTERS RENUMBERED ===\n")
cat("Clusters successfully renamed from 0-", length(remaining_clusters)-1, "\n")
cat("Total cells:", ncol(immune_filtered), "\n")
cat("Active identity now contains renumbered clusters\n")
cat("Files saved with 'Final_' prefix\n")

# Update your main object
immune_seurat <- immune_filtered
cat("\n'immune_seurat' now has properly renumbered clusters!\n")
```

```{r}

# ===== CLEAN IMMUNE CLUSTER DISEASE COMPOSITION PLOT =====
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ===== 1) Use existing composition data =====
# (assuming composition_data already exists from previous code)

# If composition_data doesn't exist, recreate it
if (!exists("composition_data")) {
  composition_data <- immune_seurat@meta.data %>%
    mutate(cluster = as.character(renamed_clusters)) %>%
    group_by(cluster, group) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    mutate(
      total_in_cluster = sum(n_cells),
      percentage = (n_cells / total_in_cluster) * 100
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    complete(cluster, group, fill = list(n_cells = 0, percentage = 0)) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    mutate(total_in_cluster = sum(n_cells[n_cells > 0])) %>%
    mutate(percentage = ifelse(total_in_cluster > 0, (n_cells / total_in_cluster) * 100, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()

  composition_data$cluster <- factor(composition_data$cluster,
                                    levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(composition_data$cluster)))))
}

# ===== 2) Create clean stacked bar plot =====
# Define colors
disease_colors <- c("CTRL" = "#2E8B57",      # Green
                   "IPF" = "#FF8C00",        # Orange
                   "SSc-ILD" = "#8A2BE2")    # Purple

clean_composition_plot <- ggplot(composition_data, aes(x = cluster, y = percentage, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           color = "white",
           size = 0.3,
           width = 0.8) +  # Make bars wider
  scale_fill_manual(values = disease_colors,
                   name = "Disease Group") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Immune Cell Cluster",
    y = "Percentage",
    title = "Disease Group Composition by Immune Cell Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, color = "black", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )

print(clean_composition_plot)

# ===== 3) Save the clean plot =====
ggsave("Clean_Immune_Cluster_Disease_Composition.pdf", clean_composition_plot,
       width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggsave("Clean_Immune_Cluster_Disease_Composition.png", clean_composition_plot,
       width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# ===== 4) Alternative version with even wider bars =====
extra_wide_plot <- ggplot(composition_data, aes(x = cluster, y = percentage, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           color = "white",
           size = 0.2,
           width = 0.9) +  # Even wider bars
  scale_fill_manual(values = disease_colors,
                   name = "Disease Group") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                    expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Immune Cell Cluster",
    y = "Percentage",
    title = "Disease Group Composition by Immune Cell Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.4)
  )

ggsave("Extra_Wide_Immune_Composition.pdf", extra_wide_plot,
       width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ===== 5) Create summary without cluttering numbers =====
cat("\n=== CLEAN COMPOSITION PLOT CREATED ===\n")
cat("Improvements made:\n")
cat("- Wider bars (width = 0.8 and 0.9)\n")
cat("- Removed all percentage labels from bars\n")
cat("- Cleaner appearance with better spacing\n")
cat("- Larger plot dimensions for better visibility\n")

cat("1. Clean_Immune_Cluster_Disease_Composition.pdf - Clean version (14x7)\n")
cat("2. Clean_Immune_Cluster_Disease_Composition.png - PNG version\n")
cat("3. Extra_Wide_Immune_Composition.pdf - Extra wide version (16x8)\n")

cat("- Purple (#8A2BE2): SSc-ILD\n")

# ===== 6) Print some key insights without cluttering the plot =====
# Most disease-enriched clusters

disease_enriched <- composition_data %>%
  filter(group != "CTRL") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(disease_pct = sum(percentage), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(disease_pct)) %>%
```
