```{r}

immune_seurat <- readRDS("Immune_Renamed_0to20_Final.rds")

# ===== FIND MARKERS FOR RENAMED CLUSTERS AND CREATE SUBSET HEATMAP =====
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# ===== 1) Find markers for all renamed clusters =====
cat("=== FINDING MARKERS FOR RENAMED CLUSTERS ===\n")
cat("This may take a few minutes...\n")

# Make sure we're using the renamed clusters as active identity
Idents(immune_seurat) <- immune_seurat$renamed_clusters

# Find all markers
renamed_markers <- FindAllMarkers(immune_seurat,
                                 only.pos = TRUE,
                                 min.pct = 0.25,
                                 logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                 verbose = TRUE)

saveRDS(renamed_markers, file = "renamed_markers.rds")
cat("Total markers found:", nrow(renamed_markers), "\n")
cat("Clusters analyzed:", length(unique(renamed_markers$cluster)), "\n")

# ===== 2) Get top 10 markers per cluster =====
top10_renamed_markers <- renamed_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(10, avg_log2FC) %>%
  arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))

cat("Top 10 markers per cluster selected\n")

# ===== 3) Filter for specific clusters of interest =====
clusters_of_interest <- c("1", "3", "5", "15", "16", "18")
cat("Creating heatmap for clusters:", paste(clusters_of_interest, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Get markers for only the clusters of interest
subset_markers <- top10_renamed_markers %>%
  filter(cluster %in% clusters_of_interest)

# Get unique genes for heatmap
heatmap_genes <- unique(subset_markers$gene)
cat("Total genes for heatmap:", length(heatmap_genes), "\n")

# ===== 4) Calculate average expression for subset clusters =====
cat("Calculating average expression...\n")

# Only calculate for clusters of interest
subset_avg_exp <- AverageExpression(immune_seurat,
                                   features = heatmap_genes,
                                   idents = clusters_of_interest,
                                   slot = "data")$RNA

# Z-score normalize across clusters (rows = genes, cols = clusters)
subset_avg_exp_scaled <- t(scale(t(subset_avg_exp)))

# Handle any NaN values
subset_avg_exp_scaled[!is.finite(subset_avg_exp_scaled)] <- 0

# ===== 5) Transpose for genes on x-axis, clusters on y-axis =====
heatmap_matrix <- t(subset_avg_exp_scaled)  # Now: rows = clusters, cols = genes

cat("Heatmap matrix dimensions:", nrow(heatmap_matrix), "clusters x", ncol(heatmap_matrix), "genes\n")

# ===== 6) Create cluster annotations =====
cluster_annotation <- data.frame(
  Cluster_Type = paste("Cluster", rownames(heatmap_matrix)),
  row.names = rownames(heatmap_matrix)
)

# Define colors for the specific clusters
cluster_colors <- c("#E31A1C", "#FF7F00", "#1F78B4", "#33A02C", "#6A3D9A", "#B15928")
names(cluster_colors) <- paste("Cluster", clusters_of_interest)

annotation_colors <- list(Cluster_Type = cluster_colors)

# ===== 7) Create the heatmap =====
cat("Creating heatmap...\n")

pdf("Selected_Clusters_Top10_Markers_Heatmap.pdf", height = 8, width = 60)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,      # Keep cluster order
  cluster_cols = TRUE,       # Cluster genes
  show_colnames = TRUE,      # Show gene names (x-axis)
  show_rownames = TRUE,      # Show cluster names (y-axis)
  fontsize_row = 14,         # Cluster names font
  fontsize_col = 10,         # Gene names font
  border_color = "grey60",
  annotation_row = cluster_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Top 10 Markers: Clusters 1, 3, 5, 15, 16, 18",
  angle_col = 45,           # Angle gene names for readability
  cellwidth = 15,          # Width for each gene
  cellheight = 30          # Height for each cluster
)

dev.off()

# ===== 8) Show the heatmap in console too =====
heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  border_color = "grey60",
  annotation_row = cluster_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Top 10 Markers: Selected Clusters",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 12,
  cellheight = 25
)

# ===== 9) Save marker tables =====
write.csv(renamed_markers, "Renamed_Clusters_All_Markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top10_renamed_markers, "Renamed_Clusters_Top10_Markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(subset_markers, "Selected_Clusters_Markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ===== 10) Display markers for selected clusters =====
cat("\n=== TOP MARKERS FOR SELECTED CLUSTERS ===\n")

for (clust in clusters_of_interest) {
  cluster_genes <- subset_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    head(5)

  cat("\nCluster", clust, "top 5 markers:\n")
  cat("  Genes:", paste(cluster_genes$gene, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  Log2FC:", paste(round(cluster_genes$avg_log2FC, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ===== 11) Cell type reminder for selected clusters =====
cat("\n=== CELL TYPES OF SELECTED CLUSTERS ===\n")
cluster_celltypes <- data.frame(
  cluster = c("1", "3", "5", "15", "16", "18"),
  cell_type = c("T_cells", "NK_cells", "B_cells", "Regulatory_T_cells",
                "Proliferating_cells", "Cytotoxic_T_cells")
)

print(cluster_celltypes)

# ===== 12) Summary statistics =====
cat("\n=== HEATMAP SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Clusters included:", paste(clusters_of_interest, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total genes displayed:", ncol(heatmap_matrix), "\n")
cat("Genes per cluster: ~10 (top markers)\n")
cat("Layout: Genes on X-axis, Clusters on Y-axis\n")

# Show cell counts for selected clusters
selected_cluster_counts <- table(Idents(immune_seurat))[clusters_of_interest]
cat("\nCell counts in selected clusters:\n")
print(selected_cluster_counts)

cat("\n=== FILES GENERATED ===\n")
cat("1. Selected_Clusters_Top10_Markers_Heatmap.pdf - Main heatmap\n")
cat("2. Renamed_Clusters_All_Markers.csv - All cluster markers\n")
cat("3. Renamed_Clusters_Top10_Markers.csv - Top 10 per cluster\n")
cat("4. Selected_Clusters_Markers.csv - Markers for clusters 1,3,5,15,16,18\n")

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Heatmap created for immune cell clusters with adaptive/lymphoid focus:\n")
cat("- Cluster 1: T cells\n")
cat("- Cluster 3: NK cells  \n")
cat("- Cluster 5: B cells\n")
cat("- Cluster 15: Regulatory T cells\n")
cat("- Cluster 16: Proliferating cells\n")
cat("- Cluster 18: Cytotoxic T cells\n")
```

```{r}
# ===== PRESERVE EXACT GENE ORDER FROM ORIGINAL HEATMAP =====

# ===== 1) EXTRACT GENE ORDER FROM YOUR ORIGINAL WORKING HEATMAP =====
# First, let's recreate the original heatmap to get the clustered gene order
cat("Recreating original heatmap to extract gene order...\n")

# Create the original heatmap object (don't save to PDF, just get the object)
original_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,       # This creates the gene clustering
  show_colnames = FALSE,     # Don't display, just get order
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  silent = TRUE              # Don't plot, just return object
)

# Extract the gene order from the clustering
if (!is.null(original_heatmap$tree_col)) {
  # Get the gene order from the dendrogram
  clustered_gene_order <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)[original_heatmap$tree_col$order]
  cat("Successfully extracted", length(clustered_gene_order), "genes in clustered order\n")
} else {
  # Fallback: use the order from your image (manually specify)
  cat("Using manual gene order from your image...\n")
  clustered_gene_order <- c("AURKA", "MKI67", "BIRC5", "UBE2C", "CENPF", "CDK1", "ANLN", "NUSAP1", "TOP2A", "PRC1", "IQGAP3", "AURKB", "CCNB1", "CCNB2", "CDCA7", "RRM2", "TPX2", "BCL7A", "MYO1G", "TCL1A", "CCDC144B", "SPOCK2", "BANK1", "VPREB3", "TNFRSF13C", "MS4A1", "LY9", "IGHM", "CD79A", "CD79B", "SMIM14", "LINC01781", "TMEM233", "GCSAML", "MEG3", "IL1RL1", "STXBP6", "RAB27B", "DUSP14", "HPGDS", "HDC", "MARCH3", "FOXP3", "TNFRSF4", "MAGEH1", "ICA1", "TNFRSF18", "CTLA4", "TIGIT", "LINC01943", "CD27", "IL2RA", "KLRF1", "FGFBP2", "SPON2", "CLIC3", "GNLY", "KLRD1", "NKG7", "CMC1", "PRF1", "CD247", "AC026369.3", "RBP4", "RND3", "FABP3", "PHLDA3", "PCOLCE2", "PPIC", "FHL1", "GLDN", "FAM89A", "CD2", "KLRB1", "SPOCK2", "AC245427.1", "CD3E", "CD3D", "ITM2A", "IL32", "TRBC2", "TRAC")
}

# ===== 2) FILTER CLUSTERS AND REORDER =====
# Define target clusters and desired order
actual_rows <- rownames(heatmap_matrix)
if (any(grepl("^g", actual_rows))) {
  existing_clusters <- c("g1", "g3", "g5", "g15", "g18")
  desired_cluster_order <- c("g5", "g15", "g3", "g1", "g18")
} else {
  existing_clusters <- c("1", "3", "5", "15", "18")
  desired_cluster_order <- c("5", "15", "3", "1", "18")
}

# Filter clusters that actually exist
available_clusters <- existing_clusters[existing_clusters %in% rownames(heatmap_matrix)]
final_cluster_order <- desired_cluster_order[desired_cluster_order %in% available_clusters]

# Filter genes that actually exist in the matrix
available_genes <- clustered_gene_order[clustered_gene_order %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix)]

cat("Using", length(available_clusters), "clusters and", length(available_genes), "genes\n")

# ===== 3) CREATE PROPERLY ORDERED MATRIX =====
# Filter rows (clusters) and columns (genes) with exact ordering
final_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[final_cluster_order, available_genes, drop = FALSE]

cat("Final matrix dimensions:", dim(final_matrix), "\n")
cat("Cluster order:", paste(rownames(final_matrix), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("First 10 genes:", paste(head(colnames(final_matrix), 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ===== 4) CREATE HEATMAP WITH PRESERVED ORDER =====
pdf("Exact_Gene_Order_Heatmap.pdf", height = 8, width = 60)

pheatmap(
  final_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,      # Keep cluster order
  cluster_cols = FALSE,      # Keep gene order (already clustered)
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 16,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  border_color = "grey60",
  main = "5 Clusters - Exact Gene Order Preserved",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 15,
  cellheight = 40
)

dev.off()

# ===== 5) DISPLAY PREVIEW IN CONSOLE =====
preview_genes <- min(30, ncol(final_matrix))
pheatmap(
  final_matrix[, 1:preview_genes, drop = FALSE],
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 14,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  border_color = "grey60",
  main = paste("Preview: First", preview_genes, "Genes in Correct Order"),
  angle_col = 45
)

# ===== 6) VERIFICATION =====
cat("\n=== GENE ORDER VERIFICATION ===\n")
cat("First 20 genes in final heatmap:\n")
print(head(colnames(final_matrix), 20))

cat("\nExpected order from your image (first 20):\n")
expected_start <- c("AURKA", "MKI67", "BIRC5", "UBE2C", "CENPF", "CDK1", "ANLN", "NUSAP1", "TOP2A", "PRC1", "IQGAP3", "AURKB", "CCNB1", "CCNB2", "CDCA7", "RRM2", "TPX2", "BCL7A", "MYO1G", "TCL1A")

# Check if order matches
actual_start <- head(colnames(final_matrix), 20)
matches <- sum(actual_start == expected_start[1:length(actual_start)])
cat("Genes matching expected order:", matches, "out of", length(actual_start), "\n")

cat("\n=== FINAL RESULT ===\n")
cat("Heatmap created with:\n")
```

```{r}
# ===== MYELOID CLUSTER HEATMAP =====
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# ===== 1) Define myeloid clusters of interest =====
myeloid_clusters <- c("2", "4", "0", "8", "9", "10", "11", "13", "14")
cat("Creating heatmap for myeloid clusters:", paste(myeloid_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ===== 2) Filter markers for myeloid clusters =====
# Assuming top10_renamed_markers already exists from previous analysis
if (!exists("top10_renamed_markers")) {
  cat("top10_renamed_markers not found. Finding markers first...\n")
  # Set active identity to renamed clusters
  Idents(immune_seurat) <- immune_seurat$renamed_clusters

  # Find all markers
  renamed_markers <- FindAllMarkers(immune_seurat,
                                   only.pos = TRUE,
                                   min.pct = 0.25,
                                   logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                   verbose = FALSE)

  # Get top 10 per cluster
  top10_renamed_markers <- renamed_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(10, avg_log2FC) %>%
    arrange(cluster, desc(avg_log2FC))
}

# Filter for myeloid clusters only
myeloid_markers <- top10_renamed_markers %>%
  filter(cluster %in% myeloid_clusters)

# Get unique genes for heatmap
myeloid_heatmap_genes <- unique(myeloid_markers$gene)
cat("Total genes for myeloid heatmap:", length(myeloid_heatmap_genes), "\n")

# ===== 3) Calculate average expression for myeloid clusters =====
cat("Calculating average expression for myeloid clusters...\n")

myeloid_avg_exp <- AverageExpression(immune_seurat,
                                    features = myeloid_heatmap_genes,
                                    idents = myeloid_clusters,
                                    slot = "data")$RNA

# Z-score normalize across clusters
myeloid_avg_exp_scaled <- t(scale(t(myeloid_avg_exp)))

# Handle any NaN values
myeloid_avg_exp_scaled[!is.finite(myeloid_avg_exp_scaled)] <- 0

# ===== 4) Transpose for genes on x-axis, clusters on y-axis =====
myeloid_heatmap_matrix <- t(myeloid_avg_exp_scaled)  # Now: rows = clusters, cols = genes

cat("Myeloid heatmap matrix dimensions:", nrow(myeloid_heatmap_matrix), "clusters x", ncol(myeloid_heatmap_matrix), "genes\n")

# ===== 5) Create cluster annotations (simplified to avoid errors) =====
myeloid_cluster_annotation <- data.frame(
  Cluster_ID = rownames(myeloid_heatmap_matrix),
  row.names = rownames(myeloid_heatmap_matrix)
)

# Create colors for myeloid clusters
myeloid_colors <- rainbow(length(myeloid_clusters))
names(myeloid_colors) <- rownames(myeloid_heatmap_matrix)

myeloid_annotation_colors <- list(Cluster_ID = myeloid_colors)

# ===== 6) Create the myeloid heatmap =====
cat("Creating myeloid heatmap...\n")

pdf("Myeloid_Clusters_Top10_Markers_Heatmap.pdf", height = 10, width = 25)

pheatmap(
  myeloid_heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,      # Keep cluster order
  cluster_cols = TRUE,       # Cluster genes
  show_colnames = TRUE,      # Show gene names (x-axis)
  show_rownames = TRUE,      # Show cluster names (y-axis)
  fontsize_row = 14,         # Cluster names font
  fontsize_col = 10,         # Gene names font
  border_color = "grey60",
  annotation_row = myeloid_cluster_annotation,
  annotation_colors = myeloid_annotation_colors,
  main = "Top 10 Markers: Myeloid Clusters (0,2,4,8,9,10,11,13,14)",
  angle_col = 45,           # Angle gene names for readability
  cellwidth = 12,          # Width for each gene
  cellheight = 35          # Height for each cluster
)

dev.off()

# ===== 7) Also create a simple version without annotations =====
pdf("Myeloid_Clusters_Simple_Heatmap.pdf", height = 10, width = 25)

pheatmap(
  myeloid_heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 16,
  fontsize_col = 11,
  border_color = "grey60",
  main = "Myeloid Cell Clusters: Top Marker Genes",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 14,
  cellheight = 40
)

dev.off()

# ===== 8) Display in console =====
pheatmap(
  myeloid_heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  border_color = "grey60",
  main = "Myeloid Clusters Heatmap",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 25
)

# ===== 9) Save myeloid marker data =====
write.csv(myeloid_markers, "Myeloid_Clusters_Top10_Markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ===== 10) Display top markers for each myeloid cluster =====
cat("\n=== TOP 5 MARKERS FOR EACH MYELOID CLUSTER ===\n")

for (clust in myeloid_clusters) {
  cluster_genes <- myeloid_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    head(5)

  if (nrow(cluster_genes) > 0) {
    cat("\nCluster", clust, "top 5 markers:\n")
    cat("  Genes:", paste(cluster_genes$gene, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("  Log2FC:", paste(round(cluster_genes$avg_log2FC, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# ===== 11) Myeloid cell type annotations =====
cat("\n=== MYELOID CLUSTER CELL TYPES ===\n")
myeloid_celltypes <- data.frame(
  cluster = c("0", "2", "4", "8", "9", "10", "11", "13", "14"),
  cell_type = c("M2_Macrophages", "Macrophages", "Monocytes",
                "M2_Macrophages", "M2_Macrophages", "M2_Macrophages",

print(myeloid_celltypes)

# ===== 12) Cell count summary =====
myeloid_cluster_counts <- table(Idents(immune_seurat))[myeloid_clusters]
cat("\nCell counts in myeloid clusters:\n")

total_myeloid_cells <- sum(myeloid_cluster_counts)
```

```{r}
cat("Recreating original MIXED IMMUNE heatmap to extract gene order...\n")
# Create the original mixed heatmap object (don't save to PDF, just get the object)
original_mixed_heatmap <- pheatmap(
  mixed_heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,       # This creates the gene clustering
  show_colnames = FALSE,     # Don't display, just get order
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  silent = TRUE              # Don't plot, just return object
)

# Extract the gene order from the clustering
if (!is.null(original_mixed_heatmap$tree_col)) {
  # Get the gene order from the dendrogram
  clustered_mixed_gene_order <- colnames(mixed_heatmap_matrix)[original_mixed_heatmap$tree_col$order]
  cat("Successfully extracted", length(clustered_mixed_gene_order), "genes in clustered order\n")
} else {
  # Fallback: use current gene order
  cat("No clustering tree found, using current gene order...\n")
  clustered_mixed_gene_order <- colnames(mixed_heatmap_matrix)
}

# ===== 2) FILTER CLUSTERS AND REORDER =====
# Define target mixed immune clusters
target_mixed_clusters <- c("6", "7", "16", "17", "19", "12", "20")

# Check actual row names in the matrix
actual_rows <- rownames(mixed_heatmap_matrix)
cat("Actual row names in mixed matrix:", paste(actual_rows, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Handle different naming conventions
if (any(grepl("^g", actual_rows))) {
  # Add "g" prefix if needed
  target_with_prefix <- paste0("g", target_mixed_clusters)
  cat("Trying with g prefix:", paste(target_with_prefix, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  final_mixed_clusters <- target_with_prefix
} else {
  final_mixed_clusters <- target_mixed_clusters
}

# Filter clusters that actually exist
available_mixed_clusters <- final_mixed_clusters[final_mixed_clusters %in% rownames(mixed_heatmap_matrix)]
cat("Available mixed clusters:", paste(available_mixed_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Filter genes that actually exist in the matrix
available_mixed_genes <- clustered_mixed_gene_order[clustered_mixed_gene_order %in% colnames(mixed_heatmap_matrix)]
cat("Available genes:", length(available_mixed_genes), "\n")

# ===== 3) CREATE PROPERLY ORDERED MATRIX =====
# Filter rows (clusters) and columns (genes) with exact ordering
final_mixed_matrix <- mixed_heatmap_matrix[available_mixed_clusters, available_mixed_genes, drop = FALSE]

cat("Final mixed matrix dimensions:", dim(final_mixed_matrix), "\n")
cat("Cluster order:", paste(rownames(final_mixed_matrix), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("First 10 genes:", paste(head(colnames(final_mixed_matrix), 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")

  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),

print(tail(colnames(final_mixed_matrix), 10))

# ===== 8) CELL TYPE SUMMARY FOR FILTERED CLUSTERS =====
cat("\n=== FILTERED CLUSTER CELL TYPES ===\n")
cluster_types <- data.frame(
  cluster = rownames(final_mixed_matrix),
  cell_type = case_when(
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("6", "g6") ~ "Neutrophils",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("7", "g7") ~ "Mast_cells",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("12", "g12") ~ "Plasma_cells",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("16", "g16") ~ "Proliferating_cells",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("17", "g17") ~ "Dendritic_cells",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("19", "g19") ~ "Tissue_resident_CTL",
    rownames(final_mixed_matrix) %in% c("20", "g20") ~ "Plasmacytoid_DC",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
)

print(cluster_types)

cat("\n=== FINAL MIXED IMMUNE RESULT ===\n")
cat("Heatmap created with:\n")
cat("- Clusters:", paste(rownames(final_mixed_matrix), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("- Total genes:", ncol(final_mixed_matrix), "\n")
cat("- Exact gene order preserved from original clustering\n")
cat("- Files: Exact_Mixed_Gene_Order_Heatmap.pdf and Simple version\n")

cat("\nThis has the EXACT same gene order as your original mixed immune heatmap!\n")
```

```{r}
immune_filtered <- immune_seurat


# ===== CELLCHAT RECEPTOR-LIGAND ANALYSIS: LECs vs IMMUNE =====
library(CellChat)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ===== 1) PREPARE LEC DATA =====
cat("Preparing LEC clusters...\n")

# Extract specific LEC clusters (LEC0, LEC2, LEC3, LEC5)
target_lec_clusters <- c("LEC0", "LEC2", "LEC3", "LEC5")

# Filter LEC object to target clusters
lec_subset <- subset(sce_LECs, idents = target_lec_clusters)
cat("LEC clusters included:", paste(target_lec_clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("LEC cells:", ncol(lec_subset), "\n")

# ===== 2) PREPARE IMMUNE DATA =====
cat("Preparing immune clusters...\n")

# Use your renumbered immune clusters (all 21 clusters: 0-20)
cat("Immune clusters included: 0-20\n")
cat("Immune cells:", ncol(immune_filtered), "\n")

# ===== 3) COMBINE DATASETS =====
cat("Combining LEC and immune datasets...\n")

lec_counts <- as.matrix(lec_subset[["RNA"]]$data)
immune_counts <- as.matrix(immune_filtered[["RNA"]]$data)

# Find common genes
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(lec_counts), rownames(immune_counts))
cat("Common genes between datasets:", length(common_genes), "\n")

# Create combined matrix
combined_counts <- cbind(
  lec_counts[common_genes, ],
  immune_counts[common_genes, ]
)

seurat_obj <- immune_seurat  # your object
stopifnot(exists("cell_labels"))

# 1) Ensure names on the label vector
if (is.null(names(cell_labels))) {
  stop("Your 'cell_labels' vector has no names. Give it names that match colnames(immune_seurat).")
}

# 2) Reindex labels to the Seurat object's cells, in the correct order
cell_labels <- cell_labels[colnames(seurat_obj)]  # now ordered like the object

# 3) Drop cells with missing labels (if any)
keep <- !is.na(cell_labels)
if (!all(keep)) {
  message("Dropping ", sum(!keep), " cells with missing labels.")
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = colnames(seurat_obj)[keep])
  cell_labels <- cell_labels[keep]
}

# 4) Sanity check: lengths must match now
stopifnot(length(cell_labels) == ncol(seurat_obj))

# 5) Store labels in metadata and build CellChat
seurat_obj$labels <- factor(cell_labels)
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = seurat_obj, group.by = "labels")

# proceed as usual
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.human
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
# decide raw.use; here we assume raw counts are available
raw_like <- TRUE
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, raw.use = raw_like)
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

# ===== 8) VISUALIZATION =====
cat("Creating visualizations...\n")

# --- compute vertex weights (group sizes) and align to the network matrix ---
# sizes per group
gs <- table(cellchat@idents)

# make sure order matches the adjacency matrix rows/cols
gs <- gs[rownames(cellchat@net$count)]
gs <- as.numeric(gs)

# --- plots ---
pdf("LEC_Immune_Communication_Network.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)

# number of interactions
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = gs,     # <- the vector, not a function
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge   = FALSE,
  title.name   = "Number of Interactions"
)

# interaction strength
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = gs,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge   = FALSE,
  title.name   = "Interaction Strength"
)

dev.off()

# Network plot showing communication strength
pdf("LEC_Immune_Communication_Network.pdf", width = 12, height = 10)

# Circle plot showing interaction strength
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize(cellchat),
                 weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE,
                 title.name = "Number of Interactions")

netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize(cellchat),
                 weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE,
                 title.name = "Interaction Strength")

dev.off()

# ===== 9) HEATMAP OF COMMUNICATION PATTERNS =====
pdf("LEC_Immune_Communication_Heatmaps.pdf", width = 15, height = 10)

# Heatmap showing communication patterns
netVisual_heatmap(cellchat, signaling = NULL, color.heatmap = "Reds")

# Show top pathways
pathways.show.all <- cellchat@netP$pathways
top_pathways <- head(pathways.show.all, 10)

for (pathway in top_pathways) {
  tryCatch({
    netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = pathway, layout = "circle")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Skipping pathway", pathway, "due to error\n")
  })
}

dev.off()

# ===== 10) ANALYZE SPECIFIC LEC-IMMUNE COMMUNICATIONS =====
cat("Analyzing LEC-to-Immune communications...\n")

# Get communication from LECs to immune cells
lec_to_immune <- subsetCommunication(cellchat,
                                    sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                                    targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE))

# Get communication from immune to LECs
immune_to_lec <- subsetCommunication(cellchat,
                                    sources.use = grep("Immune_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                                    targets.use = grep("LEC_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE))

# ===== 11) TOP INTERACTIONS ANALYSIS =====
cat("Identifying top interactions...\n")

# Most significant LEC-to-immune interactions
top_lec_to_immune <- lec_to_immune %>%
  arrange(desc(prob)) %>%
  head(20)

# Most significant immune-to-LEC interactions
top_immune_to_lec <- immune_to_lec %>%
  arrange(desc(prob)) %>%
  head(20)

# ===== 12) SAVE RESULTS =====
write.csv(lec_to_immune, "LEC_to_Immune_Communications.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(immune_to_lec, "Immune_to_LEC_Communications.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_lec_to_immune, "Top_LEC_to_Immune_Interactions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_immune_to_lec, "Top_Immune_to_LEC_Interactions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save CellChat object
saveRDS(cellchat, "LEC_Immune_CellChat_Object.rds")

# ===== 13) SUMMARY STATISTICS =====
cat("\n=== CELLCHAT ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total cell types analyzed:", nlevels(cellchat@idents), "\n")
cat("LEC clusters:", paste(grep("LEC_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Immune clusters:", paste(grep("Immune_", levels(cellchat@idents), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\nCommunication statistics:\n")
cat("Total interactions (LEC → Immune):", nrow(lec_to_immune), "\n")
cat("Total interactions (Immune → LEC):", nrow(immune_to_lec), "\n")
cat("Significant pathways identified:", length(cellchat@netP$pathways), "\n")

cat("\nTop 5 LEC-to-Immune interactions:\n")
for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(top_lec_to_immune))) {
  cat(i, ". ", top_lec_to_immune$source[i], " → ", top_lec_to_immune$target[i],
      " (", top_lec_to_immune$ligand[i], "-", top_lec_to_immune$receptor[i],
      ", prob=", round(top_lec_to_immune$prob[i], 3), ")\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\nTop 5 Immune-to-LEC interactions:\n")
for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(top_immune_to_lec))) {
  cat(i, ". ", top_immune_to_lec$source[i], " → ", top_immune_to_lec$target[i],
      " (", top_immune_to_lec$ligand[i], "-", top_immune_to_lec$receptor[i],
      ", prob=", round(top_immune_to_lec$prob[i], 3), ")\n", sep = "")
}

cat("\n=== FILES GENERATED ===\n")
cat("1. LEC_Immune_Communication_Network.pdf - Network visualizations\n")
cat("2. LEC_Immune_Communication_Heatmaps.pdf - Heatmaps and pathway plots\n")
cat("3. LEC_to_Immune_Communications.csv - All LEC→Immune interactions\n")
cat("4. Immune_to_LEC_Communications.csv - All Immune→LEC interactions\n")
cat("5. Top_LEC_to_Immune_Interactions.csv - Top 20 LEC→Immune\n")
cat("6. Top_Immune_to_LEC_Interactions.csv - Top 20 Immune→LEC\n")
cat("7. LEC_Immune_CellChat_Object.rds - Complete CellChat object\n")

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Use the CSV files to identify key receptor-ligand pairs between LECs and immune cells!\n")
```

```{r}
# Directional circle plot emphasizing LEC→Immune signaling
netVisual_circle(
  targeted_cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = targeted_group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "LEC0/3/5 → Immune: Number of Interactions"
)

netVisual_circle(
  targeted_cellchat@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = targeted_group_sizes,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "LEC0/3/5 → Immune: Interaction Strength"
)

dev.off()

# ===== 5) DIRECTIONAL HEATMAP (LECs AS SENDERS) =====
cat("Creating directional heatmaps...\n")

pdf("Targeted_LEC_Signaling_Heatmaps.pdf", width = 18, height = 8)

# Extract LEC→Immune communications only
lec_to_immune_targeted <- subsetCommunication(
  targeted_cellchat,
  sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
  targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE)
)

# Create directional heatmap showing LECs as senders
if (nrow(lec_to_immune_targeted) > 0) {
  # Custom heatmap showing LEC→Immune signaling strength
  netVisual_heatmap(targeted_cellchat,
                   sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                   targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                   color.heatmap = "Reds",
                   title.name = "LEC0/3/5 Signaling to Immune Cells")
}

# Top pathways from LECs to immune cells
targeted_pathways <- targeted_cellchat@netP$pathways
top_targeted_pathways <- head(targeted_pathways, 6)

for (pathway in top_targeted_pathways) {
  tryCatch({
    # Show pathway with emphasis on LEC sources
    netVisual_aggregate(targeted_cellchat,
                       signaling = pathway,
                       layout = "circle",
                       sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Skipping pathway", pathway, "due to error\n")
  })
}

dev.off()

# ===== 6) EXTRACT AND ANALYZE LEC→IMMUNE COMMUNICATIONS =====
cat("Analyzing targeted LEC-to-Immune communications...\n")

# Focus only on LEC→Immune direction
targeted_lec_signaling <- lec_to_immune_targeted

# Get top signaling interactions
top_targeted_signaling <- targeted_lec_signaling %>%
  arrange(desc(prob)) %>%
  head(30)

# ===== 7) LEC CLUSTER-SPECIFIC SIGNALING ANALYSIS =====
cat("Analyzing cluster-specific signaling patterns...\n")

# Analyze each target LEC cluster's signaling
lec_cluster_signaling <- list()

for (lec_cluster in paste0("LEC_", target_lecs)) {
  if (lec_cluster %in% levels(targeted_cellchat@idents)) {
    cluster_signaling <- targeted_lec_signaling %>%
      filter(source == lec_cluster) %>%
      arrange(desc(prob)) %>%
      head(10)

    lec_cluster_signaling[[lec_cluster]] <- cluster_signaling
  }
}

# ===== 8) SAVE TARGETED RESULTS =====
cat("Saving targeted analysis results...\n")

# Save signaling data
write.csv(targeted_lec_signaling, "Targeted_LEC_to_Immune_Signaling.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top_targeted_signaling, "Top30_LEC_to_Immune_Signaling.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save cluster-specific results
for (cluster_name in names(lec_cluster_signaling)) {
  filename <- paste0("Signaling_", gsub("_", "", cluster_name), "_to_Immune.csv")
  write.csv(lec_cluster_signaling[[cluster_name]], filename, row.names = FALSE)
}

# Save CellChat object
saveRDS(targeted_cellchat, "Targeted_LEC_Immune_CellChat.rds")

# ===== 9) TARGETED SUMMARY AND RESULTS =====
cat("\n=== TARGETED LEC SIGNALING ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("LEC signalers analyzed:", paste(grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Immune receivers analyzed:", paste(grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total cell types:", nlevels(targeted_cellchat@idents), "\n")
cat("Focus: LEC0, LEC3, LEC5 signaling TO immune cells\n")

cat("\nSignaling Statistics:\n")
cat("LEC → Immune signaling events:", nrow(targeted_lec_signaling), "\n")
cat("Significant pathways:", length(targeted_cellchat@netP$pathways), "\n")

cat("\nTop 5 LEC-to-Immune Signaling Events:\n")
for(i in 1:min(5, nrow(top_targeted_signaling))) {
  cat(paste0(i, ". ", top_targeted_signaling$source[i], " → ", top_targeted_signaling$target[i],
             " (", top_targeted_signaling$ligand[i], "→", top_targeted_signaling$receptor[i],
             ", prob=", round(top_targeted_signaling$prob[i], 3), ")\n"))
}

# LEC cluster-specific top signaling
cat("\n=== LEC CLUSTER-SPECIFIC SIGNALING PATTERNS ===\n")
for (cluster_name in names(lec_cluster_signaling)) {
  cluster_data <- lec_cluster_signaling[[cluster_name]]
  if (nrow(cluster_data) > 0) {
    cat("\n", cluster_name, " top signaling targets:\n")
    for(j in 1:min(3, nrow(cluster_data))) {
      cat("  → ", cluster_data$target[j], " (", cluster_data$ligand[j], "→", cluster_data$receptor[j],
          ", prob=", round(cluster_data$prob[j], 3), ")\n")
    }
  }
}

# ===== 10) SIGNALING STRENGTH COMPARISON =====
cat("\n=== LEC CLUSTER SIGNALING STRENGTH COMPARISON ===\n")

signaling_summary <- targeted_lec_signaling %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_targets = n_distinct(target),
    avg_prob = round(mean(prob), 3),
    max_prob = round(max(prob), 3),
    top_target = target[which.max(prob)],
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_prob))

print(signaling_summary)

cat("\n=== FILES GENERATED ===\n")
cat("1. Targeted_LEC_to_Immune_Networks.pdf - Directional network plots\n")
cat("2. Targeted_LEC_Signaling_Heatmaps.pdf - LECs→Immune heatmaps and pathways\n")
cat("3. Targeted_LEC_to_Immune_Signaling.csv - All LEC0/3/5→Immune signaling\n")
cat("4. Top30_LEC_to_Immune_Signaling.csv - Top 30 signaling events\n")
cat("5. SignalingLEC[X]_to_Immune.csv - Cluster-specific signaling files\n")
cat("6. Targeted_LEC_Immune_CellChat.rds - Targeted CellChat object\n")

cat("\n=== TARGETED SIGNALING ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Focus: LEC0, LEC3, LEC5 as signal SENDERS to immune cell RECEIVERS\n")
cat("Directional analysis reveals how these specific LEC subtypes communicate with immune cells!\n")
```

```{r}
# ===== MODIFIED HEATMAP SECTION TO REMOVE EMPTY SPACE =====

pdf("Targeted_LEC_Signaling_Heatmaps3.pdf", width = 18, height = 8)

# Extract LEC→Immune communications only
lec_to_immune_targeted <- subsetCommunication(
  targeted_cellchat,
  sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
  targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE)
)

# Create directional heatmap showing LECs as senders
if (nrow(lec_to_immune_targeted) > 0) {

  # Method 1: Use netVisual_heatmap with remove.isolate parameter
  netVisual_heatmap(targeted_cellchat,
                   sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                   targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                   color.heatmap = "Reds",
                   title.name = "LEC0/3/5 Signaling to Immune Cells",
                   remove.isolate = TRUE,  # This removes isolated nodes with no connections
                   width = 12, height = 6)

  # Method 2: Alternative approach using netVisual_bubble for cleaner visualization
  netVisual_bubble(targeted_cellchat,
                  sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                  targets.use = grep("Immune_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                  remove.isolate = TRUE,
                  title.name = "LEC0/3/5 → Immune Signaling Strength")

  # Method 3: Create custom matrix with only non-zero interactions
  # Get the communication matrix
  comm_matrix <- targeted_cellchat@net$weight

  # Extract only LEC sources and Immune targets
  lec_sources <- grep("LEC_", rownames(comm_matrix), value = TRUE)
  immune_targets <- grep("Immune_", colnames(comm_matrix), value = TRUE)

  # Subset the matrix
  lec_immune_matrix <- comm_matrix[lec_sources, immune_targets]

  # Remove rows and columns that are all zeros
  non_zero_rows <- rowSums(lec_immune_matrix) > 0
  non_zero_cols <- colSums(lec_immune_matrix) > 0

  clean_matrix <- lec_immune_matrix[non_zero_rows, non_zero_cols]

  # Create custom heatmap if there are non-zero interactions
  if (nrow(clean_matrix) > 0 && ncol(clean_matrix) > 0) {
    library(pheatmap)
    pheatmap(clean_matrix,
             color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(50),
             cluster_rows = FALSE,
             cluster_cols = FALSE,
             main = "LEC0/3/5 → Immune Signaling (Non-zero only)",
             fontsize = 10,
             cellwidth = 15,
             cellheight = 15)
  }
}

# Continue with pathway analysis as before...
targeted_pathways <- targeted_cellchat@netP$pathways
top_targeted_pathways <- head(targeted_pathways, 6)

for (pathway in top_targeted_pathways) {
  tryCatch({
    # Show pathway with emphasis on LEC sources, removing isolates
    netVisual_aggregate(targeted_cellchat,
                       signaling = pathway,
                       layout = "circle",
                       sources.use = grep("LEC_", levels(targeted_cellchat@idents), value = TRUE),
                       remove.isolate = TRUE)  # Add this parameter
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Skipping pathway", pathway, "due to error\n")
  })
}

dev.off()
```

```{r}

# ===== 5) CUSTOM DIRECTIONAL HEATMAP (LECs AS ROWS, IMMUNE AS COLUMNS) =====
cat("Creating custom directional heatmap...\n")

pdf("Targeted_LEC_Signaling_Heatmaps2.pdf", width = 20, height = 6)

# Get the communication strength matrix
comm_matrix <- targeted_cellchat@net$weight

# Extract LEC and Immune cluster names
lec_clusters <- grep("LEC_", rownames(comm_matrix), value = TRUE)
immune_clusters <- grep("Immune_", colnames(comm_matrix), value = TRUE)

# Create custom matrix: LECs as rows, Immune as columns
lec_to_immune_matrix <- comm_matrix[lec_clusters, immune_clusters, drop = FALSE]

cat("Custom heatmap dimensions:", dim(lec_to_immune_matrix), "\n")
cat("LECs (rows):", nrow(lec_to_immune_matrix), "\n")
cat("Immune (columns):", ncol(lec_to_immune_matrix), "\n")

# Create the custom heatmap
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(
  lec_to_immune_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "LEC0/3/5 Signaling Strength to Immune Cells",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 15,
  cellheight = 40,
  border_color = "grey90"
)

# Alternative version with clustering
pheatmap(
  lec_to_immune_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#FDE725", "white", "#440154"))(100),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,  # Cluster immune cells by similarity
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "LEC0/3/5 → Immune (Clustered by Response)",
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 15,
  cellheight = 40
)

dev.off()
```
